exact.en: Refuel at any ground fuel station.
exact.zh: 在任意地面加油站补充燃料。

exact.en: Customize the weather during a flight.

exact.zh: 在不使用辅助的情况下，手动启动空客A320neo的发动机。

exact.en: Use the Smart Cam to view animals for 3 seconds, from a distance of 550 yards or less.

exact.zh: 在条件允许的机场机位上，申请过所有种类的起飞前地勤服务。

exact.zh: 运用地勤推回服务移动飞机，总里程达1英里。

exact.zh: 参考“实时交通”中的现实飞机航线，制定一个飞行计划，然后在不使用辅助的情况下飞完全程。

exact.en: Complete a non-stop flight of at least 300 miles from take-off to landing.
exact.zh: 完成一次航程不低于300英里的直达航班。

exact.en: Land at an airport where windspeeds are in excess of 5 knots, without using any assistance.
exact.zh: 风速超过5节时，成功降落在机场，且不使用任何辅助。

exact.en: Land on a grass runway, without using any assistance.
exact.zh: 成功降落在草地跑道，且不使用任何辅助。

exact.en: Use the Instrument Landing System (ILS) to complete a landing.
exact.zh: 使用仪表着陆系统（ILS）完成着陆。

exact.en: Complete a non-stop 300+ mile flight from parking to parking spot, without assistance.
exact.zh: 从始发地驻机坪出发，完成航程300+英里的直达航班，降落在目的地并到达驻机坪，期间不使用辅助。

exact.en: After receiving landing clearance, switch off engines and successfully land on the runway.
exact.zh: 获得着陆许可后，关闭飞机引擎，并成功着陆在跑道上。
完成一个高光事件挑战。

exact.en: Fly from LFBD airport near Asobo Studio to KSEA airport near Microsoft HQ.

exact.en: Taxi aircraft for a total distance of 100 miles.
exact.zh: 飞机滑行总里程达100英里。

exact.en: Land at an airport where windspeeds are in excess of 15 knots, without using any assistance.
exact.zh: 风速超过15节时，成功降落在机场，且不使用任何辅助。

exact.en: Land on a runway shorter than 2,000 feet, without using any assistance or bypassing any travel.
exact.zh: 成功降落长度短于2000英尺的跑道上，不使用任何辅助，且不跳过任何旅途。

exact.en: Land on a runway that has at least a 12 degree incline, without using any assistance.
exact.zh: 成功降落在坡度不小于12°的跑道上，且不使用任何辅助。

exact.en: Complete the Nevada Bush Trip, without using any navigation assistance.
exact.zh: 完成内华达郊野之行，且不使用任何导航辅助。

exact.zh: 在550码或更近的距离内，使用智能镜头观看25个明星地标。

exact.en: Accumulate 50 hours of flight time in rainy weather.
exact.zh: 累计50小时的降雨天气飞行时间。

exact.en: Complete flights of at least 300 miles using a prop, jet and airliner.
exact.zh: 使用螺旋桨飞机、喷气式飞机和客机完成航程至少为300英里的飞行。

exact.en: Complete a flight of at least 8 hours with a propeller or turbo-prop aircraft.
exact.zh: 驾驶螺旋桨飞机或涡轮螺旋桨飞机，完成一次时长至少为8小时的飞行。

exact.en: Accumulate 100 hours of flight time in a single pilot profile.
exact.zh: 在单个飞行员档案中累计100小时的飞行时间。

exact.en: Accumulate 50 hours of flight time at night.
exact.zh: 累计50小时的夜晚飞行时间。

exact.en: Accumulate 50 hours of IFR flight time, including at least one take-off and landing.
exact.zh: 累计50小时的IFR飞行时间，且完成至少一次起飞和着陆。
标准离场程序与标准进场程序

在500个不同的机场成功降落。

exact.zh: 使用 Flight Simulator 标准版中的每架飞机，完成 300 英里以上的飞行。

exact.en: Accumulate 500 hours of flight time in a single pilot profile.
exact.zh: 在单个飞行员档案中累计500小时的飞行时间。

exact.en: Accumulate 1,000 hours of flight time in a single pilot profile.
exact.zh: 在单个飞行员档案中累计1,000小时的飞行时间。

Successfully complete 30 seaplane landings without incident
exact.zh: 成功完成30次水上飞机着陆且无事故

exact.zh: 驾驶所拥有的飞机从一个机场飞往另一个机场

exact.zh: 在世界摄影师模式、职业生涯模式和挑战联赛模式中各完成3个任务

exact.zh: 乘坐热气球参观7个地标。在参观的每个地标周围1千米内停留3分钟

exact.en: Perform a touch-and-go landing at 2 different airports in a single session
exact.zh: 一次任务中在2个不同的机场执行触地复飞式着陆

exact.zh: 在任意直升机场成功完成50次着陆且没有事故

exact.zh: 在挑战联赛每个可选每周挑战赛中获得排名

exact.zh: 在雷诺航空赛的快速比赛中3次进入前三名

exact.en: Complete 10 weekly Challenges in the Challenge League
exact.zh: 在挑战联赛中完成10个每周挑战

exact.en: Complete 100 weekly Challenges in the Challenge League
exact.zh: 在挑战联赛中完成100个每周挑战

exact.en: Complete a Red Bull Air Race without incurring any penalties
exact.zh: 完成红牛航空竞速赛且不受任何处罚

exact.zh: 在职业生涯模式中获得所有20项基本认证

exact.en: Take a photo in World Photographer, using photo mode
exact.zh: 在世界摄影师中使用拍摄模式拍摄一张照片

exact.zh: 在世界摄影师中完成一个收集页面

exact.zh: 在世界摄影师中完成10个收集页面

exact.zh: 在世界摄影师中完成一个包含航空、人造、自然与动物的收集页面
在世界摄影师中收集100星

exact.zh: 完成首个教程训练任务

exact.zh: 完成所有基本操控、起飞和着陆以及VFR训练任务

exact.zh: 选择该图块以查看市场中的物品

You don't have any Custom Content. Go to the Marketplace to find new Activities.
exact.zh: 你没有任何自定义内容，请前往市场寻找新活动。

exact.en: Take part in the fastest motorsport in the world, featuring air racing at speeds up to 500 mph
exact.zh: 参加全世界最快的空中竞速，比赛飞行速度可达每小时500英里

exact.en: End Flight when aircraft shuts down
exact.zh: 飞机停止运转时结束飞行

exact.en: Adjust whether the post-flight Logbook screen will open automatically whenever the aircraft is shut down.
exact.zh: 调整飞机关闭后飞行日志屏幕是否会自动打开。
自动操作方向舵反向偏航

exact.en: Adjust whether you want rudder controls to be assisted.
exact.zh: 设置是否需要系统辅助操作方向舵。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want the aircraft lights to be activated automatically.
exact.zh: 设置航空器照明是否自动开启。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want the airport services to be in motion or not.
exact.zh: 调整是否需要机动性机场服务。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to display an artificial representation of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) flowing around the aircraft during a flight.
exact.zh: 设置是否需要显示在飞行过程中飞机周围流动的计算流体动力学（CFD）的人工表示。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want the AI Piloting assist to temporarily take over flight controls whenever the cursor mode is activated during flight.

Note that this feature is only applicable when using an Xbox controller.
exact.zh:
设置在飞行中启动光标模式时，是否由AI驾驶辅助暂时接管飞行控制。

请注意，此功能仅适用于使用Xbox控制器的时候。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want the AI Piloting assist to temporarily take over flight controls whenever the cursor mode is activated during flight.

Note that this feature is only applicable when using a DualSense® controller.
exact.zh:
设置在飞行中启动光标模式时，是否由AI驾驶辅助暂时接管飞行控制。

请注意，此功能仅适用于使用DualSense®控制器的时候。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to enable a Traffic Collision Avoidance System to issue alerts when close to other aircraft during flight. If enabled, this setting will apply even in aircraft that are not fitted with the system in real life.
exact.zh: 设置是否需要空中防撞系统的辅助。若开启该选项，即使是现实中不具备该系统的航空器也将应用此项设置。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want the AI pilot to offer anti-stall protection during Free Flight and supported Activities. When active, the AI will temporarily override the yoke and attempt to recover the aircraft when the angle of attack reaches unsafe levels.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否希望AI飞行员提供防失速保护。当设置为启用状态时，AI将暂时取代控制杆，并在迎角达到危险阈值时尝试复原飞机.

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want the AI co-pilot to assist with checklists during Free Flight and supported Activities. If this is enabled, additional options will be available in the in-flight Checklist panel to either auto-complete the checklist (where the Co-Pilot performs the checklist action and marks it complete) or validate (where the Co-Pilot waits for you to perform the action before marking it complete).

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否需要AI副驾驶协助完成检查单。如果启用该选项，飞行中打开检查单面板时会有额外选项供您使用：自动模式（AI副驾驶自动执行检查单所列操作并标记完成）或验证模式（AI副驾驶等待您执行检查单所列操作，之后才标记完成）。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want the instructor to take over flight controls when necessary.
exact.zh: 设置教练何时接管操作。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want the AI Piloting assist to temporarily take over flight controls whenever the cursor mode is activated during flight.
exact.zh: 设置在飞行中启动光标模式时，是否由AI驾驶辅助暂时接管飞行控制。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want elevator controls to be assisted.
exact.zh: 设置是否需要系统辅助操作升降舵。

exact.en: Apply sensitivity tweaks to the yoke commands, allowing for easier control when using an Xbox controller.
exact.zh: 对控制杆命令输入应用灵敏度调整，以便在使用Xbox控制器时实现更轻松的控制。

exact.en: Apply sensitivity tweaks to the yoke commands, allowing for easier control when using a DualSense® controller.
exact.zh: 对控制杆命令输入应用灵敏度调整，以便在使用DualSense®控制器时实现更轻松的控制。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want collective controls to be assisted in rotorcraft during Free Flight and supported Activities.
exact.zh: 设置是否希望在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间在旋翼机中辅助总距操纵控制。
直升机：辅助周期变距杆

exact.en: Adjust whether you want cyclic controls to be assisted in rotorcraft during Free Flight and supported Activities.
exact.zh: 调整是否希望在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间在旋翼机中辅助周期变距操纵控制。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want tail rotor controls to be assisted in rotorcraft during Free Flight and supported Activities.
exact.zh: 调整是否希望在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间在旋翼机中辅助尾桨控制。

exact.en: Automatically adjusts the collective to prevent loss of control due to Vortex Ring State conditions that can occur when descending too quickly at low airspeeds or during rapid deceleration (quick stop).
exact.zh: 自动调节总距，以防止在低空速状态下降过快或实施快速减速（急停）时，因涡环状态而导致的失控。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want AI assistance for throttle, pitch, flaps and landing gear during the Final Approach phase of Free Flights and supported Activities. When active, this assist will attempt to adjust the above systems, but any user inputs will resume manual controls and override the AI.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置是否需要在自由飞行和支持的活动的最终进近阶段为油门、俯仰、襟翼和起落架提供AI辅助。若开启，此AI辅助将尝试调整上述系统，但任何用户输入操作都将恢复手动控制并覆盖AI。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want rudder controls to be assisted for fixed-wing aircraft during Free Flight and supported Activities.

When enabled, this option will help maintain level flight when in the air, and help steer the aircraft when on the ground. It will also cancel out effects of any crosswind during take-off or landing to make it easier to stay aligned with the runway.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间是否需要系统辅助固定翼飞行器的操作方向舵。

启用后，此选项将帮助飞机在空中保持平飞，在地面上亦能协助飞机转向。它还将自动抵消起飞、降落过程中侧风的影响，使保持在跑道方向上变得更简单。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争公平。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want AI assistance for throttle, pitch, flaps and landing gear during the Takeoff phase of Free Flights and supported Activities. When active, this assist will attempt to adjust the above systems, but any user inputs will resume manual controls and override the AI.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置是否需要在自由飞行和支持活动的起飞阶段为油门、俯仰、襟翼和起落架提供AI辅助。若开启，此AI辅助将尝试调整上述系统，但任何用户输入操作都将恢复手动控制并覆盖AI。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want trim controls to be assisted for fixed-wing aircraft to maintain level flight while cruising during Free Flight and supported Activities.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间是否需要系统辅助固定翼飞行器进行配平，以便飞机在巡航状态下保持平直飞行。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争公平。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want yoke controls (pitch and roll) to be assisted for fixed-wing aircraft during Free Flight and supported Activities.

When enabled, this option will make minor corrections to maintain level flight if the controls are left alone while flying relatively straight and level.

The assist is overridden whenever the user manually controls the yoke, and will not trigger if the aircraft is banking at an angle of 15 degrees or above.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
调整在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间是否需要协助控制杆（俯仰和滚动）进行辅助控制。

启用后，游戏将自动对操纵控制杆进行细微的更正，以协助在双手离杆时保持平飞。

若玩家手动操作控制杆，自动辅助控制将被覆盖，且飞机倾斜角度为15度及以上时该辅助功能不会触发。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能数，以确保公平竞争。

exact.en: ATC UI panel open at start

Adjust whether the ATC interaction UI panel should be open by default at the start of a new flight.

Whenever the panel is not open, it can be accessed via the in-flight Toolbar menu.
exact.zh:
设置在新飞行开始时是否默认开启'ATC交互UI界面'。

如果该界面没有打开，可通过'飞行中工具栏'菜单打开。

exact.en: Show message log in ATC menu
Adjust whether the ATC UI panel will display a log of archived messages.
exact.zh: 设置是否在ATC UI界面显示已存档消息记录。

exact.en:
Adjust whether ATC will follow the departure and arrival procedures specified in the flight plan.

If enabled, Air Traffic Control will always default to the departure runway, arrival runway and approach procedure as defined in the original flight plan, regardless of the current weather conditions.

If disabled, ATC will decide the active runway and approach depending on current conditions, including weather and performance.
exact.zh:
调整空中交通管制（ATC）是否遵循飞行计划中设定的出发和抵达程序。

如果启用，无论当前天气状况如何，ATC将始终默认采用原始飞行计划中设定的起飞跑道、抵达跑道和进近程序。

如果禁用，ATC将根据包括天气和性能在内的当前状况决定使用的跑道和进近方式。

exact.en:
Enable or disable the ATC voice during flight.

Note that ATC will still be audible during introduction cinematics regardless of this setting.
exact.zh:
开关飞行过程中的ATC语音。

注意即使此设置已关闭，过场动画中的ATC语音依旧是正常启用的。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want throttle controls to be assisted.
exact.zh: 设置是否需要系统辅助操作油门。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want the engine fuel mixture automatically adjusted in appropriate aircraft, during Free Flight and supported Activities.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否需要在相应的飞机上自动调整发动机燃料混合物。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en: Adjust whether the ATC interaction UI panel should be tuned to an active Air Traffic Controller by default at the start of a new flight. If this is disabled, you will not see or hear ATC communications until you retune the radio.
exact.zh: 设置在新飞行开始时是否默认开启“ATC交互UI界面”，以联系可用的航空管制员。如果关闭此选项，重调无线电之前将无法接收到任何ATC通信。

exact.en: Hot air balloons: Accelerated envelope inflation
Adjust whether you want the envelope of hot air balloons to inflate at an increased rate.
exact.zh: 设置是否希望以更快的速度对热气球的气囊进行充气。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want the basket of hot air balloons to be moored when starting from ground. If activated, unmooring must be performed via an input.
exact.zh: 设置是否希望在从地面启动时是否要将热气球吊篮系泊。激活后，则必须通过输入执行解系泊。

exact.en: Checklist UI panel open at start

Adjust whether the Checklist management UI panel should be open by default at the start of a new flight.

Whenever the panel is not open, it can be accessed via the in-flight Toolbar menu.
exact.zh:
设置在新飞行开始时是否默认开启'检查单管理UI界面'。

如果该界面没有打开，可通过'飞行中工具栏'菜单打开。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want the AI co-pilot to manage communication with Air Traffic Control during Free Flight and supported Activities.

Note that the AI may not always be able to anticipate your intentions in order to make the correct requests - for example it may not automatically request landing clearance if you attempt to land at an unscheduled airport that isn't part of an existing flight plan.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否需要AI副驾驶负责与空中交通管制通信。

请注意，AI并不是在所有情况下都能完全领会你的意图并作出正确请求，例如当你试图降落在现有飞行计划外未预定的机场时，它可能无法自动请求降落许可。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want the AI co-pilot to fly the aircraft.
exact.zh: 设置是否需要AI副驾驶操纵航空器。

exact.en:
Adjust whether all the active Visual Assistance options are visible by default at the start of each flight.

When enabled, you will be able to quickly toggle all enabled Visual Assistances during flight by pressing {STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}.

Note that this setting will not change whether any Visual Assistance option is active, and will only toggle whether already-active Assists are visible or not.
exact.zh:
设置所有活动的视觉辅助选项是否在每次飞行开始时默认可见。

启用后，按下{STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}，您将能够在飞行期间快速切换所有启用的视觉辅助。

请注意，此设置不会切换任何视觉辅助选项的活跃状态，而只会切换已激活辅助的能见度。

exact.en: Display Labels for all on-screen POIs
exact.zh: 显示屏幕上所有兴趣点的标签

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want to show text labels for all nearby Points of Interest during Free Flight and supported Activities.

If this option is active, all on-screen POI markers within close proximity to the aircraft's current position will display text labels.

If this option is deactivated, only the POI closest to the center of the screen will be labelled.
exact.zh:
调整是否要在自由飞行期间显示附近所有兴趣点的文本标签以及所支持的活动。

如果启用，则靠近飞机当前位置的所有屏幕兴趣点标记将显示文本标签。

如果禁用，则仅标记最靠近屏幕中心的兴趣点。

exact.en: Adjust whether to display commonly-used contextual button inputs on-screen during various phases of a flight, such as how to access the EFB or movement controls when on foot.
exact.zh: 设置是否在飞行的各个阶段在屏幕上显示常用的上下文按钮输入，例如步行时如何访问EFB或移动控件。
飞行过程中显示上下文输入
显示已选兴趣点（POI）的方向

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to display an on-screen marker if you use the Flight Assistant menu during a flight to target a Point of Interest.
exact.zh: 在飞行过程中如果使用'飞行辅助'菜单定位一个兴趣点，请设置是否在屏幕上显示标记。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want Electronic Stability and Protection (ESP) and Under-Speed Protection (USP) assistance. If enabled, this setting will apply even in aircraft that are not fitted with the systems in real life.
exact.zh: 设置是否需要电子增稳保护系统(ESP)与低速保护系统(USP)的辅助。若开启该选项，即使是现实中不具备这些功能的航空器也将应用此项设置。

exact.en: This option is yet to be implemented, help text TBC.
exact.zh: 此项设置尚未实装，说明文本有待后续添加。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want gyro drift to occur during flight. If this is disabled, the gyro will require mid-flight recalibration in certain aircraft.
exact.zh: 设置是否开关飞行过程中的陀螺仪漂移。如果禁用该选项，驾驶特定飞机时，需要在飞行过程中重新校准陀螺仪。

exact.en:
Adjust whether to simulate loss of pilot consciousness (blackout and redout effects) when flying at extreme G forces.

If deactivated, pilots can perform extreme maneuvers without simulating loss of consciousness.

If the CIVIL AVIATION PILOT option is enabled, pilots will have limited resistance to extreme G forces.

If the JET PILOT option is enabled, pilots will have slightly improved resistance to extreme G forces.
exact.zh:
设置是否模拟飞行员在极端重力下的意识丧失现象（黑视与红视）。

如果停用该选项，模拟飞行员将无视意识丧失，进而能够完成一些极限操作。

启用“民间飞行员”选项时，飞行员对极端重力的抵抗力会比较有限。

启用“喷气机飞行员”选项时，飞行员对极端重力的抵抗力将略有提高。

exact.en:
Adjust whether to simulate the protective effects of a G-Suit when flying at extreme G forces.

If enabled, pilots will be able to tolerate an additional G-force before experiencing loss of consciousness effects.

If the G-Effect option is deactivated, this option will have no effect.
exact.zh:
设置是否模拟抗荷服在极端重力下飞行时的保护效果。

如果启用，飞行员将能够在经历意识丧失效果之前承受额外的重力。

如果重力加速度效应选项已停用，该选项将没有效果。
外部视角中的抬头显示

exact.en:
Adjust whether to show a full or minimal on-screen HUD while in External Camera mode.

Full HUD will show text and visual information on various aircraft instruments in the corners of the screen for quick visual reference.

Minimal HUD will only display text information without the accompanying visuals.

You can also turn the HUD off completely.
exact.zh:
设置'外部摄像机'模式下显示完整或最小HUD屏幕。

完整HUD将在屏幕角落显示各种飞机仪表的文本和视觉信息，以便实现快速视觉参考。

最小HUD将仅显示文本信息，而不显示随附的视觉效果。

你也可以完全关闭HUD。

exact.en:
Adjust whether to show a minimal on-screen HUD while in Cockpit Camera mode.

Minimal HUD will show text information on various aircraft instruments in the corners of the screen for quick visual reference.

You can turn the HUD off for a more realistic experience.
exact.zh:
设置在驾驶舱摄像机模式下是否显示最小HUD屏幕。

最小HUD将在屏幕角落显示各种飞机仪表的文本信息，以便实现快速视觉参考。

你可以关闭HUD以获得更逼真的体验。

exact.en: HUD in virtual reality cockpit view
Adjust whether to show a full or minimal on-screen minimap while in External Camera mode.
exact.zh: 调整是否在外部摄像机模式下显示完整或精简的屏幕小地图。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want to enable physical and/or visual only icing effects on the aircraft when flying in certain atmospheric conditions.

When this option is set to ON, ice accretion will affect the airframe, injection systems, carburetor, as well as pitot icing. Icing adds to the overall weight of the aircraft and disrupts the laminar flow of air over the surfaces leading to a loss of altitude or even a stall situation. Engine icing manifests in different ways depending on motorization, but in the end it results in a loss of power or even a complete engine failure.

If set to VISUAL ONLY, the above physical effects of icing on the flight model and engine are deactivated, while keeping the visual feedback on the airframe.

If set to OFF, no physical or visual icing effects will occur.
exact.zh:
设置在某些大气条件下飞行时是否要对飞机启用物理和/或视觉上的结冰效果。

当此选项设置为'开'时，积冰将影响机身、喷射系统、化油器以及空速管结冰。结冰增加飞机的整体重量，并扰乱飞机表面的空气层流，导致高度下降，甚至失速。发动机结冰根据不同的机动性表现出不同的方式，但最终会导致动力损失甚至是发动机完全失效。

如果设置为'仅视觉'，则飞行模型和发动机的上述物理结冰效果将停用，只保持机体上的视觉效果。

如果设置为'关'， 不会发生物理或视觉结冰效果。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want a series of on-screen gates to be shown in the world during Free Flight and supported Activities.

If enabled, these gates will indicate an appropriate altitude and heading for the current flight path.

If enabled, you will be able to quickly toggle the visibility of this Assist by pressing {STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否需要显示一系列屏幕闸门。

启用后，这些闸门将为当前航迹显示适宜的高度和航向。

启用后，按下{STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}，您可以快速切换此辅助的能见度。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。
小地图显示航线与航路点

exact.en: Adjust whether you want navigation icons drawn on the minimap.
exact.zh: 设置是否需要在小地图上显示导航标记。

exact.en: Nav Log UI panel open at start
exact.zh: 导航日志UI界面默认开启

exact.en:
Adjust whether the Nav Log UI panel should be open by default at the start of a new flight.

Whenever the panel is not open, it can be accessed via the in-flight Toolbar menu.
exact.zh:
设置在新飞行开始时是否默认开启'导航日志UI界面'。

如果该界面没有打开，可通过'飞行中工具栏'菜单打开。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want on-screen notifications about Aircraft Systems during Free Flight and supported Activities.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否在需要屏幕上显示关于航空器系统的通知消息。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的协助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want on-screen Tips, explaining basic aviation concepts during Free Flight and supported Activities.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置是否在屏幕上显示小提示，以便在自由飞行和支持的活动期间解释各种基本航空概念。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的协助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want on-screen Objectives recommending what actions to take during Free Flight and supported Activities.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置是否希望在自由飞行和支持的活动期间屏幕上显示推荐目标以引导操作。

请注意，某些活动会限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。
驾驶与操控的键位提示

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want on-screen notifications about Control inputs during Free Flight and supported Activities.

If enabled, you will be able to quickly toggle the visibility of this Assist by pressing {STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否需要在屏幕上显示控制输入。

启用后，按下{STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}，您可以快速切换此辅助的能见度。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want on-screen Tips, explaining basic simulation concepts during Free Flight and supported Activities.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否需要在屏幕上显示小提示，以便解释各种基础模拟概念。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to prevent damage if colliding with other aircraft. If this assist is not enabled, any significant impact with other aircraft (either in the air or on the ground) will cause your flight to end.
exact.zh: 设置是否允许与其他航空器相撞时规避伤害。若此辅助功能未启用，则一旦与任何其他航空器相撞（无论是在空中还是地面上），飞行将自动结束。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want to prevent damage when colliding with the ground and other environment objects during Free Flight and supported Activities. If this assist is not enabled, any significant impact with terrain will cause your flight to end.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间是否允许与地面或其他环境对象相撞时规避伤害。若此辅助功能未启用，则一旦与任何环境对象相撞，飞行将自动结束。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want to prevent the engine from suffering damage if under stress during Free Flight and supported Activities. If this assist is not enabled, any sustained maneuvers that cause significant stress to the engine will cause your flight to end.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间，是否允许发动机在过载时受到损伤。若此辅助功能未启用，则一旦你的操作导致发动机过载、令其受到损伤，飞行将自动结束。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to enable equipment failures within the aircraft.
exact.zh: 设置是否允许飞机部件故障。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want the aircraft's payload weight and balance to be managed automatically.
exact.zh: 设置是否由系统调节装载量与机体平衡。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want to prevent the aircraft from suffering stress damage if flying at high G-force during Free Flight and supported Activities. If this assist is not enabled, any sustained maneuvers that cause significant stress to the airframe will cause your flight to end.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和所支持的活动期间是否允许航空器在高重力加速度下飞行时受到损伤。若此辅助功能未启用，则一旦你的操作导致机体过载、令其受到损伤，飞行将自动结束。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en: Adjust whether in-flight turbulence is enabled.
exact.zh: 设置是否开启飞行中颠簸。

exact.en: Adjust whether various in-flight sequences are combined into a single button press.
exact.zh: 设置是否将多个飞行操作整合到单次按键操作中。
无需绕机检查直接开始飞行

exact.en:
If this option is set to ON, when starting a flight at a gate or a parking, the pilot will directly be inside the cockpit rather than outside the aircraft.

Inversely, if this option is set to OFF, the pilot will start the flight outside of the aircraft where he will be able to walk around the aircraft before entering it.
exact.zh:
如果此选项设为“开启”，当从登机口或驻机坪开始飞行时，飞行员将直接位于驾驶舱内，而不是出现在飞机外部。

反之，如果此选项设为“关闭”，飞行开始时飞行员将出现在飞机外部，可以先绕机走动，然后再进入飞机。

exact.en:
Adjust whether to display pin markers on the aircraft exterior during a pre-flight walk-around.

If enabled, these pins will highlight the critical parts that require inspection.
exact.zh:
设置是否在飞行前绕机巡视时在飞机外部显示针标。

若启用，针标将高亮显示需要进行检查的关键部件。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want Airports to be marked with an icon in the world during Free Flight and supported Activities.
exact.zh: 设置是否在自由飞行和支持的活动期间标明游戏世界里的机场方位。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want Cities to be marked with an icon in the world during Free Flight and supported Activities.
exact.zh: 设置是否在自由飞行和支持的活动期间标明游戏世界里的城市方位。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want Fauna to be marked with an icon in the world during Free Flight and supported Activities.
exact.zh: 设置是否在自由飞行和支持的活动期间标明游戏世界里的动物群方位。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want Landmarks to be marked with an icon in the world during Free Flight and supported Activities.
exact.zh: 设置是否在自由飞行和支持活动期间标明游戏世界里的地标方位。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want to have the Smart Camera trigger Automatically or Manually.

If Automatic, the camera will automatically aim at a nearby point of interest (airport, city, etc).

If Manual, you can trigger the Smart Cam by pressing {STR_SMARTCAM}
exact.zh:
设置自动或手动启用智能摄像机。

如果设为自动，摄像机将自动对准附近的兴趣点（机场、城市等）。

如果设为手动，您可以按下 {STR_SMARTCAM}以启用智能摄像机。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want an on-screen ribbon shown in the world to guide the optimum path during take-off.
exact.zh: 设置起飞时是否需要在屏幕上显示指示带，以指引你选择最佳路径。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want an on-screen ribbon shown in the world to guide the optimum taxi path during Free Flight and supported Activities.

If enabled, you will be able to quickly toggle the visibility of this Assist by pressing {STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否需要在屏幕上显示游戏世界里的一个功能区，以指导最佳滑行路径。

启用后，按下{STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}，您可以快速切换此辅助的能见度。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to display Atmospheric Turbulence visualization.
exact.zh: 调整是否显示大气湍流可视化效果。
滑翔机：牵引飞机起飞辅助

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want yoke controls (pitch and roll) to be assisted for gliders during the aerotow phase at the beginning of a flight.

If enabled, a colored box will also be displayed in the world to help maintain your position in the safe area behind the tow plane.

This assist will not be applicable in Glider flights that begin with a winch launch.
exact.zh:
设置在滑翔机飞行开始时的空中牵引阶段是否需要对控制杆（俯仰和滚动）进行辅助控制。

如果启用，还将在游戏世界中显示一个彩色框，以帮助保持您在牵引飞机后面安全区域的位置。

该辅助不适用于以绞车牵引起飞开始的滑翔机飞行。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want to experience realistic turbulence throughout a flight.

When this option is set to REALISTIC, turbulence is simulated with accurate intensity for the current altitude, weather and environment.

If set to MEDIUM or LOW, real world turbulence values are reduced and the wind direction and speed becomes more stable. Thermals will still be present, but also more consistent.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
调整并选择是否要在整个飞行过程中体验逼真的湍流。

当此选项设置为 “逼真” 时，将通过当前高度、天气和环境的精确强度模拟湍流。

如果设置为 “中度” 或 “低度”，则实际湍流值会减小，风向和风速会变得更加稳定。热气流仍将存在，但也与整体环境更加接近。

请注意，某些活动将限制可用的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争公平。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want tuition from the instructor.
exact.zh: 设置是否开启教练的讲解。

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want unlimited fuel during Free Flight and supported Activities.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置在自由飞行和支持的活动期间是否开启无限燃料。

请注意，某些活动将限制支持的协助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en: VFR map UI panel open at start

Adjust whether the VFR Map UI panel should be open by default at the start of a new flight.

Whenever the panel is not open, it can be accessed via the in-flight Toolbar menu.
exact.zh:
设置在新飞行开始时是否默认开启'VFR地图UI界面'。

如果该界面没有打开，可通过'飞行中工具栏'菜单打开。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want on-screen indicators recommending what buttons to press during the flight.
exact.zh: 设置飞行时是否在屏幕上显示系统推荐的按键操作。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want the AI co-pilot to give audible advice during the flight.
exact.zh: 设置是否允许AI副驾驶在飞行中提供语音建议。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to experience realistic wake turbulence when behind other aircraft.
exact.zh: 调整是否希望跟随在其他飞机飞行时体验到真实的尾流湍流。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to display a representation of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) for wake turbulence effects.
exact.zh: 调整是否显示尾流湍流效应的计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟。
显示常用航路点指示器

exact.en:
Adjust whether you want waypoint markers superimposed in the world during Free Flight and supported Activities to help with navigation.

If enabled, a visual marker will appear on-screen identifying the name, distance and altitude of the current waypoint whenever you have an active Flight Plan.

If enabled, you will be able to quickly toggle the visibility of this Assist by pressing {STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}.

Note that some Activities will restrict the number of supported Assistance features to ensure competitive balance.
exact.zh:
设置是否要在自由飞行和支持的活动期间叠加游戏世界中的航路点图标，以助导航。

如果启用，只要有活跃的飞行计划，屏幕上就会出现一个视觉标记，用于识别当前航路点的名称、距离和高度。

启用后，按下{STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}，您可以快速切换此辅助的能见度。

请注意，某些活动会限制支持的辅助功能的数量，以确保竞争平衡。

exact.en: All Assists : You want to learn the ropes with all piloting assistances.
exact.zh: 全部辅助：希望使用全部飞行辅助功能来学习各种基本技能。

exact.en:
ALL ASSISTS

For those new to flight simulation or wanting to learn the ropes. Assistance and instruction will be offered during flight by an AI co-pilot.


MIDDLE-GROUND

For those who want a mostly-realistic experience but with some extra guidance.


TRUE TO LIFE

For those comfortable with flight simulation and who want the most authentic experience.


If you wish to customize your Assistance settings further, expand the sub-categories on the left to view and adjust individual options.
exact.zh:
全程辅助

为飞行模拟新人和希望摸索诀窍的玩家设计。飞行过程中，AI副驾驶将提供辅助与指示。


适当折中

为想要基本真实的飞行体验和一些额外引导的玩家准备。


沉浸体验

为已经适应飞行模拟并想要最逼真体验的玩家准备。


如果您想要进一步自定义辅助功能，请展开左侧子菜单，查看并调整单项设置。

exact.en: ALL ASSISTS offers the most assistance, letting users quickly take to the sky while delegating most pilot and communication systems to an autopilot. Aircraft damage is turned off, fuel is unlimited, and there are regular notifications and navigation guidance to instruct users throughout a flight.
exact.zh: 全程辅助模式为你提供最大限度的辅助，将大部分驾驶与通讯系统操作托管给自动驾驶，让你快速飞上蓝天。航空器损伤将关闭，燃料无限供应，且玩家会在飞行中收到常规通知与导航指引信息。

exact.en: MIDDLE-GROUND is intended for users who want to challenge themselves a little more. Several systems are delegated to autopilot, there are regular notifications during a flight, but aircraft damage is enabled and fuel is not unlimited.
exact.zh: 折中模式为追求更高挑战的玩家准备。此模式下将有数项功能托管给自动驾驶，飞行中可收到常规通知，但航空器可能损伤，且燃油量有限。

exact.en: REAL PILOT is intended for users with real-life pilot experience but limited flight simulation knowledge. All flight systems are manual, all damage and fuel management is realistic, but there are occasional notifications teaching features unique to simulation.
exact.zh: 飞行老手模式为具有实际飞行经验但并未过多接触模拟飞行的玩家准备。所有飞行系统都将是手动控制，飞行器损伤与燃料管理将还原真实体验，但偶尔会弹出通知消息，向玩家讲解模拟飞行独有的要素。

exact.en: SIMULATION EXPERT is intended for veteran simmers who have limited real pilot experience. A few flight systems not seen in other simulators are delegated to autopilot, but everything else is manual. All damage and fuel management is realistic, and there are occasional notifications teaching how to control the simulation.
exact.zh: 模拟专家模式为实际飞行经验有限的资深模拟飞行玩家准备。该模式下将有数个本模拟器独有的功能交由自动驾驶控制，但其他系统均为手动。飞行器损伤与燃料管理将还原真实体验，并会偶尔弹出通知消息，向玩家讲解本模拟器的操作方式。

exact.en: TRUE TO LIFE disables all assistance. Flight control is entirely manual, all damage and fuel management is realistic, and there are no notifications or on-screen guidance during flight.
exact.zh: 在沉浸模式下，系统不提供任何辅助。你将完全手动控制飞机，飞行器损伤与燃料管理将还原真实体验，并且飞行中屏幕上不会出现任何通知。

exact.en: Altiport endorsement is also called a Mountain rating. Altiport is an aerodrome located at very high elevations (4500 ft - 8000 ft), often have steep slopes, and are used one way to land, the other to take off (going up to land, going down to takeoff). The pattern is not rectangular but rather like a drop of water shaped. Finally, there are no possible missed approaches in short final, because the ground climbs quicklier than your aircraft in these conditions.
exact.zh: 高山短距离起降机场认证又称山地执照。高山短距离起降机场指位于极高海拔处（4500至8000英尺）的机场，通常有陡峭的斜坡，使用一个方向着陆、另一个方向起飞（向上着陆、向下起飞）的模式。其飞行图式不是矩形的，而是类似于水滴的形状。在此类短距离机场的最终进近阶段，由于地面上升速度比飞机快，因此无法在进近失败后复飞。

exact.en: ATPL is an Airline Transport Pilots License certificate that gives you the ability to carry passengers and cargo in authorized commercial operations, and also act as PIC of a multi-pilot aircraft. ATPL is the highest level of aircraft pilot certificate.
exact.zh: ATPL是航空运输飞行员执照，使您能够在拥有授权的商业运行中载运乘客和货物，并担任多机组飞机的机长。ATPL是飞行员执照的最高级别。

exact.en: CPL ASEL is a Commercial Pilot License certificate that gives you the authorization to act as PIC of an aircraft for compensation or hire and carry people or cargo, but not to work for scheduled airlines. Without additional ratings, the flight should be conducted in ASEL in VMC.
exact.zh: CPL ASEL是商用驾驶员执照，使您可以成为飞机机长，获取薪资或被雇佣，运行飞机并载运人员或货物，但不能参加班机航班工作。如果没有额外执照，飞行需要以所限制的速度，在平滑跑道起飞和降落。
商用驾驶执照 - 飞机

exact.en: CPL Rotorcraft Category Helicopter class rating is a Commercial Pilot License certificate that gives the authorization to act as PIC of a helicopter for compensation or hire and carry people or cargo, but not to work for scheduled airlines. Without additional ratings, the flight should be conducted in a single piston engine helicopter with single main rotor, in VMC.
exact.zh: CPL 旋翼机类别直升机等级执照，使您可以成为直升机机长，获取薪资或被雇佣，运行旋翼机并载运人员或货物，但不能参加班机航班工作。如果没有额外执照，飞行需要以所限制的速度驾驶单活塞发动机和单主旋翼的直升机。

exact.en: Insurance is a system associated with an aircraft that reduces the cost of repairs and repatriation following a crash.
exact.zh: 与飞机相关的保险系统可降低事故后的维修和遣返成本。

exact.en: Payment of the insurance is made by direct debit. At the end of each day, you receive a notification and are debited with the cost of the insurance depending on how many flight hours you’ve done this same day. If you don't request any new insurance plan, the contract is renewed (tacit renewal).
exact.zh: 保险金通过直接扣款的方式支付。在每天结束时，你会收到通知，根据你在当天完成的飞行小时数从保险费用中扣除。如果你不申请任何新的保险计划，合同将续签（默认续签）。

exact.en: Following a crash, the insurance will estimate the cost to restore the aircraft to its previous condition. The insurance will either cover a part of the repair cost or refund the covered amount if you sell the aircraft.
exact.zh: 发生事故后，保险公司将估算将飞机恢复到先前状态的费用。如果你选择修复飞机，保险公司将承担部分维修费用；如果你选择出售飞机，保险公司将退还相应的保险金额。

exact.en: Depending on your reputation level, you can get more or less discount on the insurance cost. And if you never have any crashes or repatriations, the insurance can give you an additional discount regardless of your reputation.
exact.zh: 你可以根据声誉水平获得或多或少的保险费用折扣。且如果你从未遭遇过任何事故或遣返，无论声誉如何，你都可以享受额外折扣。

exact.en: If your aircraft cannot take off, the insurance will cover a part of the repatriation costs. The insurance coverage on the repatriation costs is directly applied and the rest will be taken on your account.
exact.zh: 如果你的飞机无法起飞，保险公司将承担部分遣返费用。保险范围内的遣返费用可直接起效，其余部分则由你承担。

exact.en: Based on the flight hours done in the last 24h
exact.zh: 基于最近24小时的飞行时间

exact.en: Check up allowed us to identify the damages caused after a rough flight. We estimate the reparation cost to restore your aircraft to its previous condition at {CREDIT} Your insurance plans covers {COVERAGE_PERCENT}%.

exact.en:
Leagues are divisions of the playerbase based on their performance in weekly cohorts. Higher leagues contain more adept competitors.
Inactivity
Pilots who are inactive for a set period of time will lose league ranking.
Bronze - Gold leagues: No inactivity penalties.
Platinum league: Relegated to Gold if inactive for 2 weeks in a row.
Diamond league: Relegated to Platinum if inactive for a week.
exact.zh:
联赛是根据玩家每周在小组中的表现进行划分的。较高联赛中竞争者的水平更高。
不活跃

青铜 - 黄金联赛：无不活跃惩罚。
白金联赛：连续2周不活跃将降级到黄金联赛。
钻石联赛：1周不活跃将降级到白金联赛。

exact.en:
In Low Altitude challenges, the goal is to reach the end of the course while accruing the fewest number of points. Points are obtained every second by adding your altitude above sea level to your total points. Therefore, fly as low and as fast as you can. You are encouraged to try different routes through the course area to find the optimal path.

If the pilot crashes their aircraft, they are placed back on track starting at the previous course segment.
Pilots can manually trigger back on track by pressing: {STR_BACK_ON_TRACK}
exact.zh:
低空挑战的目标是在获得最少点数的同时抵达航线的终点。每秒钟都会获得点数，只需将当前所处的海拔高度添加到总点数。因此，要尽可能飞得低一点且快一点。我们鼓励在航线区域尝试各种不同的路线，找到最佳飞行路径。

如果飞行员坠机，他们将从上一个航线段重新回到原点。
飞行员可以手动触发重新回到原点，方法是按：{STR_BACK_ON_TRACK}

exact.en:
Obtaining a good score relies on striking a balance between flying low and flying fast, as the lowest path is not always the most straightforward. Scoring is determined through altitude and speed.
Altitude: Every second, the pilot’s altitude above sea-level is measured. The lower the altitude, the fewer the points they will receive, leading to a better score.
Speed: The faster a pilot completes the course, the fewer times their altitude will be measured, leading to a better score.
exact.zh:
若要获得不错的评分，就必须在低空飞行和高速飞行之间取得平衡，高度最低的飞行路径不一定总是最直截了当的。评分根据高度和速度来确定。
高度：每秒钟都会测量飞行员的海拔高度。高度越低，得到的点数就越低，从而便能获得更高的评分。
速度：飞行员完成航线的速度越快，其高度受到测量的次数也就越少，从而便能获得更高的评分。

exact.en: Green Route - Longer route but lower MSL altitude. Overall good

exact.en: Red Route - Shorter route but higher MSL altitude. Overall bad

exact.en:
Set at famous and demanding airports around the world, Precision Landing challenges are designed to test a pilot's ability to overcome environmental obstacles and land safely at a predetermined runway. Each challenge begins in the air, on or near final approach, with clearance to land already granted.
Piloting and navigating assistance options are limited.
exact.zh:
精确着陆挑战设在世界各地著名且要求严格的机场，旨在测试飞行员克服环境障碍并安全降落在预定跑道上的能力。每项挑战均开始于空中、飞机处于最终进近阶段时，且已获得着陆许可。
驾驶和导航辅助选项已受限。

exact.en:
Landing precision: Calculating distance between an aircraft's touch-down point and the touch-down target visible on the runway. Landing closer to the target awards more points.
Landing orientation: Assessing the orientation of the aircraft compared to the target orientation. Landing with orientation closer to the target awards more points.
Landing smoothness: Gauging an aircraft's vertical speed (feet per minute) at touch-down. The closer a pilot gets to 0 fpm, the more points will be awarded.
exact.zh:
着陆精度：计算飞机着陆点与跑道上可见着陆目标之间的距离。着陆点越靠近目标，获得的分数越高。
着陆方向：评估飞机相对于目标方向的方向。着陆方向越靠近目标，获得的分数越高。
着陆平稳度：测量飞机着陆时的垂直速度（英尺/分钟）。垂直速度越接近0，获得的分数就越高。

exact.en:
Rally Race challenges have a pilot fly an aircraft from a starting gate to a finish gate, while sequentially passing through intermediary gates along the way. The goal of rally races is to complete the course in the fastest time possible.
If the pilot crashes their aircraft, or misses a gate, they are placed back on track aligned with the gate they missed. Pilots can manually trigger back on track by pressing:{STR_BACK_ON_TRACK}
Note that increasing speed decreases maneuverability.
exact.zh:
拉力赛挑战要求飞行员驾驶飞机从起点闸口飞行到终点闸口，同时依次通过沿途的中间闸口。拉力赛的目标是以最快的时间完成赛道。
如果飞行员的飞机坠毁或错过了闸口，他们会被重新放置在与错过的闸口对齐的赛道上。飞行员可以通过按下手动触发重新回到赛道：{STR_BACK_ON_TRACK}
请注意，提高速度会降低机动性。

exact.en:
Series are periods of multiple weeks where pilots compete in specifically themed courses. The active courses change each week.
At the end of each Series, pilots receive their final League ranking for the Series and then are reset to the Bronze League for the start of the next Series. Pilots who end the current Series in Platinum or Diamond league receive a bonus by starting the next Series in a higher League.
