exact.en: It seems a background process may be causing issues with Microsoft Flight Simulator. Check antivirus, malware checker, firewall, game overlays, and other active processes on your PC. If the issue persists, scan the QR code or visit <https://flightsimulator.zendesk.com/hc/en-us> for potential solutions or to contact Support.
exact.zh: 某一后台进程可能导致《Microsoft Flight Simulator》出了点问题。请检查电脑上的防毒软件、恶意软件检查器、防火墙、游戏内额外信息和其他活动进程。若问题仍旧存在，请扫描此二维码或点击以下链接：<https://flightsimulator.zendesk.com/hc/en-us>，以寻求潜在解决方案或联系客户支持。

exact.en: Something went wrong during the launch of the game.
exact.zh: 游戏发布过程中出了点 问题。

exact.en: Accelerometer must be reset and indicate +1g
exact.zh: 需重置加速度计，并确保其读数为1g
按下信号器仪表盘上的“确认”按钮

exact.en: ADF must be set to desired frequency
exact.zh: 需将自动定向机设定至所需频率

exact.en: ADI must be illuminating in red
Attitude display indicator must be operative
exact.zh: 姿态指引仪需在运作中

exact.en: RPM must be adjusted to about 2000 RPM
exact.zh: 发动机转速需调整到约2000转/分钟

exact.en: RPM must be adjusted to about 2700 RPM
exact.zh: 发动机转速需调整到约2700转/分钟

exact.en: RPM must be adjusted to about 2780 RPM
exact.zh: 发动机转速需调整到约2780转/分钟
根据需要调整高度表调定值
调整总距操纵杆摩擦制动器

exact.en: Adjust to the upright position described by a placard on the roll-over bar and verify proper fixation
exact.zh: 调整到防滚架上标牌所描述的直立位置，并验证是否固定妥当

exact.en: Adjust the elevator trim according to the flight conditions
exact.zh: 根据飞行条件调整升降舵配平

exact.en: Adjust the pressure on pedals to adjust brake power
exact.zh: 调整踏板的压力，以调节制动功率

exact.en: Adjust the throttle lever as desired
Set the ailerons trim to neutral
Aileron trim must be set neutral
Maintain a speed suitable for the flight's conditions
exact.zh: 根据飞行状况保持在一定的速度

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 120 Km/H (65kt) during final approach
exact.zh: 最终进近时保持空速为120千米/小时（65节）

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 130 Km/H (70kt) during approach
exact.zh: 进近时保持空速为130千米/小时（70节）

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 150 Km/H (80kt) during descent
exact.zh: 下降时保持空速为150千米/小时（80节）

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 150 Km/H (80kt) during enroute climb
exact.zh: 航路爬升时保持空速为150千米/小时（80节）

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed around 43 knots / 50 mph for this phase
exact.zh: 在此阶段，保持空速表读数在43节/每小时50英里左右

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed at 55 knots for this phase
exact.zh: 在此阶段，保持空速表读数为55节

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed at 60-75 knots for this phase
exact.zh: 在此阶段，保持空速表读数为60到75节

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed at 70-80 knots for this phase
exact.zh: 在此阶段，保持空速表读数为70到80节

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed at 70-85 knots for this phase
exact.zh: 在此阶段，保持空速表读数为70到85节

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 73kt during enroute climb
exact.zh: 航路爬升时保持空速为73节

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed at 80-85 knots for this phase
exact.zh: 在此阶段，保持空速表读数为80到85节

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed at 80-90 knots (around 97 mph) for this phase
exact.zh: 在此阶段，保持空速表读数为80到90节（97英里/小时左右）

exact.en: Reduce airspeed to 80-90 kts to operate flaps
exact.zh: 将空速降至80到90节，以此操作襟翼

exact.en: Maintain indicated air speed at 90-110 mph for this phase
exact.zh: 在此阶段，保持空速表读数为90到110英里/小时

exact.en: Airspeed must be adjusted to 60 kts
Airspeed must be adjusted to 63 kts
Airspeed must be adjusted to 65 kts
Maintain an airspeed under 108kt during descent
exact.zh: 下降时保持空速低于108节

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed under 26kt / 30 mph during descent
exact.zh: 下降时保持空速低于26节/每小时30英里

exact.en: Maintain an indicated airspeed of 26 Kts / 30 mph to achieve the best rate of climb
exact.zh: 将空速表读数保持在26节/每小时30英里以达到最佳爬升率

exact.en: Maintain an indicated airspeed of 87kt to achieve the best rate of climb
exact.zh: 将空速表读数保持在87节以达到最佳爬升率

exact.en: Maintain an indicated airspeed of 89kt to achieve the best rate of climb
exact.zh: 将空速表读数保持在89节以达到最佳爬升率

exact.en: Check that the airspeed indicator is working

exact.zh: 空速/马赫数指示器必须指示0
以80英里/小时左右的速度起飞

exact.en: Set air conditioning as required per current flight parameters.
exact.zh: 根据当前飞行参数设置空调。

exact.en: Air inlet must be clear of obstruction
Air intake must be cleared of any foreign objects or obstruction
exact.zh: 必须清除进气口处的异物或障碍物

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 104kt during enroute climb
exact.zh: 航路爬升时保持空速为104节

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 93kt during enroute climb
exact.zh: 航路爬升时保持空速为93节

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 96kt during enroute climb
exact.zh: 航路爬升时保持空速为96节

exact.en: Allow a five minute colling period for the starter before any further starting operation is attempted
exact.zh: 在进行后续开启操作之前，将启动器冷却5分钟

exact.en: Allow the engine to run at the current power setting for 1 minute
exact.zh: 使发动机在当前电源设置下运行1分钟

exact.en: All circuit breakers must be in
exact.zh: 所有断路器开关必须位于

exact.en: All electrical equipment must be off
All electrical equipment must be switched off
All remaining electrical equipment must be switched off
exact.zh: 所有剩余的电气设备必须关闭

exact.en: All fuses must be in place
All lights must be turn off
All lights On when pressed, then all lights Off when released
exact.zh: 按下时所有灯亮起，松开时所有灯关闭

exact.en: All magnetos switches must be set to Both
exact.zh: 所有磁电机开关需拨至“双侧”

exact.en: All mixture levers must be set on Rich (levers fully down)
exact.zh: 所有混合气操纵杆需设置为浓混合比（操纵杆完全拨下）

exact.en: All parameters must be in green arcs
exact.zh: 所有参数都必须在绿色的弧线内

exact.en: All parameters must be in green range
exact.zh: 所有参数都必须在绿色范围内

exact.en: All parameters must be in normal range
exact.zh: 所有参数必须在正常范围内

exact.en: All pressures and temperatures must be in green arcs
exact.zh: 所有的压力和温度都必须在绿色的弧线内
所有开关必须处于关闭状态

exact.en: All switches on main CB must be set to On
exact.zh: 所有主要跳开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: All warning and caution lights must be off
exact.zh: 所有警告和警示灯必须关闭

exact.en: Alternate air source must be closed
Both alternators must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 两台交流发电机均需设为“开启”

exact.en: There should be no alternator warning displayed
exact.zh: 此时不应有交流发电机警告显示

exact.en: Both alternator switches must be ON
exact.zh: 需将交流发电机开关拨至“开启”
交流发电机须拨至“关闭”
交流发电机须拨至“开启”

exact.en: Alternator switches must be set to ON, and batteries must be charging correctly
exact.zh: 交流发电机需设为“开启”，电池需正常充电
交流发电机输出接近零

exact.en: Check altimeters and adjust to current altitude if needed
exact.zh: 检查高度表，并在必要时将其调整为当前高度

exact.en: Check altimeter and adjust to current altitude if needed.
exact.zh: 检查高度表，并在需要时根据当前高度进行调整。

exact.en: Check and adjust altimeter settings for your destination
exact.zh: 根据你的目的地检查并调整高度表调定值

exact.en: Check altimeter and adjust to current altitude if needed
exact.zh: 检查高度计，并在需要时根据当前高度进行调整
检查自动驾驶的目标高度
设置自动驾驶的目标高度

exact.en: Check that ammeter has a value greater than -1, and the voltmeter shows at least 24,5V
exact.zh: 确认电流表读数大于-1，且电压表读数至少为24或25V

exact.en: Ensure the ammeter displays a coherent value
Charge shown must be positive on main and standby battery
exact.zh: 主电池与备用电池的电量需为正

exact.en: Check that amp and voltage readings are in the green and within recommended parameters
exact.zh: 检查安培数和电压读数是否处于绿色区且在推荐参数范围内。

exact.en: If the oil pressure has not moved from the red range within 3 seconds after starting, set the engine master to OFF and investigate problem.
exact.zh: 若油压没有在启动发动机后3秒内脱离红色区域，关闭发动机总开关，查找故障原因。

exact.en: Check that the "L STARTER" annunciation isn't displayed after starting the engine. If it's displayed, turn off the engine and investigate the problem
exact.zh: 确认发动机启动后“左启动器”提示并未出现。如果这条提示出现，关闭发动机，查找故障原因。

exact.en: Check that the "R STARTER" annunciation isn't displayed after starting the engine. If it's displayed, turn off the engine and investigate the problem
exact.zh: 确认发动机启动后“右启动器”提示并未出现。如果这条提示出现，关闭发动机，查找故障原因。

exact.en: Check that "L ENGINE GLOW" is indicated (only when the engine is cold); proceed when message extinguishes
exact.zh: 可见“左发动机预热”的提示信息（仅当发动机温度低时出现）；信息消失后继续操作

exact.en: Check that "R ENGINE GLOW" is indicated (only when the engine is cold); proceed when message extinguishes
exact.zh: 确认显示“右发动机预热”的提示信息（仅当发动机温度低时出现）；信息消失后继续操作

exact.en: Ensure that nothing is displayed on the annunciator panel
exact.zh: 确保信号器仪表盘上没有信息显示

exact.en: Check the different instruments and indicators work properly : general voltage, safety panel, oil pressure, pressurization
exact.zh: 检查各种仪表与指示器，确保它们正常工作；查看总体电压、安全仪表盘、油压与压力输送

exact.en: Place and hold in "TST" position, and ensure all annunciators illuminate
exact.zh: 保持“TST”（测试）状态，在此状态下确保所有信号器点亮

exact.en: Ensure nothing is displayed on the annunciator window
exact.zh: 确保信号器窗口上没有信息显示

exact.en: Antenna must be in good condition
exact.zh: 天线必须处于良好状态

exact.en: Anti-collisions lights must be turn on
Anti-collision lights must be set to "OFF"
Strobe lights (anti-collision lights) must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 高亮度白色频闪灯（防撞灯）需设为“关闭”

exact.en: Anti-collision lights must be set to "ON"
Anti-ice mode switch must be set to Automatic
exact.zh: 防冰模式开关需拨至“自动”
如有需要，开启防冰模式

exact.en: "Anti Skid" switch must be set on On
exact.zh: 必须将“Anti Skid”（防滑）开关拨至“On”（开）

exact.en: Apply collective pitch progressively to stabilize hover at 2 feet skid height
exact.zh: 逐步应用总距操纵，以稳定悬停在2英尺的侧滑高度

exact.en: Apply slight forward cyclic to accelerate at a constant height
exact.zh: 周期变距杆轻微向前，以恒定高度加速

exact.en: Perform the mandatory approach briefing if passengers are present
exact.zh: 若机上有乘客，需进行例行进近广播

exact.en: APU ACC caution light must be off
APU bleed must be set to NORM
exact.zh: 辅助动力装置引气开关需拨至“标准”

exact.en: APU Bleed switch must be set to OFF
exact.zh: 辅助动力装置排气开关需拨至关闭

exact.en: APU bleed switch must be set to ON
exact.zh: 辅助动力装置排气开关需拨至开启

exact.en: Wait until the APU is fully running before turning APU generators ON
exact.zh: 等待辅助动力装置完全运行后再将辅助动力装置发电机拨至“开启”

exact.en: Wait until the APU start switch displays the AVAIL light
exact.zh: 等待辅助动力装置启动开关的“可用”指示灯亮起

exact.en: APU Generator switch must be set to ON
exact.zh: 辅助动力装置发电机开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: APU master switch must be set to OFF
exact.zh: 辅助动力装置总开关需拨至关闭

exact.en: APU master switch must be set to ON
exact.zh: 辅助动力装置总开关需拨至开启
APU（辅助动力装置）必须关闭

exact.en: APU "Ready" light must be on within 30 seconds
exact.zh: APU“就绪”灯必须在30秒内亮起
等待辅助动力装置每分钟转数稳定下来

exact.en: APU selector must be set to OFF
exact.zh: 辅助动力装置转换开关需设为“关闭”

exact.en: Set the APU selector to Start then release it to ON
exact.zh: 将辅助动力装置选择器设置为“启动”，然后放开则显示“开启”

exact.en: APU start switch must be set to ON
exact.zh: 辅助动力装置启动开关需拨至开启

exact.en: APU switch must be set on Off
exact.zh: 必须将APU（辅助动力装置）开关拨至OFF（关闭）

exact.en: Autopilot and Yaw damper must be "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将自动驾驶与偏航阻尼器调至“关闭”

exact.en: Check that the area in front of the plane is clear
Area must be cleared of any foreign objects or obstruction
exact.zh: 必须清除该区域的异物或障碍物

exact.en: Area must be clear of foreign matter
exact.zh: 必须清除该区域的异物

exact.en: Reduce to idle after clearing obstacle
exact.zh: 清除障碍物之后降低动力至怠速

exact.en: Listen to the Automatic Terminal Information Service for info, and get a Start Clearance as required
exact.zh: 认真听航站自动信息服务，从中获取信息，并按要求取得开车许可

exact.en: Check that the attitude indicator is working properly (should move during taxi)
exact.zh: 确认姿态指示器正常工作（滑行时会移动）

exact.en: Align attitude indicator with artificial horizon
exact.zh: 参照模拟地平仪校准姿态指示器

exact.en: The attitude indicator must be uncaged
exact.zh: 姿态指示器需处于释放松开状态

exact.en: CAS message "STARTER" should not remain displayed when Ng reaches ~52%.
exact.zh: 当发电机旋转速度到达52%后，机组警告系统上的“启动器”信息将停止显示。

exact.en: When turned on, autopilot should execute a series of test and play a sound to confirm correct functioning
exact.zh: 开启自动驾驶后，系统将完成一系列测试，并播放确认音

exact.en: Check the autopilot's parameters, according to your plan
exact.zh: 根据你的飞行计划，检查自动驾驶参数

exact.en: Fuel pumps of both engines must be switched OFF
exact.zh: 两台发动机的燃料泵均需关闭

exact.en: Fuel pumps of both engines must be switched ON
exact.zh: 两台发动机的燃料泵均需开启

exact.en: Set the FUEL PUMP switch to the ON position temporarily
exact.zh: 暂时将燃料泵开关拨至开启

exact.en: Avionics master switches must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将各个航空电子设备总开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Avionics master's BUS 1 switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将航空电子设备总线开关1拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Avionics master's BUS 1 switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 必须将总线开关1拨至“开启”

exact.en: Avionics master's BUS 2 switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将航空电子设备总线开关2拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Avionics master's BUS 2 switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 需将航空电子设备总线开关2拨至“开启”

exact.en: Avionics master switch must be set to "DISPATCH"
exact.zh: 航空电子设备主开关需设置为“调用”

exact.en: Avionics master switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将航空电子设备总开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Avionics master switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 需将航空电子设备总开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Set avionics No. 1 and No. 2 Switches to "OFF"
exact.zh: 将航空电子设备1号和2号开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Set avionics No. 1 and No. 2 Switches to "ON"
exact.zh: 将航空电子设备1号和2号开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Avionics No. 1 Switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 航空电子设备1号开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: Avionics No. 2 Switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 航空电子设备2号开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: Ensure the avionics, flight plan, GPS etc. are set as desired for the planned flight
exact.zh: 按照此次飞行的目标，正确设置航空电子设备、飞行计划与全球定位系统

exact.en: Check that the A/C system is turned off.
exact.zh: 检查空调系统是否已关闭。

exact.en: Airspeed should be 1.2 times the stall speed
exact.zh: 空速应为失速速度的1.2倍

exact.en: Minimum airspeed through the pickup poles should be 1.6 times the stall speed
exact.zh: 通过拾波器的最小空速应为失速速度的1.6倍

exact.en: Batteries switches must be set to "ON"
Battery and alternator switches must be ON
exact.zh: 需将电池及交流发电机开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Both battery switches must be ON
exact.zh: 需将两个电池开关都拨至“开启”

exact.en: Battery master switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将电池总开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Battery switches must be set to AUTO / ON
exact.zh: 电池开关需设置为“自动”或“开启”

exact.en: Battery switches must be set to OFF
Battery switches must be set to ON
Battery switch must be set to "OFF"
Battery switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 需将电池开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: The discharge shown must be negative
Beacon switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将红色防撞灯开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Beacon switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 需将红色防撞灯开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Best economy : 2350 RPM at 20 inches manifold pressure
exact.zh: 经济性最佳：20英寸歧管压力下的转速为2350转/分

exact.en: "Bleed Air" must be set to NORM
exact.zh: 必须将“Bleed Air”（引气）设置为“NORM”（标准）

exact.en: Bleed switch must be on either "AUTO" or "MAX DIFF"
exact.zh: 需将引气开关拨至“自动”或“最大差值”

exact.en: Bleed switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将引气开关拨至“关闭”
按下按钮时，蓝色指示灯亮起

exact.en: Set the boost pump to ON temporarily
exact.zh: 将助推泵暂时设置为开启
将“升压泵”开关设置为关闭

exact.en: Brakes must be applied and ensuing brake pressure checked
exact.zh: 必须应用制动器并检查制动压力
飞行准备检查时握住制动器

exact.en: Ensure the disc brakes work properly
Test the brakes by pushing the pedals and set the parking brake
exact.zh: 通过踩踏板并启用驻机制动器来测试制动器

exact.en: Push the pedals and hold them
Press and release the brake pedals, ensuring that the brake discs operate properly
exact.zh: 按下并释放制动踏板，确保制动盘运行正常

exact.en: Brake fluid level must be sufficient
Brake must be in good condition
exact.zh: 制动器必须处于良好状态

exact.en: Brake Pressure and Hydraulic Pressure (<1000 PSI)
exact.zh: 制动压力和液压（<1000磅/平方英寸）

exact.en: Brake wear indicator must be extended
exact.zh: 必须延长制动器磨损指示器

exact.en: Apply just enough brakes to slow down the plane
exact.zh: 控制刹车力度，使飞机停止

exact.en: Brief your passengers regarding the flight
exact.zh: 向乘客简要介绍航班信息

exact.en: Brightness must be adjusted as required
exact.zh: 亮度需根据需要进行调整

exact.en: Check that bus voltage readings are in the green and within recommended parameters.
exact.zh: 检查总线电压读数是否处于绿色区且在推荐参数范围内。

exact.en: Check that the PFD turns on when the electric masters are ON
exact.zh: 电源总开关开启时，可看到主飞行显示器亮起

exact.en: Cabin PWR 12V switch must be switched OFF
exact.zh: 座舱的12伏电源开关应关闭

exact.en: All windows must be correctly closed and locked
Canopy must be closed and locked

exact.zh: 设置座舱盖开关检查闩锁

exact.en: Cap must be on and hold
From the "cold" position (indicators fully up), turn the carburetor heat levers to set a 15°C rise in carburetor heat and check that a limited decrease in RPM ensues
exact.zh: 转动化油器加热握杆，使其从“放热”位置（指针在最上方）上升化油器热量至15°C，并检查每分钟转速是否得到限降低

exact.en: Turn on carburetor heat and check that a limited decrease in RPM ensues
exact.zh: 开启化油器加热，并检查每分钟转速是否得到限降低

exact.en: Carburetors heat must be set on Cold (indicators fully up)
exact.zh: 化油器加热需设置在“放热”（指针在最上方）

exact.en: Carburetor heat gauges must always be in green sector
exact.zh: 化油器温度计读书需保持在绿色区域

exact.en: Carburetor temperature gauge must indicate a temperature matching the OAT
exact.zh: 化油器温度计需显示需与外界大气温度相匹配

exact.en: From the "cold" position (fully pushed in), set the the carburetor heat lever to "Hot" (fully pulled back) and check that a decrease of 100 RPM ensues
exact.zh: 将汽化器的加热操纵杆从“冷”（完全推入）拉至“热”（拉至底端），应观察到发动机每分钟转速下降100

exact.en: Set carburetor heat as required depending on flying conditions
exact.zh: 根据飞行状况，按要求设置汽化器温度

exact.en: Carburetor lever must be set to “cold” position (fully pushed in).
exact.zh: 化油器操纵杆需拨至“冷”位置（完全推入）。

exact.en: Carburetor heat lever must be set on "Normal" (fully pushed)
exact.zh: 化油器加热操纵杆需推至“标准”（推至最远）

exact.en: Main Tank L.H., FUS. Tank or Main Tank R.H.
exact.zh: 左侧主油箱，机身油箱或右侧主油箱

exact.en: Standby power selector must be set to Auto
exact.zh: 备用电源转换开关需设为“自动”

exact.en: Move manually the aileron to check if the movement is free. Check also if the opposite aileron move
exact.zh: 手动移动副翼以检查是否可自由移动。还要检查相对的副翼是否活动
以可听见的方式检查操作

exact.en: Check collective lever's unrestricted free movement then set it fully down
exact.zh: 检查总距操纵杠杆的自由移动是否受限，然后将其完全放下。

exact.en: There must be no bends, dents, dings, cracking or blistering of exterior coatings, or other surface discrepancies
exact.zh: 外部涂层不得有弯曲、凹痕、弯折、开裂或起泡或其他表面差异

exact.en: Door must be closed and secured
Check drop of maximum 175 RPM on either magnetos and 50 RPM differential max between magnetos
exact.zh: 检查任一磁电机转速是否下降最高175转/分或磁电机之间是否有最大50转/分的转速差
检查是否为空或行李已固定

exact.en: Check extended and retracted position; check indication
exact.zh: 检查伸展和回缩位置；检查指示

exact.en: A cooling fan should be heard as the avionics master switch is on
exact.zh: 当航空电子设备主开关开启时，应听到冷却风扇的声音
检查定心弹簧是否损坏

exact.en: Check for condition and cleanliness of cover
exact.zh: 检查盖子的状况和清洁度

exact.en: Check for damage and secure attachment
exact.zh: 检查是否有损坏并固定配件

exact.en: Check for freeplay by moving the tip of the horizontal stabilizer up and downwards
exact.zh: 上下移动水平安定面的顶端，检查是否有空隙

exact.en: Check for leaks and loose connections
exact.zh: 检查是否有泄漏和连接松动

exact.en: Check for proper inflation and general condition (weather checks, tread depth and wear)
exact.zh: 检查充气是否适当和一般状况（天气、胎纹深度和磨损）

exact.en: Check for proper inflation and general condition (weather checks, tread depth and wear, etc.) of tire(s) and strut(s)
exact.zh: 检查轮胎和支柱的充气是否适当以及一般状况（天气、胎纹深度和磨损等）。
检查安全性，检查联动装置

exact.en: Check freedom of movement and security
exact.zh: 检查是否可自由移动和安全性

exact.en: Check fuel quantity in each tank
exact.zh: 检查每个油箱中的燃油量

exact.en: Check full extension then retraction of flaps
exact.zh: 检查完全伸展情况，然后收回襟翼

exact.en: Check and inspect wings to find any default on the airframe
exact.zh: 检查机翼，找出机体上的任何缺陷

exact.en: Check hinge bolts, move up and down, check for security
exact.zh: 检查铰链螺栓，上下移动，检查安全性

exact.en: Check indication and set dangerous height
exact.zh: 检查指示并设置危险高度

exact.en: Check indicator movement on the fuel flow gauge
exact.zh: 检查燃油流量计上的指示器移动情况

exact.en: Check no obstructions or foreign objects inside the inlet
exact.zh: 检查进气口内是否有障碍物或异物
检查轮胎是否已妥善充气
检查操纵杆是否可以无限制自由移动

exact.en: Check no chords showing on tire, inflated to 62 PSI, brake pads are free to move slightly
exact.zh: 检查轮胎上没有显示翼弦 ，充气至62PSI，刹车片可稍微自由移动
检查是否有松动的物件

exact.en: CHECK secure, no slop, servo arm moves opposite of aileron, and trim tab secure
exact.zh: 检查是否稳固，无滑动，伺服翼与副翼相对移动，配平片固定

exact.en: Check oil level not more than 2 quarts below “Full” mark. Cap secure.
exact.zh: 检查机油位，低于“满”标记不超过2夸脱。盖子 安全。

exact.en: Check outside that the wings are correctly spread and locked
exact.zh: 检查外部，确认机翼正确展开并锁定

exact.en: Carefully check that pitot tube is warm to touch within 30 seconds
exact.zh: 在30秒内仔细检查皮托管的触感是否温热

exact.en: Check quantity and ensure low fuel annunciators (l low fuel R) are Extinguished
exact.zh: 检查油量并确保燃油报警器（低燃油报警器）已熄灭

exact.en: Check the quantity of fuel on board
exact.zh: 在仪表板上确认燃料量

exact.en: Check for restrictions by dust or other foreign matter
exact.zh: 检查是否受到灰尘或其他异物的限制

exact.en: Check rpm drop 150 RPM on either magnetos or 50 RPM differential between magnetos
exact.zh: 检查任一磁电机转速是否下降150转/分或磁电机之间是否有50转/分的转速差

exact.en: Check, secure cap and oil door
exact.zh: 检查、固定盖子和机油门

exact.en: Check secure, should be no play in any direction
exact.zh: 检查是否稳固，在任何方向上都不应有游隙

exact.en: Check tailwheel lock by lifting plunger by hand
exact.zh: 用手抬起柱塞检查尾轮锁
检查自动驾驶仪是否断开

exact.en: Check that heading, rate-of-turn and sideslip displays change correctly during turns
exact.zh: 检查航向、转弯速率和侧滑显示在转弯期间是否正确变化

exact.en: Check that parking brake handle is pulled
exact.zh: 检查是否已拉动驻机制动器手柄

exact.en: Check that propeller area is clear of people and obstacles
exact.zh: 检查螺旋桨区域是否已没有人和障碍物

exact.en: Check that the dipstick is correctly pushed and the filler cap secure
exact.zh: 检查量油尺是否可以正确推动并且加油口盖是否牢固

exact.en: Check that the ignition key is in off position
exact.zh: 检查点火钥匙是否拨至关闭位置

exact.en: Check that the static pressure alternate source valve is in off position
exact.zh: 检查静压备用源阀已拨至关闭位置

exact.en: Check there is nothing around the aircraft
exact.zh: 检查飞机周围是否没有任何东西

exact.en: Check the elevator trim is on the take off position
exact.zh: 检查升降舵配平是否拨至“起飞”位置
检查是否有任何未固定的紧固件

exact.en: Check for proper inflation and general condition
exact.zh: 检查充气和一般状况是否适当

exact.en: Check that wingfold switch position matches actual wing position
exact.zh: 检查机翼折叠开关位置是否与机翼实际状态相匹配

exact.en: Choke lever must be fully pushed
Choke lever must be fully pulled
All circuit breakers must be pushed in
exact.zh: 需按下所有断路器开关
以220千米/小时的速度爬升
以250千米/小时的速度爬升
以300千米/小时的速度爬升

exact.en: Clock must be set to current time
exact.zh: 时钟必须设置为当前时间

exact.en: COMM 1 and COMM 2 must be turned off
Compartment blower switch must be set to Off
exact.zh: 机舱风机开关需设置为“关闭”

exact.en: Compartment blower switch must be set to On
exact.zh: 机舱风机开关需设置为“开启”

exact.en: Compasses must be slaved and checked
exact.zh: 罗盘需从动并得到校核

exact.en: Check that the compass works properly (should move during taxi)
exact.zh: 确认罗盘正常工作（滑行时会移动）

exact.en: Check that all listed instruments are functioning properly, set them if needed.
exact.zh: 检查所有列表的仪表是否正常运作。如有需要，则进行设置。

exact.en: When NH reaches 10%, set Condition lever 1 to the feather (FTR) position
exact.zh: 当引擎转速达到10%，将引擎状态杆1拨到顺桨（FTR）处

exact.en: When NH reaches 10%, set Condition lever 2 to the feather (FTR) position
exact.zh: 当引擎转速达到10%，将引擎状态杆2拨到顺桨（FTR）处

exact.en: Condition lever 1 must be set to AUTO
exact.zh: 引擎状态杆1需设置为“自动”

exact.en: Condition lever 2 must be set to AUTO
exact.zh: 引擎状态杆2需设置为“自动”

exact.en: Condition levers must be fully pulled
exact.zh: 燃油状况操纵柄必须完全拉下

exact.en: Condition levers must be fully pushed
exact.zh: 引擎状态操纵柄必须完全拉下

exact.en: Verify condition, security, freedom of movement and tab
exact.zh: 确认状况、安全、自由移动和标签

exact.en: Connect envelope to basket, then spread envelope out
exact.zh: 将囊体连接至吊篮，随后展开囊体
连接降落伞漏气孔与囊体

exact.en: Move primary flight controls to ensure that they function properly (unobstructed movements).
exact.zh: 移动主要飞行控制装置，以确保它们可以正常运行（无障碍移动）。

exact.en: Control stick must be pulled about 1/4 from neutral position
exact.zh: 操纵杆需从空档位置拉出约1/4

exact.en: Move flight controls to ensure correct functioning : push, pull, turn left and right
exact.zh: 移动操纵设备，通过推、拉，左转、右转确保工作正常

exact.en: Control stick must be in a neutral position
exact.zh: 驾驶杆应处于居中状态

exact.en: Let the engine on idle to cool down for 5 minutes
exact.zh: 让发动机怠速冷却5分钟

exact.en: Cotter key must be installed in hook point attach bolt
exact.zh: 必须在抓钩点连接螺栓上安装键销

exact.en: Cowl flap should be closed. If CHT is above 180°C open as required.
exact.zh: 应关闭整流罩鱼鳞板。如汽缸盖温度在180摄氏度以上，则按要求打开。

exact.en: Cowl flap must be fully open (lever fully pushed)
exact.zh: 整流罩鱼鳞板需完全打开（拉杆拉至最底）

exact.en: Turn on any other instrument : Avionics, radio, transponder, beacon light, position light; Landing light at night
exact.zh: 打开任何其他仪表：航空电子系统，无线电，应答机，探照灯，位置指示灯；夜晚时打开着陆灯
向后转动，随后向前转动

exact.en: Should be "ON" by default. If the fuel transfer status light starts to blink, the fuel transfer pump must be switched off.
exact.zh: 应默认处于“开启”状态。燃油输送状态指示灯开始闪烁时，应关闭燃油输送泵。

exact.en: Engine master switch must be set to "OFF" , and the engine completely stopped.
exact.zh: 需将发动机总开关拨至“关闭”，且发动机需完全关闭。

exact.en: Electrical power must be supplied to DC Bus 2
exact.zh: 需将电力供给直流母线2

exact.en: Depending on weather conditions, switch pitot heater on
exact.zh: 根据天气状况，打开空速管加热器

exact.en: Depress brake pedals and pull parking brake lever aft to apply parking brake
exact.zh: 踩下制动踏板并拉动后部驻车制动杆以启动驻车制动器
以4到5米每秒的速度下降
以800至1000英尺/分钟的速度下降
以每分钟500英尺的速度下降

exact.en: Set all De-ice system switches to OFF position.
exact.zh: 将所有除冰系统开关拨至“关闭”位置

exact.en: Adjust anti-ice system as required by current flight conditions.
exact.zh: 根据当前飞行条件调整防冰系统。

exact.en: De-icing must be switched on if necessary
Directional trim must be in a neutral position
exact.zh: 方向配平应处于居中状态

exact.en: Disconnect both the battery and alternator from the system
exact.zh: 断开电池和交流发电机与系统的连接
断开囊体与吊篮的连接
断开降落伞与囊体的连接
断开降落伞与囊体的连接
断开顶端与囊体的连接

exact.en: Documents must be on board and up to date
exact.zh: 文件必须随身携带并且保持更新至最新

exact.en: Doors must be closed and locked
Door warning light must be off
Door warning light must be on
Down for land, up for water
All indicators of the annunciator panel must be off
exact.zh: 确保信号器仪表盘上所有指示灯未亮起

exact.en: Place and hold in "TEST" position, and ensure all annunciators illuminate
exact.zh: 保持“测试”状态，在此状态下确保所有信号器点亮

exact.en: Elevator trim must be on "neutral" setting : ~4 on the trim indicator
exact.zh: 起飞时需将升降舵配平设置为“居中”，即配平指示器读数小于4

exact.en: Elevator trim must be on "neutral" setting for take-off (~4 on the trim indicator)
exact.zh: 起飞时需将升降舵配平设置为“居中”（配平指示器读数小于4）

exact.en: Flaps position must be fully "DOWN" (lever fully pulled up)
exact.zh: 襟翼状态需为完全“放下”（操纵杆拉至最高）

exact.en: Flap lever must be positioned on First notch for Take-Off
exact.zh: 襟翼操纵杆应处于第一格，以备起飞

exact.en: Flaps must be "UP" (lever fully pushed down)
exact.zh: 襟翼状态应为“立起”（操纵杆拉至最底）

exact.en: Flaps must be "UP" (lever fully pushed down) when reaching 300 ft
exact.zh: 高度到达300英尺时，襟翼状态应为“立起”（操纵杆拉至最底）

exact.en: Move flight controls to ensure correct functioning : push, pull, turn left and right, test rudders
exact.zh: 移动操纵设备，通过推、拉，左转、右转确保其工作正常；同时测试方向舵

exact.en: Check that fuel pressure is in green sector
exact.zh: 确保燃料压力处于绿色区

exact.en: Cut off mixture (mixture lever fully down)
exact.zh: 停止燃油混合（混合阀拉至最底）

exact.en: Mixture must be rich (mixture lever completely up)
exact.zh: 需达到浓混合比（将燃油混合阀拉到最高）
需将无线电总开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Transponder must be set to altitude mode (ALT)
exact.zh: 需将应答机设为高度(ALT)状态

exact.en: Transponder must be set to standby (SBY)
exact.zh: 需将应答机设为待机(SBY)状态

exact.en: Verify condition, check on the bottom of fuselage or left side of cargo pod
exact.zh: 确认条件，检查机身底部或货舱左侧

exact.en: Drain for at least 4 seconds to clear filter of possible water, check closed
exact.zh: 抽水至少 4 秒钟以抽取过滤器中的水，检查是否关闭

exact.en: Drain for at least 4 seconds to clear sump of possible water, check closed
exact.zh: 抽水至少 4 秒钟以抽取水坑中的水，检查是否关闭

exact.en: Drain little fuel and check there is no water inside
exact.zh: 抽取少量燃油，检查内部是否有水

exact.en: Engine Control Unit Swap must be set to "AUTOMATIC"
exact.zh: 需将发动机控制单元切换设为“自动”

exact.en: Lift up on trailing edge of flap to see that it is secure.
exact.zh: 抬起襟翼后缘，检查是否牢固。

exact.en: EGT gauge must indicate between 700°C and 770°C
exact.zh: 排气温度表盘需显示在700°C到770°C之间

exact.en: EGT must not go above 871°C after start
Check that exhaust gas temperature is below 650°C
exact.zh: 检查排气温度温度是否在650°C以下

exact.en: Monitor engine parameters on the EICAS display
exact.zh: 监控发动机指示和机组警告系统显示的发动机参数

exact.en: All electrical equipment must be switched OFF (anti-collision lights may remain ON)
exact.zh: 需关闭一切电子设备（防撞灯需保持开启）

exact.en: Set electrical equipment accordingly to the flight's requirements
exact.zh: 根据飞行要求合理设置电子设备

exact.en: Electrical switches must be set to Off except "Boost Pump" and "Battery"
exact.zh: 除“升压泵”和“电池”外的电力开关必须设为“关闭”

exact.en: Electrical switches must be set to Off except "Engine" and "Battery"
exact.zh: 除“发动机”和“电池”外的电力开关必须设为“关闭”

exact.en: Electrical switches must be set to Off except "ENG" and "Battery"
exact.zh: 除“发动机”和“电池”外的电力开关必须设为“关闭”

exact.en: Electrical switches must be set to Off except "Engine", "Battery" and "JPT Reg"
exact.zh: 除“发动机”、“电池”及“喷管温度调节器”外，其他电气开关必须设为“关闭”
需将燃料泵开关拨至“关闭”
需将燃料泵开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Electric master switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将电路总开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Electric master switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 需将电路总开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Electric master switch must be set to "START" temporarily
exact.zh: 需将电路总开关暂时拨至“开启”

exact.en: Electric master must be switched ON
Electrical panel must display no amber warning lights on
exact.zh: 电力面板不得显示琥珀色警示灯

exact.en: Elements must be in good condition
exact.zh: 元件必须处于良好状态

exact.en: Elements must be in good condition and their fixation must be secure
exact.zh: 元素必须处于良好状态并固定牢靠

exact.en: Elements must be in good condition and functional
exact.zh: 元素必须处于良好状态并能正常运作

exact.en: Elements must be in good condition and secure with no excessive free play
exact.zh: 组件必须保持良好状态并且牢固，无过度松动。

exact.en: Element must be in good condition
exact.zh: 元件必须处于良好状态

exact.en: Element must be in good condition and its fixation must be secure
exact.zh: 元素必须处于良好状态并固定牢靠

exact.en: Element must be in good condition and clean
exact.zh: 元件必须状况良好且洁净

exact.en: Element must be in good condition and functional
exact.zh: 元素必须处于良好状态并能正常运作

exact.en: Element must be in good condition and secured
exact.zh: 元素必须处于良好状态并固定牢靠

exact.en: Element must be locked, there must be no leak
exact.zh: 元件必须锁定，不能有漏洞

exact.en: Element must have no excessive free play
exact.zh: 元件不能有过多的自由活动空间

exact.en: Elevator and aileron trim position must be neutral
exact.zh: 升降舵以及副翼配平的位置应置中

exact.en: Elevator and aileron trim position must be confirmed
exact.zh: 需确认升降舵以及副翼配平的位置

exact.en: Set Elevator and Rudder set to Green Arc
exact.zh: 将升降舵和方向舵设置为绿色弧线

exact.en: Trim to adjust speed to 60 KIAS
Trim to adjust speed to 63 KIAS
Trim to adjust speed to 65 KIAS
Elevator trim must be set neutral
Elevator trim must be on "neutral" setting
exact.zh: 需将升降舵配平设置为“居中”

exact.en: Elevator trim must be on "neutral" setting for take-off
exact.zh: 起飞时需将升降舵配平设置为“居中”

exact.en: Set the elevator trim for cruise
exact.zh: 设置升降舵配平，准备巡航

exact.en: Set the elevator trim for descent
exact.zh: 设置升降舵配平，准备下降

exact.en: Emergency exit lights must be switched off
Emergency fuel valve must be set on "Normal" position
exact.zh: 需将应急燃油阀设为“普通”

exact.en: Pull the starter switches and set the fuel control switches to "RUN" for the other engines
exact.zh: 拉动发动杆，并将燃油控制开关设置为“运行”以发动其余发动机

exact.en: Ensure the aircraft's RPM has stabilized before continuing
exact.zh: 确保航空器的发动机转速稳定，然后再进行下一步

exact.en: Let the engines cool down on idle for 5 minutes
exact.zh: 让发动机怠速冷却5分钟

exact.en: Engines RPM must be synchronized at the required RPM
exact.zh: 发动机转速需在所需转速基础上同步

exact.en: Set the engine 4 fuel control switch to the RUN position
exact.zh: 将4号发动机燃油控制开关设置为“运行”

exact.en: Engine 4 Start switch must be pulled to launch the starting procedure
exact.zh: 4号发动机启动开关需拉动才能开启启动程序

exact.en: Engine bleed switches must be set to ON
exact.zh: 发动机排气开关必须拨至“开启”

exact.en: Engine should drop 40-80 RPM when switching magneto from "BOTH" to either "LEFT" or "RIGHT"
exact.zh: 当磁电机从“两者都”切换到“左”或“右”时，发动机应下降40-80转/分

exact.en: Check that everything is normal on engine gauges
exact.zh: 确认发动机仪表一切正常

exact.en: Check that all gauges are within correct values : oil pressure, oil temperature, vacuum, battery, fuel quantity...
exact.zh: 确认一切仪表读数正常，包括油压、油温、真空度、电池电量，以及燃料余量……

exact.en: Pull throttle completely and ensure that the engine idles below 1000 RPM
exact.zh: 彻底关闭油门，确保发动机怠速转速降至1000转/分钟以下

exact.en: Pull throttle completely and check that the engine idles between 600-650 RPM
exact.zh: 彻底关闭油门，确保发动机怠速转速为600到650转/分钟
检查是否处于每分钟1400转（在海平面时）

exact.en: Pull down throttle completely and check that the engine idles around 1600 RPM
exact.zh: 彻底拉下油门杆，确保发动机怠速转速为每分钟1600转左右

exact.en: Pull throttle completely and check that the engine idles around 2000 RPM (at sea level)
exact.zh: 彻底拉动油门，检查发动机怠速转速是否为每分钟2000转左右（在海平面时）

exact.en: Pull down throttle completely and check that the engine idles around 890 RPM
exact.zh: 彻底关闭油门，确保发动机怠速转速为890转/分钟左右

exact.en: Check parameters and verify no red Xs (warnings) are displayed through engine page indicators
exact.zh: 查看各项参数，确保引擎指示灯没有红色X字（警告）显示

exact.en: Engine indicator emergency must be off
exact.zh: 发动机的紧急状况指示器需处于关闭状态

exact.en: Wait for stabilized idle and abort start if no ITT rise within 20 seconds, no oil pressure rise by 30% N2, ITT will exceed red line, or stabilized idle is not achieved within 50 seconds of initial ITT rise
exact.zh: 如果20秒内涡轮级间温度没有上升，油压没有上升30%高压转子转速，涡轮级间温度将超过红线，或在初始涡轮级间温度上升50秒内未实现稳定怠速，等待稳定怠速及中断启动

exact.en: Engine instruments must indicate normal values
exact.zh: 发动机仪表必须显示正常值

exact.en: Engine master 1 must be switched ON
Engine master 2 must be switched ON
Both master engine switches must be set to OFF
exact.zh: 两台主发动机开关均需设为“关闭”

exact.en: Engine master must be switched ON
exact.zh: 引擎总开关须拨至“开启”

exact.en: Left engine master must be switched ON
exact.zh: 左发动机总开关应开启

exact.en: Right engine master must be switched ON
exact.zh: 右引擎总开关须拨至“打开”位置

exact.en: Engine master switch must be on "ON" position. Wait until the annunciator panel stops displaying the "GLOW" indicator
exact.zh: 需将发动机总开关拨至“开启”。此后等待信号器仪表盘上的“预热”信息熄灭

exact.en: Engine master switches must be set to Off; then, safety guards must be closed
exact.zh: 发动机主开关需拨至“关闭”；随后需关闭安保

exact.en: Engine master switches must be set to On; then, safety guards must be closed
exact.zh: 发动机主开关需拨至“开启”；随后需关闭安保

exact.en: Check that the engine rises to 2240-2300 RPM while at full throttle
exact.zh: 确保油门开到最大时发动机转速达到2240到2300每分钟

exact.en: Engine mode switch must be set to IGN START
exact.zh: 发动机模式开关必须设为“开始点火”(IGN START)

exact.en: Engine mode switch must be set to NORM
exact.zh: 发动机模式开关必须设为“正常”(NORM)

exact.en: Engine RPM must drop between 450-600 RPM
exact.zh: 发动机转速需降至450-600转/分之间

exact.en: Engine RPM must stabilize at idle power
exact.zh: 发动机转速必须稳定在怠速功率上

exact.en: Set left engine's run/stop button to RUN
exact.zh: 将左发动机的“运行/停止”按钮设为“运行”

exact.en: Set right engine's run/stop button to RUN
exact.zh: 将右发动机的“运行/停止”按钮设为“运行”

exact.en: "Engine Start" button must be depressed for 2 seconds
exact.zh: “发动机启动”按钮必须按住2秒

exact.en: "Engine" switch must be set to Off
"Engine" switch must be set to On; within 5 seconds "Don't Start" and "Inv 36 V Fail" light must be off
exact.zh: “发动机”开关需拨至“开启”；5秒内“请勿发动”和“36伏转换器故障”灯需未亮起

exact.en: "Engine" switch must be set to On; within 5 seconds "Don't Start" light must be off
exact.zh: “发动机”开关需拨至“开启”；5秒内“请勿发动”灯需未亮起

exact.en: "ENG Crank" switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 必须将“ENG Crank”（发动机曲柄）开关拨至“OFF”（关）

exact.en: "Eng Start" button must be depressed for 2 seconds, then released
exact.zh: “启动发动机”按钮需按住2秒，然后再释放

exact.en: Set the engine start selector to START A and B
exact.zh: 将发动机启动选择器设置为启动A和B

exact.en: When engine parameters are stabilized, revert engine start selector to "OFF AND START ABORT"
exact.zh: 当发动机参数稳定下来时，将发动机启动选择器恢复为“关闭并中止启动”

exact.en: "ENG" switch must be set to Off
exact.zh: 发动机开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: "ENG" switch must be set to On; within 5 seconds "Do Not Start" and "Inv 36 V Fail" light must be off
exact.zh: 发动机开关需拨至“开启”；5秒内“请勿发动”和“36伏转换器故障”灯需未亮起

exact.en: Ensure all preflight inspection steps are complete
exact.zh: 确保所有飞行前检查步骤都已完成

exact.en: Ensure that witness marks on the float hatches are aligned
exact.zh: 确保浮动舱盖上的参考点对齐

exact.en: Envelope must be in good condition
exact.zh: 囊体必须处于良好状态

exact.en: Envelope temperature must never exceed maximum permissible value
exact.zh: 囊体温度不得超过最大范围值

exact.en: Exterior lights master switch must be forward
exact.zh: 外部灯光主开关必须拨至前方

exact.en: External power switch must be set to OFF
exact.zh: 外部电源开关需拨至关闭

exact.en: If the EXT PWR button displays AVAIL, set it to ON
exact.zh: 若外部电源按钮显示可用，则将其调至开启

exact.en: EXT lights switch must be turned to OFF position.
exact.zh: 外部灯开关须拨至“关闭”位置。

exact.en: Ensure that the EXT PWR button displays AVAIL
exact.zh: 确保外电源按钮显示“可用”

exact.en: Feet must be ready to brake
Field altitude and cabin pressure must match
exact.zh: 场地高度和客舱压力需匹配

exact.en: Indicated Air Speed should be around 50-60 kias (around 63 mph) with flaps fully down on final approach
exact.zh: 最终进近、襟翼完全放下时，空速表读数应处于50到60节之间（约63英里/小时）

exact.en: Air speed should be around 60-70 kias with flaps fully down on final approach
exact.zh: 最终进近、襟翼完全放下时，空速表读数应处于60到70节之间

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed at 60-75 knots during approach
exact.zh: 进近时，保持空速表读数为60到75节

exact.en: Indicated air speed should be around 65 mph with flaps fully down on final approach
exact.zh: 最终进近、襟翼完全放下时，空速表读数应处于65英里/小时左右

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed at 71 knots during final approach
exact.zh: 最终进近时，保持空速表读数为71节

exact.en: Indicated Air Speed should be around 65 mph with flaps fully down on final approach
exact.zh: 最终进近、襟翼完全放下时，空速表读数应处于65英里/小时左右
以每小时260千米的速度进行最终进近

exact.en: Check that fire extinguisher is in the cockpit and in usable condition
exact.zh: 检查灭火器是否在驾驶舱内且处于可用状态

exact.en: First mark on left wing flap indicator
exact.zh: 左翼襟翼指示器上的第一个标记

exact.en: Flaps lever must be set to "UP" position
exact.zh: 旋翼制动杆须拨至“向上”位置
将襟翼调整至准备起飞的状态

exact.en: Adjust flaps as air speed decreases during descent
exact.zh: 下降时空速也会随之降低，根据情况调整襟翼
将襟翼调整至所需位置

exact.en: Flaps should be set at 0°-10° below 110 KIAS, and 10°-30° below 85 KIAS
exact.zh: 空速表读数低于110节时，襟翼角度应设置在0°到10°之间，低于85节时则应设置在10°到30°之间

exact.en: Flaps position must be set for landing. Normal Landing : Any flaps setting within the flap airspeed limit. Short field landing : Full flaps recommended
exact.zh: 需调整襟翼，以备着陆。普通着陆：只要不超出襟翼的空速极限，可采取任意设置。短跑道着陆：推荐完全展开襟翼

exact.en: Adjust flaps according to aircraft standard procedure.
exact.zh: 根据飞机标准程序调整襟翼。

exact.en: Flaps position must be set for landing. Normal Landing : any flaps setting within the flap airspeed limit. Short field landing : full flaps recommended (LDG)
exact.zh: 需调整襟翼，以备着陆。普通着陆：只要不超出襟翼的空速极限，可采取任意设置。短跑道着陆：推荐完全展开襟翼（着陆）

exact.en: Flaps can be lowered to 10° for steeper approach
exact.zh: 对于更险峻的进近，襟翼可降至10°

exact.en: Set flaps to all positions and check indicators and flaps function correctly, then set flaps to "TAKE-OFF"
exact.zh: 设置各处襟翼，并确保指示灯与各襟翼正常工作，随后将襟翼状态设为“起飞”

exact.en: Check flaps movement Up and Down, no blocking
exact.zh: 检查襟翼是否可自如地上下移动

exact.en: Fully extend and retract flaps, make sure that their deployment is unobstructed
exact.zh: 完全展开并收起襟翼，确保展开时毫无障碍

exact.en: Adjust the flaps according to current takeoff requirements
exact.zh: 根据当前的起飞要求调整襟翼
襟翼状态需为完全“放下”

exact.en: Flaps must be fully down when the plane is in the wind, at least 400 feet high and between 165 mph and 100 mph
exact.zh: 如飞机高度于至少400英尺，速度在165英里每小时到100英里每小时之间，处于风中飞行时，襟翼需完全放下

exact.en: Flaps electrical and mechanical indicator must be checked
exact.zh: 需检查襟翼电力及机械倾角的指示器

exact.en: Flaps extend for landing, according to current landing conditions.
exact.zh: 根据当前着陆条件展开襟翼。

exact.en: Flap lever must be positioned on First notch
exact.zh: 襟翼操纵杆应处于第一档

exact.en: Flaps full, selector in the upper position
exact.zh: 襟翼全展开，选择器拨至“向上”位置

exact.en: Set flaps lever to LDG position.
exact.zh: 设置襟翼操纵杆至“着陆”位置。

exact.en: Flaps must be fully retracted after reaching 300ft above surface.
exact.zh: 襟翼在升空至300英尺后必须完全收回。

exact.en: Flap lever must be positioned on second notch
exact.zh: 襟翼操纵杆应处于第二档

exact.en: Flaps lever must be set to Take-Off position
exact.zh: 旋翼制动杆须拨至“起飞”位置

exact.en: Flaps must be "UP" when reaching 300 ft
exact.zh: 高度到达300英尺时，襟翼状态应为“立起”

exact.en: Flap / Trim selector must be fully pulled up (flaps and trim paired)
exact.zh: 襟翼/配平的转换开关需完全拉起（襟翼与配平匹配）

exact.en: Flap / Trim selector must be fully pushed down (trim only)
exact.zh: 襟翼/配平的转换开关需完全拉下（仅配平）

exact.en: Flare gently with cyclic to reduce rate-of-descent and forward speed
exact.zh: 借助周期变距杆轻轻拉平，以调低下降速率和前进速度

exact.en: Beacon light must be switched on, and navigation light must be switched on at night
exact.zh: 需开启信标灯，夜间需开启导航灯

exact.en: Move flight controls to check correct functioning (free movement without obstruction): push, pull, turn left, and turn right.
exact.zh: 移动飞行操纵设备，检查其是否正常运作（移动是否自如）：推、拉，左转、右转。

exact.en: Move flight controls to check correct function (unrestricted free movement): push, pull, turn left and right
exact.zh: 移动飞行操纵设备，检查其是否正常运作（移动是否自如）：推、拉，左转、右转

exact.en: Check that you can override autopilot by directly moving the yoke
exact.zh: 确保你可以通过直接移动控制杆覆盖自动驾驶操作

exact.en: Flight director must be turned OFF
While taxiing, check that instrumentations and avionics display correct information and work properly (compass, airspeed indicator, attitude indicator...)
exact.zh: 滑行时，确保各类仪表与航空电子设备（罗盘、空速表、姿态指示器……）信息显示无误、工作正常
巡航中随时注意仪表读数
下降时随时注意仪表读数

exact.en: Ensure all necessary flight instruments are set correctly
exact.zh: 确保所有飞行仪表设置正确

exact.en: Ensure the flight management system, GPS and flight plan are set as desired for the planned flight
exact.zh: 按照此次飞行的目标，正确设置飞行管理系统、全球定位系统与飞行计划

exact.en: Monitor the status and progression of the flight
exact.zh: 全程注意飞行的状态与进度

exact.en: For aircraft having the manual tail wheel lock system, lever must be in locked position
exact.zh: 对于具有手动尾轮锁定系统的飞机，操纵杆必须处于“锁定”位置

exact.en: Check for condition, restrictions, and debris
exact.zh: 检查状态、限制和异物干扰
实现所需的性能或经济性

exact.en: From hover, reduce collective pitch very gradually until initial touch-down is made
exact.zh: 从悬停开始到初步着陆，逐渐减小总桨距

exact.en: From idle to 0% RPM within 25 seconds
Fuel boost switch must be set to NORM
exact.zh: 燃油增压泵开关需拨至“标准”

exact.en: Fuel boost pump switch must be set to OFF
exact.zh: 燃油增压泵开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Fuel boost switch must be set to ON
exact.zh: 燃油增压泵开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: Turn on the fuel boost pump, then turn it off when fuel flow peaks
exact.zh: 开启燃油提升泵，然后在燃油流量达到峰值时将其关闭

exact.en: Fuel mixture must be set for low idle (halfway up)
exact.zh: 燃料混合需设为低怠速（推至一半）

exact.en: Engine condition lever must be set to LOW IDLE position
exact.zh: 发动机状态杆必须拨至“低怠速”位置

exact.en: Drain the fuel and check its quality
Check and secure fuel filler cap
exact.zh: 检查并固定燃油注油口盖

exact.en: Fuel flow must be between 700 and 800 pounds per hour
exact.zh: 燃油流量须在每小时700到800磅之间

exact.en: Check there is no imbalance between fuel tanks.
exact.zh: 检查燃油箱之间是否有不平衡。

exact.en: Check that the gauges display enough fuel for the planned flight according to the planned flight performance
exact.zh: 根据计划的飞行性能，检查仪表是否显示燃料足够计划航程使用

exact.en: Check that the quantity of fuel on board is sufficient for planned flight
exact.zh: 检查机上燃油量是否足以满足计划航程需求

exact.en: Check the quantity of fuel on the left tank
Check the quantity of fuel on the right tank
Fuel pressure gauge must indicate 0.28 kg/cm2 minimum
exact.zh: 燃油压力表需指示最低0.28kg/cm2

exact.en: Fuel pressure gauge must indicate 4 psi minimum
exact.zh: 燃油压力表需指示最低4磅/平方英寸

exact.en: Cylinder head temperature gauge must indicate 232°C maximum
exact.zh: 气缸盖温度表需指示最高232°C

exact.en: Check that fuel pressure is between 8 and 12 psi
exact.zh: 检查燃油压力是否在8到12磅/平方英寸之间

exact.en: Check that fuel pressure is in the green (within recommended parameters)
exact.zh: 检查油压是否在绿色（推荐参数）范围内

exact.en: Engine 1 fuel pump must be set to ON. Ensure the corresponding LP VALVE is also open.
exact.zh: 1号发动机的燃油泵需设置为“开启”。确保对应的低压活门也处于开启状态。

exact.en: Engine 2 fuel pump must be set to ON. Ensure the corresponding LP VALVE is also open.
exact.zh: 2号发动机的燃油泵需设置为“开启”。确保对应的低压活门也处于开启状态。
所有燃油泵需处于“开启”状态

exact.en: Fuel Pump must be set to On position
exact.zh: 燃油泵须拨至“启动”位置

exact.en: Set fuel pump switch to OFF
exact.zh: 将燃油泵开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Fuel pump switch must be set to ON and then switched OFF after fuel peak.
exact.zh: 需将燃油泵开关拨至“开启”，然后在燃油峰值后关闭。

exact.en: Hold Fuel Pump switch on PRIME position for 2 seconds, then set to BOOST
exact.zh: 握住燃油泵开关至“初始”位置保持2秒，然后设置为“冲压”

exact.en: Fuel quantity must be sufficient for planned flight
exact.zh: 燃油量必须足以满足计划航程

exact.en: Both fuel selectors must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 两台燃料选择器均需设为“开启”

exact.en: Fuel selectors must be set to OFF position.
exact.zh: 燃油选择器必须拨至“关闭”位置。

exact.en: Fuel selector must be set on the ACRO and center tanks position
exact.zh: 燃油选择器需设置在定点和中央油箱位置

exact.en: Both fuel selectors must be set to "CROSSFEED"
exact.zh: 两台燃料选择器均需设为“交叉输送”

exact.en: The fuel crossfeed function can be tested on both engines at the same time. Function has to be tested for 30 seconds maximum
exact.zh: 交输供油功能可以同时在两台发动机上测试。功能必须测试最多30秒

exact.en: Main fuel tank must be selected (ON position)
exact.zh: 主燃油箱必须选定（“开启”位置）

exact.en: Fuel selector must be set on "Main Tank L.H."
exact.zh: 燃油选择器需设置在“左侧主油箱”上

exact.en: Fuel selector must be set on "Main Tank L.H." or "FUS. Tank"
exact.zh: 燃油选择器需设置在“左侧主油箱”或“机身油箱”上

exact.en: Fuel selector must be set either on "Main Tank L.H." or "Main Tank R.H."
exact.zh: 燃油选择器需设置在“左侧主油箱”或“右侧主油箱”上

exact.en: Fuel selector must be set either on "Main Tank L.H.", "FUS. Tank" or "Main Tank R.H."
exact.zh: 燃油选择器需设置在“左侧主油箱”、“机身油箱”或“右侧主油箱”上

exact.en: Both fuel selectors must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 两台燃料选择器均需设为“关闭”

exact.en: Fuel shutoff valve must be closed
Fuel shutoff valve must be open
Fuel shutoff valve must be open (fully pushed in)
exact.zh: 需打开燃料切断阀（推至最大）

exact.en: Fuel tank selector lever must be on "BOTH" position
exact.zh: 需将油箱选择器开关拨至”双侧“位置

exact.en: Fuel tank selector must be set on "Alle" (All)
exact.zh: 燃油箱选择器需设置在“Alle”（即“所有”）上

exact.en: Fuel tank selector switch must be on "BOTH" position
exact.zh: 需将油箱选择器开关拨至“双侧”位置

exact.en: Fuel tank selector switch must be on LEFT position
Fuel tank selector switch must be on LEFT or RIGHT position
exact.zh: 油箱选择器应拨至“左侧”或“右侧”

exact.en: Fuel tank selector switch must be on L or R position
exact.zh: 油箱选择器需拨至“左”或“右”位置

exact.en: Fuel tank selector switch must be on RESERVE position
exact.zh: 燃油箱选择器开关需设置在“预留”位置

exact.en: Fuel tank selector switch must be on RIGHT position
exact.zh: 燃油箱选择器开关需设置为“右”

exact.en: Fuel tank selector switch must be on "OUVERT" position
exact.zh: 需将油箱选择器开关拨至“OUVERT”位置（未指定）

exact.en: Fuel transfer should be activated when needed to avoid fuel imbalanced between tanks (no more than 9 gal)
exact.zh: 当左右油箱出现不平衡问题时，需启动燃油输送泵（燃油存量之差不应超过9加仑）

exact.en: Fuel vent tube must be clear of obstruction
exact.zh: 燃油排气管必须畅通无阻

exact.en: Fuel wobble pump must be open (handle fully down)
exact.zh: 燃油手摇泵需处于开启状态（操纵杆完全拉下）

exact.en: Fuel wobble pump must be closed (handle fully up)
exact.zh: 燃油手摇泵需处于关闭状态（操纵杆完全拉上）
选择燃料量最多的油箱
仪表需显示3000磅/平方英寸

exact.en: Gear leg must be in good condition
exact.zh: 起落架支柱必须状态良好

exact.en: Check that the landing gear selector is down
exact.zh: 确保起落架选择器已设为放下

exact.en: Generator/Battery Selector must be set to GEN
exact.zh: 发电机/电池选择器需调整至“发电机”上

exact.en: "Generator Emergency" switch must be set to Off
exact.zh: “备用发电机”开关需设置为“关闭”

exact.en: "Generator Emergency" switch must be set to On
exact.zh: “备用发电机”开关需设置为“开启”

exact.en: Generator switch must be set to ON, and the FAULT light displayed
exact.zh: 发电机开关必须拨至“开启”(ON)，此时故障灯亮起

exact.en: "Generator Main" switch must be set to On
exact.zh: “主发电机”开关需设置为“开启”

exact.en: Generator switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将发电机开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Generator/battery selectors must be set on BAT
exact.zh: 发电机/电池选择器需调整至“电池”上

exact.en: Generator switches must be set to ON
exact.zh: 发电机开关需设置为“开启”

exact.en: Check there is no impact, dirt, or damages
exact.zh: 检查是否有撞击、污垢或损坏

exact.en: Check there is no impact, dirt, or damages. Control surfaces must move smoothly.
exact.zh: 检查是否有撞击，污垢或损坏。控制面必须平稳移动。

exact.en: Handle must be forward; light must be off
exact.zh: 操纵杆必须处于向前状态；提示灯需处于关闭状态

exact.en: Check that the heading indicator is working properly (should move during taxi)
exact.zh: 确认航向指示器正常工作（滑行时会移动）

exact.en: Align heading indicator with the compass
exact.zh: 参照罗盘校准航向指示器

exact.en: Heat air with burners, until basket lifts up
exact.zh: 用燃烧器加热空气，直到篮子升起

exact.en: Heat air with burners, until envelope stands upright
exact.zh: 用燃烧器加热空气，直到气囊直立

exact.en: Measure how long you've been using the aircraft for
exact.zh: 计算一下你使用这架航空器的时间

exact.en: Hook must be retracted and hook caution light must be off
exact.zh: 须收回阻拦钩，且阻拦钩警告灯应处于关闭状态

exact.en: Hydraulic pressure gauge must indicate around 1000 PSI
exact.zh: 液压压力表需指示在1000磅/平方英寸左右

exact.en: Hydraulic pressure gauge must indicate between 135 and 150 kp/cm²
exact.zh: 液压压力表需指示在135至150kp/cm²之间

exact.en: Hydraulic pressure gauge must indicate 655 PSI minimum
exact.zh: 液压压力表需指示最低655磅/平方英寸
液压泵需处于“开启”状态

exact.en: When Indicated Air Speed > 115 knots, Set Flaps position to "UP"
exact.zh: 当空速表读数达到>115节时，将襟翼状态调整为“竖起”

exact.en: When Indicated Air Speed > 140 Km/H, retract Flaps
exact.zh: 当空速表指示>140千米/小时，收起襟翼

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed above 84 knots with flaps on "LDG" during final approach
exact.zh: 在最终进近阶段，保持空速表读数高于84节，且襟翼处于“着陆”状态

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed above 88 knots with flaps on "T/O" during approach
exact.zh: 在进近阶段，保持空速表读数高于88节，且襟翼处于“起飞”状态

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed above 89 knots with flaps on "LDG" during final approach
exact.zh: 在最终进近阶段，保持空速表读数高于89节，且襟翼处于“着陆”状态

exact.en: Maintain Indicated Air Speed above 91 knots with flaps on "T/O" during approach
exact.zh: 在进近阶段，保持空速表读数高于91节，且襟翼处于“起飞”状态

exact.en: Pull down power lever completely and check that the engine idles around 710 RPM
exact.zh: 将发动机操纵杆拉回底部，确保发动机怠速转速为710转/分钟左右

exact.en: If minimum oil pressure is not indicated within 30 seconds, shut off the engine and determine trouble
exact.zh: 如果30秒内未显示最小油压，请关闭发动机并找出问题根源

exact.en: If use of reverse thrust is desired, pull up power lever grip to unlock reverse range, then pull power lever slowly and smoothly aft
exact.zh: 如果需要使用反向推力，请拉起动力杆手柄以解锁反向范围，然后缓慢平稳地向后拉动动力杆

exact.en: Ignite burners, control, then light off
exact.zh: 点燃燃烧器，控制，然后关闭灯光

exact.en: Ignition switch must be set to "AUTO" or "ON"
exact.zh: 需将点火开关拨至“自动”或“开启”

exact.en: Ignition delay must be set on "Früh" (Early)
Ignition delay is usually set on "Spät" (Late) for engine start
exact.zh: 点火延迟通常调整至“Spét（晚）”以启动发动机
需将点火器设置为“普通”状态
需将点火器开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Ignition and start switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 必须将点火启动开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Ignition and start switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 必须将点火启动开关拨至“开启”
需将点火器设置为“启动”状态

exact.en: Ignition switches must be set to "ON"
Set Ignition Switch in center position
exact.zh: 将点火开关拨至中心位置
指示器需处于“关闭”状态
指示器需处于“开启”状态
将惯性分离器设为“标准”

exact.en: Inflate envelope as full as possible with cold air by using an inflation fan
exact.zh: 使用鼓风机用冷空气尽可能使气囊充气

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 110 mph during initial climb
exact.zh: 在初始爬升阶段中保持空速为110英里/小时

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 130 Km/H (55kt) during initial climb
exact.zh: 起始爬升阶段保持空速为130千米/小时（55节）

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 64 kts during initial climb
exact.zh: 在初始爬升阶段，保持空速为64节

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed of 66kt during initial climb
exact.zh: 起始爬升阶段保持空速为66节

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed above 83kt during initial climb
exact.zh: 起始爬升阶段保持空速高于83节

exact.en: Maintain an airspeed above 86kt during initial climb
exact.zh: 起始爬升阶段保持空速高于86节

exact.en: Injection shut-off valve must be Off
exact.zh: 喷射器断流阀需处于“关闭”状态

exact.en: Injection shut-off valve must be On
exact.zh: 喷射器断流阀需处于“开启”状态

exact.en: Inlet must be cleared of any foreign objects or obstruction
exact.zh: 必须清除进气口处的异物或障碍物

exact.en: Inlet oil temperature gauge must indicate between 40°C and 93°C
exact.zh: 进油温度计需指示在40°C到93°C之间

exact.en: Start from top down, inspect hinge bolts, move from stop to stop to check security, inspect rudder cables and connections
exact.zh: 从上到下，检查铰链螺栓，依次检查安全性，检查方向舵 和连接

exact.en: Instruments and gauges must work properly
exact.zh: 仪器和仪表必须正常工作

exact.en: If ITT exceeds those values at any point, abort engine start
exact.zh: 一旦涡轮间温度超过这些数值，立刻中断发动机启动

exact.en: JPT Reg switch must be set to Off
exact.zh: “喷管温度调节器”开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: JPT-reg test switch must be set to position I., J.P.T. 700°C light must be illuminating; JPT-reg test switch must be set to position II., J.P.T. 700°C light must be illuminating
exact.zh: 喷管温度调节器试验开关需设置为位置I.，喷管温度700°C的灯需亮起；喷管温度调节器试验开关需设置为位置II.，喷管温度700°C的灯需亮起

exact.en: Turn and maintain the key to the right to start
exact.zh: 将钥匙向右转动并保持，即可起动

exact.en: Knob must be turned fully counter-clockwise
exact.zh: 旋钮必须按逆时针充分旋转

exact.en: Landing lights and taxi lights must be "OFF"
exact.zh: 着陆灯与滑行灯需“关闭”

exact.en: Landing lights and taxi lights must be "ON"
exact.zh: 着陆灯与滑行灯需设为“打开”

exact.en: Landing area must be large enough without unexpected obstacles in the landing direction
exact.zh: 着陆区域必须足够宽阔，且着陆方向上没有障碍物

exact.en: When at a safe altitude, apply brakes, and set landing lever on "UP" position. Monitor that the "unsafe" light goes off after a few seconds.
exact.zh: 降至安全高度时刹车，并将起落架控制杆置于“收起”位置。几秒钟后可以看到“不安全”指示灯亮起。

exact.en: Landing gear must be down correctly (check the 3 green indicators)
exact.zh: 需正确放下起落架（确保3盏绿色指示灯亮起）

exact.en: When below 170 mph, landing gears must be down
exact.zh: 当速度低于每小时170英里时，需放下起落架

exact.en: Landing gear mechanical indicator must be checked
exact.zh: 需检查起落架机械指示器

exact.en: Landing gear must be up correctly (check the 3 green indicators)
exact.zh: 需正确收起起落架（确保3个绿色指示灯亮起）

exact.en: Set landing lights switch to OFF position.
exact.zh: 将着陆灯开关拨至”关闭“位置。
需将着陆灯开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Landing lights must be set as required
Landing light on for take off
Landing light must be set as required
Nose should be lowered gently until the front landing gear touches the ground
exact.zh: 前起落架触地后，再慢慢压低机头

exact.en: Tail should be lowered gently until the rear landing gear touches the ground
exact.zh: 后起落架触地后，再慢慢压低尾翼

exact.en: Deploy or retract the skis depending on the landing area's condition.
exact.zh: 根据着陆区的情况，放下或收回雪橇板。

exact.en: Landing and taxi lights must be set as required
exact.zh: 需按要求设置着陆灯和滑行灯

exact.en: Land the aircraft on the rear wheels first
Left engine starter button must be set to ON
exact.zh: 左发动机启动按钮需拨至“开启”

exact.en: Push left engine starter button until combustion is achieved
exact.zh: 按下左侧发动机启动器按钮直至发动机开始燃烧

exact.en: Repeat previous steps to start the left engine
exact.zh: 重复之前的步骤以启动左发动机

exact.en: Set Left Pitot heater switches to "OFF"
exact.zh: 将左空速管加温器开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Left throttle must be set to "Off" first, then the right one
exact.zh: 须先将左油门设为“Off”，然后对右油门做同样设置

exact.en: Let the aircraft smoothly take off
Let the engine cool down for 2 minutes
Set lever FULL AFT to Feather Stop (F)
exact.zh: 将操纵杆从全向后拨至顺桨停止(F)

exact.en: Set lever FULL AFT to Fuel Cut-Off
exact.zh: 将操纵杆从全向后拨至燃油切断

exact.en: Start takeoff once airspeed reaches 100 Km/H (54kt)
exact.zh: 空速到达100千米/小时（54节）时开始起飞

exact.en: Turn the lights on or off depending on the airport and exterior conditions
exact.zh: 根据机场和外部条件打开或关闭灯光

exact.en: Lights must be illuminating and brightness adjusted
exact.zh: 灯光需处于照明状态并进行亮度调整

exact.en: Lights must be off when reaching 1000 ft
exact.zh: 高度到达1000英尺时，应关闭灯光

exact.en: When ITT starts rising, ensure combustion is achieved within 10s
exact.zh: 当涡轮级间温度开始上升时，确保在10s内发动机燃着

exact.en: Load indication should stabilize at 90-100% while at full throttle
exact.zh: 油门开到最大时，负载指示器应稳定在90%到100%

exact.en: Disengage lower arm switch to off position
Engage lower arm switch to Armed position
Check that the "Low fuel" annunciators messages are not displayed
exact.zh: 可确认无“低燃油”指示信息显示

exact.en: Check that the "Low vacuum" annunciator messages is displayed
exact.zh: 确认“低真空度”指示信息显示

exact.en: Check that the "Low volt" annunciator message is not displayed
exact.zh: 确认无“低电压”指示信息显示

exact.en: Check that the "Low volt" annunciator message is displayed
exact.zh: 确认“低电压”指示信息显示

exact.en: Magnetos switches must be set to Off
exact.zh: 磁电机开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Engine should drop ~100 RPM when switching magneto from "BOTH" to either "LEFT" or "RIGHT"
exact.zh: 将磁电机从“双侧”切换至“左”或“右”时，发动机转速应当降低~100转/分

exact.en: Engine should drop ~150 RPM when switching magneto from "BOTH" to either "LEFT" or "RIGHT"
exact.zh: 将磁电机从“双侧”切换至“左”或“右”时，发动机转速应当降低~150转/分

exact.en: When switching magneto between "LEFT" and "RIGHT" positions, difference in engine RPM must not exceed 40 RPM
exact.zh: 将磁电机在“左”“右”状态来回切换时，发动机的每分钟转速差不应当超出40

exact.en: When switching magneto between "LEFT" and "RIGHT" positions, difference in engine RPM must not exceed 50 RPM
exact.zh: 将磁电机在“左”“右”状态来回切换时，发动机的每分钟转速差不应当超出50

exact.en: Magnetos switch must be set to "BOTH"
exact.zh: 磁电机开关需拨至“双侧”

exact.en: Set Magneto to OFF position, then back to BOTH position
exact.zh: 将磁电机开关拨至关闭，随后拨回双侧

exact.en: Hold both Test 1 and Test 2 buttons, engine must shutdown
exact.zh: 同时按住测试1和测试2按钮，发动机必须停机

exact.en: Hold Test 1 button for 2 seconds, engine must keep running, repeat with Test 2
exact.zh: 长按测试1按钮2秒，期间发动机必须保持运行，以同样方式按住测试2按钮

exact.en: Magnetos switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 磁电机开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Switch magneto off, engine RPM should drop ~100 RPM, then switch magneto back on
exact.zh: 关闭磁电机，发动机转速应下降到100转/分左右，然后再打开磁电机

exact.en: Magnetos switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 磁电机开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: Magneto must be set to START position; then released to BOTH position when engine fires. Do not engage for more than 30 seconds in any 4-minute time period
exact.zh: 需将磁电机设置为启动状态；发动机启动后，再将其拨至双侧状态。避免在4分钟内启动磁电机超过30秒

exact.en: Maintain a speed suitable for the current flight conditions.
exact.zh: 根据当前飞行状况保持一定的速度。

exact.en: Maintain the aircraft in the center of the runway
exact.zh: 保持飞机一直在跑道中央
保持管道内气压在>13英寸汞柱

exact.en: Maintain starter operation for the desired duration
exact.zh: 在所需时间内保持起动器运行

exact.en: Main brake pressure indicator must indicate 0
exact.zh: 主制动压力指示器读数需指示0

exact.en: Manifold air pressure gauge must indicate 22-23 inHg approximately
exact.zh: 管道内气压计读数需指示22到23英寸汞柱左右

exact.en: Manifold air pressure gauge must indicate 0.76-0.79 ata approximately
exact.zh: 管道内气压计读数需指示0.76至0.79ata（在海平面气压）左右

exact.en: Maintain a manifold pressure of about 30 inHg
exact.zh: 保持管道内压力计读数在30英寸汞柱左右

exact.en: Master alternator and battery switches must be set to OFF
exact.zh: 主交流发电机和电池开关必须拨至”关闭“

exact.en: Both Alternator and Battery Masters must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 交流发电机与电池总开关均需设为“关闭”

exact.en: Both Alternator and Battery Masters must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 交流发电机与电池总开关均需设为“开启”

exact.en: Both Battery and Generator Masters must be set to ON
exact.zh: 电池和发电机总开关均需设置为“开启”

exact.en: Turn the key to the first position on the right
exact.zh: 将钥匙向右扭转到第一个位置

exact.en: Warning / Caution light must be off
If necessary, adjust mixture to make engine run smoothly
exact.zh: 如有必要，调整油气混合比，使发动机平稳运行

exact.en: Mixture must be cut off (pull mixture lever completely)
exact.zh: 需停止燃油混合（将燃油混合阀回拉到底）

exact.en: Mixture must be cut off (lever fully up)
exact.zh: 需停止油气混合（操纵杆完全拉到上方）

exact.en: Mixture must be lean (pull mixture lever, but not completely)
exact.zh: 需达到稀混合比（拉动燃油混合阀，但不可拉到底）

exact.en: Lean the mixture by pulling the mixture lever by 1 inch from a fully pushed position
exact.zh: 将燃油混合阀从推到最大的状态回拉1英寸，将混合比调稀

exact.en: Mixture must be lean when reaching 3000 ft
exact.zh: 高度到达3000英尺时，燃油混合比应为稀混合比

exact.en: Lean the mixture depending on desired performance or fuel economy
exact.zh: 根据理想性能或燃油余量，将燃油混合比调稀

exact.en: Pull until engine roughness is noted, richen until engine runs smoothly again
exact.zh: 直到可以注意到发动机工作不平稳前拉住操纵杆，直到发动机再次平稳运行前抬升油气混合比

exact.en: Mixture lever must be set on Rich (lever fully down) when engines fires
exact.zh: 发动机燃着时混合气操纵杆需设置为浓混合比（操纵杆完全拨下）

exact.en: Mixture lever must be set on Idle Cutoff (lever fully up)
exact.zh: 油气混合操纵杆需设置为慢关闭油路（操纵杆完全拨上）

exact.en: Mixture must be rich (push mixture lever completely)
exact.zh: 需达到浓混合比（将燃油混合阀推到底）

exact.en: Mixture must be rich for descent (push mixture lever)
exact.zh: 下降时燃油混合比需为浓（推动燃油混合阀）

exact.en: Mixture must be rich for descent (push mixture levers fully down)
exact.zh: 下降阶段，油气混合比需设置为浓混合比（将操纵杆完全拨下）

exact.en: If the airfield altitude is below 3000 feet, mixture must be set to rich
exact.zh: 如果机场高度低于3000英尺，则必须设置为浓混合比

exact.en: Advance mixture smoothly to RICH when engine starts
exact.zh: 发动机启动后，将燃油混合比平滑调节至浓混合比

exact.en: Move both levers to IDLE position
exact.zh: 将两个操纵杆拨至”怠速“位置

exact.en: Move flight controls to check correct functioning (free movement, correct sense): push, pull, turn left and right
exact.zh: 移动飞行操纵设备，检查其是否可正常使用（移动是否自如，手感是否如常）：推、拉，左转、右转
将操纵杆移至怠速位置

exact.en: Move mixture control slowly and smoothly to "FULL RICH"
exact.zh: 将混合比控制缓慢而平稳地调至”最浓混合比“

exact.en: Move power levers forward and backward to check unrestricted travel
exact.zh: 前后移动动力杆以检查不受限制的移动范围

exact.en: Move power lever to idle position
exact.zh: 将动力杆拨至怠速位置

exact.en: Move Propeller RPM lever through complete range and return to high RPM three times in a row; RPM should drop to around 1000-1100 RPM when in Low RPM position and return to 1600 RPM in High RPM position
exact.zh: 完全转动螺旋桨转速操纵杆并返回高转速，持续重复三次；在低转速模式时转速应降至1000至1100左右，并在高转速模式返回到1600

exact.en: Move rotor brake control to check free movement
exact.zh: 移动旋翼制动控制以检查是否可以自由移动

exact.en: Move the flight controls in all directions to ensure they work correctly

exact.en: Navigation lights must be set to "ON"

exact.zh: 当引擎转速达到45%，将右侧发动机启动器按钮设置为“关闭”

exact.en: Oil/Fuel supply levers must be set on Off (fully pushed)
exact.zh: 燃油供给杆需全部推至“关闭”（推至最远）

exact.en: Oil/fuel supply lever must be set on "Von Hauptbehälter Auf" (Open from main tanks)
exact.zh: 燃油供给杆需推至“从主油箱”（从主油箱开启）

exact.en: Oil/Fuel supply lever must be set on Off (fully pushed)
exact.zh: 燃油供给杆需推至“关闭”（推至最远）

exact.en: Oil/Fuel supply lever must be set on Run (fully pulled)
exact.zh: 燃油供给杆需拉至“开启”（拉至最近）

exact.en: Oil/Fuel supply lever must be set on Start

exact.en: Check that oil pressure is in green sector
Check that oil pressure is correct
Check that oil pressure is within recommended parameters (in the green)

exact.zh: 油压表读数需指示最低40磅/平方英寸

exact.zh: 油压表读数需指示最低50磅/平方英寸

exact.zh: 10秒内油压没有提升则关闭发动机

exact.en: Check that oil pressure is in the green sector
Check that oil temperature is in green sector

exact.en: Oil temperature gauges must indicate 60°C approximately

exact.zh: 进油温度计需指示最低-5°C

exact.zh: 排气管冷却后，安装盖子。

exact.zh: 如果在爬升过程中油温和/或冷却液温度达到黄色区域，应将飞行速度提升10节，并将功率减少10%

exact.en: Parking brake lever must be full forward
exact.zh: 驻机制动器杆须向前推到底

exact.en: Parking brake light must be On
Switch passenger seatbelt and no smoke signs to ON position.
exact.zh: 将乘客安全带与禁烟标志开关拨至“打开”位置。

exact.en: Perform the mandatory passenger briefing if passengers are present

exact.en: Switch passenger seatbelt signs to ON position.
exact.zh: 将乘客安全带标志开关拨至“打开”位置。

exact.en: Check that none of the PFD's instruments is crossed by a red X
exact.zh: 确认主飞行显示器上的仪表没有被打红X

exact.en: Set seats in a correct and safe position

exact.en: Pitot heaters lights must be Off

exact.zh: 空速管加热灯需指示“开启”
将空速管加热开关切换到“关闭”

exact.en: Pitot heater indicator must be Off
exact.zh: 空速管加温器需指示“关闭”

exact.en: Pitot heater indicator must be On
exact.zh: 空速管加温器需指示“开启”

exact.en: Pitot heat switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 空速管加温器开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Turn pitot heat ON, and check it's working correctly
exact.zh: 打开空速管加温器，并确认其正常工作

exact.en: Pitot heat switches must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 空速管加温器开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Set all pitot static heater system switches to OFF position
exact.zh: 将所有皮托管静压加热器系统开关拨至“关闭”位置

exact.zh: 将空速管静压加热器开关拨至“打开”位置。

exact.zh: 空速管警示灯需处于关闭状态

POH must be accessible to the pilot

exact.en: Position trim wheels in green arc

exact.zh: 飞机高度开始升高后，拉好驻机刹，收起落架。

exact.zh: 所有油门杆均需推至最大

exact.zh: 所有油门杆均需推至怠速状态

exact.en: Power levers must be fully pushed

exact.zh: 推进动力杆时，确认温度和扭矩未超出限制。

exact.en: Power lever must be set to manage correct airspeed
exact.zh: 需调整发动机操纵杆，保持正确的空速

exact.en: Make sure not to use more than 50% throttle power before the engine temperature is warm enough
exact.zh: 在发动机温度到达一定水平之前，注意不要将油门开过50%

exact.en: Power lever must be fully pulled
Push power lever to the max for 10 seconds. Perform the next checks during that time
exact.zh: 将发动机操纵杆推至最大，保持10秒。这期间完成下一项检查

exact.en: Retard power lever to maintain 1000 RPM
exact.zh: 拉回油门杆，以将转速保持在每分钟1000转

exact.en: Pressure and temperature values must be correct
exact.zh: 压力和温度值必须正确

exact.en: Pressure must be provided to emergency brake
exact.zh: 需向应急刹车装置施加压力

exact.en: Pressurization handle must be set in aft position
Pressurization handle must be set in full forward position
Press both propeller kill buttons to kill, switches must be lit
exact.zh: 按下螺旋桨两个停机按钮进行驻机，开关必须亮起

exact.zh: 按下有色按钮以关闭点火

exact.en: Press the AP button to turn it off
exact.zh: 按下自动驾驶仪按钮进行关闭

exact.zh: 踩下制动踏板以减小滚动距离
起动注油泵需拨至“关闭”
起动注油泵需拨至“开启”

exact.en: Engage the primer for 3 to 4 seconds
exact.zh: 接通起动注油泵运作3到4秒

exact.en: prime the engine up to 3 strokes, none if the engine is warm.
exact.zh: 为发动机起动加注最多3次，如发动机已经暖机，则无视此步骤。

exact.zh: 确认螺旋桨前方无障碍

exact.en: Verify that all people and equipment are at a safe distance from the propeller
exact.zh: 确认所有人员和设备都与螺旋桨保持安全距离

exact.en: Set Prop Lever in center position
exact.zh: 设置螺旋桨操纵杆至“中心”位置

exact.en: Propeller RPM should be between 2250 and 2700
exact.zh: 螺旋桨转速应在每分钟2250到2700转之间

exact.en: Propeller RPM must be in the green sector
exact.zh: 螺旋桨转速需处于绿色区域

exact.en: Set Prop RPM levers to get desired RPM
exact.zh: 推动螺旋桨转速操纵杆以达到理想转速

exact.zh: 完全转动螺旋桨转速操纵杆并返回高转速

exact.zh: 完全转动螺旋桨转速操纵杆并返回高转速状态；重复三次

exact.en: Propeller RPM lever must be fully pushed
exact.zh: 螺旋桨转速操纵杆需推至最大

exact.en: Propeller RPM levers must be fully pushed
exact.zh: 所有螺旋桨转速操纵杆均需推至最大

exact.en: Propeller RPM lever must be fully pulled
exact.zh: 螺旋桨转速操纵杆需拉至最底

exact.en: Propeller RPM levers must be fully pulled
exact.zh: 所有螺旋桨转速操纵杆均需拉至最底

exact.en: Pull carburetor heat lever fully backward
exact.zh: 将化油器加热杆向后拉到底

exact.en: Pull lever out, check RPM drop; push lever back in, check RPM rise back to initial value
exact.zh: 拉出拉杆，检查转速是否下降；将控制杆推回，检查转速是否回升至初始值

exact.en: Pull mixture level in full aft position
exact.zh: 将油气混合杆完全拉到向后位置
将混合气控制杆拉到底

exact.en: Pull the mixture lever to the aft position
exact.zh: 将油气混合杆拉到向后位置
拉动驻机制动器操纵杆

exact.en: Pull the throttle lever to the aft position
exact.zh: 将油门杆拉到向后位置

exact.en: Pull the throttle lever to the aft position and check the idle value is correct
exact.zh: 将油门杆拉到向后位置并检查怠速值是否正确

exact.en: Pull the yoke to the aft position
exact.zh: 将控制杆拉到向后位置

exact.en: Pull throttle lever fully back, check RPM value and stability
exact.zh: 将油门杆向后拉到底，检查转速值和稳定性

exact.en: Pull water rudders lever in upper position
exact.zh: 将水舵杆拉到“向上”位置

exact.en: Check fuel pressure and operate the manual pump until the red fuel pump cover signal turns off
exact.zh: 检查燃油压力并操作手动泵，直至燃油泵红色信号熄灭

exact.en: Push button to test caution lights

exact.zh: 将操纵杆推至“浓混合比”位置
将油气混合杆向前推到底

exact.en: Push power levers into afterburner position (full forward)
exact.zh: 将动力控制杆推入加力燃烧位置（完全前推）

exact.en: Push propeller RPM lever (P) fully forward
exact.zh: 将螺旋桨转速操纵杆（左舷）向前推到底

exact.en: Push the mixture lever full forward
exact.zh: 将油气混合杆向前推到底

exact.en: Push the nav light switch on if needed
Push the nav light switch on if required
Push the pitot heat switch in off position
exact.zh: 将空速管加热器开关推至“关闭”位置

exact.en: Push the switches in the on position
Push the switch in the lower position
Push the switch in the off position
Push the switch in the on position
Push the switch in the upper position
Push the throttle lever to reach 1800 RPM
exact.zh: 推动油门杆以达到1800转/分
将油门杆向前推至最底

exact.en: Push water rudders lever in lower position
exact.zh: 将水舵杆推至“较低”位置

exact.en: Check that radiator temperature is below 90°C
exact.zh: 检查散热器温度温度是否在90°C以下

exact.en: Radio master switch must be set to Norm
exact.zh: 无线电主控开关需拨至“标准”
设置通讯无线电与导航无线电频率

exact.en: Radio magnetic indicator must be operative
exact.zh: 无线电磁指示器需在运作中

exact.en: Radio master switch must set to Off
exact.zh: 无线电主控开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Radio master switch must set to On
exact.zh: 无线电主控开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: While above the dropping area, pull the lever to release the banner from the pole
exact.zh: 在空投区域上方时，拉动控制杆，释放杆子上的横幅

exact.en: Remove all inlet, exit or exhaust covers
exact.zh: 移除所有进气口、出气口或排气口盖

exact.en: Remove pitot cover, check for blockage
exact.zh: 移除空速管盖，检查是否堵塞

exact.en: Remove pitot cover, pitot port must be clean
exact.zh: 移除空速管盖，空速管口必须通畅

exact.en: Remove ropes and wheel chocks out
Remove tether and rotate briskly while listening for unusual rubbing or metallic noise
exact.zh: 移除绳索后迅速旋转，同时注意是否有异常摩擦声或金属噪音

exact.en: Check whether a motoring procedure is needed in the next step
exact.zh: 确认进入下一步前是否需要启动监控程序

exact.en: Retract landing gear when vertical speed is positive
exact.zh: 垂直速度为正时收起起落架

exact.en: When engine starts, move mixture control to Full Rich
exact.zh: 发动机启动时，将混合物控制调至最浓混合比

exact.en: The right condition lever must be fully pushed
exact.zh: 右引擎状态操纵柄必须完全拉下
当燃气发动机转速达到最小值12%时，设置为低怠速（LO-idle）

exact.en: Set the fuel control switch to RUN
exact.zh: 将燃油控制开关拨至“运行”

exact.en: Right engine starter button must be set to ON
exact.zh: 右发动机启动按钮需拨至“开启”

exact.en: Push the right engine starter button
exact.zh: 按下右发动机启动按钮

exact.en: Push right engine starter button until combustion is achieved
exact.zh: 按下右发动机启动按钮，直至发动机燃着

exact.en: Set the start/ignition switch to START
exact.zh: 将启动/点火开关设置为“启动”

exact.zh: 等待高压转子转速达20%并按下右侧运行/停止按钮

exact.zh: 开启右侧燃油泵，在燃油流量达到峰值时将其关闭

exact.zh: 必须将发电机开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Right throttle must be fully pushed
Single needle must be set to ADF (left button) and double needle to VOR (right button) for Radio Magnetic Indicator 1 and 2
exact.zh: 需将单针调至自动定向机（左按钮），双针调至甚高频全向信标（右按钮），以开启无线电磁性指示器1和2

exact.en: Allow airplane to roll forward slightly, and check the brakes
exact.zh: 让飞机稍微向前滑跑，并检查刹

exact.zh: 缓慢滚动，然后使用制动器，检查其是否正常工作

exact.zh: 在74节的最低速度时抬机头
