exact.zh: 达到目标速度后，将机头抬高10°

exact.en: Rotor blades must be inspected for signs of impact
exact.zh: 必须检查旋翼叶片是否有撞击痕迹

exact.en: Rotor RPM must be in green arc
exact.zh: 旋翼转速必须在绿色弧线内

exact.en: RPM should drop when carburetor heat is Open
exact.zh: 当化油器加热开启时，转速应有所下降

exact.en: RPM, EGT, oil pressure must be within limits
exact.zh: 转速，排气温度以及油压需在限度内

exact.en: RPM indicator must show a minimum of 61%
RPM must be around 56% within 50 seconds
Use the rudder to maintain the aircraft's direction during take-off
exact.zh: 起飞时使用方向舵保持航空器的朝向

exact.en: Fully extend the rudder left and right to ensure that it operates properly
exact.zh: 将方向舵向左右两侧完全伸展，以确保其正常运行

exact.en: Set rudder trim 5° to the right
exact.zh: 将方向舵配平向右调整5°

exact.en: Set the rudder trim for cruise
exact.zh: 设置方向舵配平，维持航行

exact.en: Over the runway threshold, set throttle levers to idle
exact.zh: 在跑道入口上方时，将油门杆调至怠速

exact.en: Safety start guard must be closed
Safety start guard must be open
Safety start switch must be set to Off
exact.zh: 安全起动防护开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Safety start switch must be set to On
exact.zh: 安全起动防护开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: "Saphire Starting" light must be on by 25 seconds max
exact.zh: “启动Saphire发动机”指示灯至多应亮起25秒

exact.en: "Saphire Start" button must be depressed for 2 seconds, then released
exact.zh: “启动Saphire发动机”按钮需按住2秒，随即释放

exact.en: "Saphir Start" button must be depressed for 2 seconds, then released
exact.zh: “启动Saphir发动机”按钮需按住2秒，随即释放

exact.en: "Saph Start" button must be depressed for 2 seconds, then released
exact.zh: “启动Saph发动机”按钮需按住2秒，随即释放

exact.en: "Saph Start" light must be on by 25 seconds max
exact.zh: “启动Saph发动机”指示灯至多应亮起25秒

exact.en: Seats and seatbelts are to be adjusted and locked
exact.zh: 需调整并锁定座位与安全带
选择理想的导航无线电来源

exact.en: Sequence: Doors out light illuminates, three red extinguish, three green come on, doors out extinguishes
exact.zh: 流程顺序：门外灯亮起，三个红色灯熄灭，三个绿色灯亮起，门外灯熄灭

exact.en: Sequence: Doors out light illuminates, three green extinguish, three red come on, doors out extinguishes
exact.zh: 流程顺序：门外灯亮起，三个绿色灯熄灭，三个红色灯亮起，门外灯熄灭
根据所需设置来设置高度表

exact.en: Set "Boost Pump" switch to "ENG. INT."; within 5 seconds "Don't Start" and "Inv 36 V Fail" light must be off
exact.zh: 将“升压泵”开关调至“发动机内部”；5秒内“请勿发动”和“36伏转换器故障”灯需未亮起
将化油器加热设置为自动
将总距操纵拉杆完全放下

exact.en: Set cyclic in neutral pitch position
exact.zh: 将周期变距杆拨至“居中俯仰角”位置

exact.en: Set elevator trim handle to neutral
exact.zh: 将升降舵配平握柄拨至“居中”位置

exact.en: Set elevator trim two marks aft from neutral for take off
exact.zh: 将升降舵配平设置在中间两格以下，准备起飞
将襟翼调整至准备着陆的状态
将襟翼控制杆设为“Auto”（自动）
将襟翼控制杆设为“Full”（全展开）
将襟翼控制杆设为“Half”（半展开）
将襟翼调整至中间位置

exact.en: Set fuel lever in idle position
exact.zh: 将燃油杆拨至“怠速”位置
设置点火器开关至“关闭”位置

exact.en: Set ignition switches to Off position
exact.zh: 将点火开关拨至“关闭”位置
根据要求设置舱内灯光
将起落架收放控制杆设为“DN”（放下）
将混合气控制杆向前推至最底

exact.en: Set Pitot heaters switches to desired position
exact.zh: 将空速管加热开关拨至所需的位置

exact.en: Set power levers to full power
exact.zh: 将动力杆拨至“全功率”位置

exact.en: Set power levers to idle position
exact.zh: 将动力杆拨至“怠速”位置

exact.en: Set radio and avionics as desired
exact.zh: 根据需要设置无线电和航空电子设备
将速度设定为每小时280千米

exact.en: Set the altimeter to the correct value
Set the barometer to correct value
Set the elevator trim to the take off position
exact.zh: 将升降舵配平拨至“起飞”位置

exact.en: Set the flaps selector in the lower position
exact.zh: 将襟翼选择器拨至“较低”位置

exact.en: Set the flaps selector in the upper position
exact.zh: 将襟翼选择器拨至“向上”位置

exact.en: Set the standby altimeter to the correct value
exact.zh: 设置备用高度表至正确值

exact.en: Set the STBY battery switch in the off position
exact.zh: 将备用电池开关拨至“关闭”位置

exact.en: Set the transponder to the chosen number
exact.zh: 将应答机设置为选定编号
将油门设置在“Off”（关闭）位置

exact.en: Set throttle lever to idle, when N2 reaches 10%
exact.zh: 当N2达到10%时，将油门操纵杆设置为怠速

exact.en: Set throttle lever to have NR in green arc
exact.zh: 将油门动力杆调至绿色弧中的NR位置

exact.en: (set WING FLAPS to UP or TO/APR for desired takeoff performance
exact.zh: （根据所需起飞性能将机翼襟翼拨至“向上”或“起飞/进近”位置）

exact.en: Set your flight plan as desired
exact.zh: 根据需要设置飞行计划

exact.en: When engine starts, move mixture control slowly and smoothly to Full Rich
exact.zh: 当发动机启动时，将混合物控制缓慢而平稳地调至最浓混合比

exact.en: Speed must be <178 kt before extending landing gear
exact.zh: 在放下起落架前，速度需为<178节

exact.en: Speed must be <330 km/h before extending landing gear
exact.zh: 在放下起落架前，速度需为<每小时330千米

exact.en: Speed brakes must be extended if necessary
exact.zh: 如有需要，需展开减速板

exact.en: Reduce speed below 16 kts / 30 km/h / 18 mph to taxi
exact.zh: 将速度降至16节/每小时30千米/每小时18英里以下以滑行

exact.en: If Spray equipment is installed, fan brake control should be "ON".
exact.zh: 如果已安装喷气设备，则风扇制动器控制应为“开启”。

exact.en: Stabilizer and strut must be in good condition
exact.zh: 安定面和支柱必须处于良好状态

exact.en: Standby attitude indicator must be uncaged
exact.zh: 备用姿态指示器需处于解锁状态

exact.en: Set the standby power selector to AUTO
exact.zh: 将备用电源选择器调至“自动”
起动机盖需为关闭状态
起动机盖需为开启状态

exact.en: Starter handle must be pulled up

exact.zh: 启动器主开关需为关闭状态
启动器主开关需为开启状态

exact.en: Waiting for engine combustion, before setting starter to OFF...
exact.zh: 等待发动机燃烧，然后将启动器设置为关闭

exact.en: Starter switch must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 启动器开关需拨至“开启”

exact.en: Hold starter on "ON" position until engine starts or for 15s max
exact.zh: 将启动器保持在“开启”状态直至发动机启动，最多等待15秒

exact.en: Hold starter button down until engine starts or for 15s max
exact.zh: 按下启动器按钮直至发动机启动，最多等待15秒

exact.en: Press left starter for 10s max. If engine doesn't start withing 10s, release the starter and wait 60s before next attempt
exact.zh: 长按左发动机启动器，最多保持10秒。如果发动机没能在十秒内启动，松开启动器，等待60秒再继续尝试

exact.en: Press right starter for 10s max. If engine doesn't start withing 10s, release the starter and wait 60s before next attempt
exact.zh: 长按右发动机启动器，最多保持10秒。如果发动机没能在10秒内启动，松开启动器，等待60秒后再继续尝试

exact.en: Static port must be clear of obstruction
Static pressure alt source valve must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将备用静压源阀门设置为“关闭”

exact.en: Check that the "STBY BATT" annunciator message is displayed
exact.zh: 确认“备用电源”指示信息显示

exact.en: Set battery switch to "ARM" position and verify that the Primary Flight Display (PFD) comes on
exact.zh: 将电池开关调至“ARM”位置，并检查主飞行显示器（PFD）是否正常运作

exact.en: Standby battery switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 备用电池开关需拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Hold battery switch on "TEST" position for 20 seconds, verify that green TEST lamp does not go off
exact.zh: 将电池开关拨至“测试”，保持20秒，确认绿色的测试指示灯不熄灭

exact.en: Check that standby flight instruments are set and work correctly
exact.zh: 确认备用飞行仪表已调试妥当，并正常工作

exact.en: Set strobe lights switch to OFF position
exact.zh: 将频闪灯开关拨至“关闭”位置

exact.en: Set strobe lights as required, depending on weather conditions and airfield regulations
exact.zh: 根据天气条件和机场规程，根据需要调整频闪灯

exact.en: Switch strobe light on, check its condition, and switch it off
exact.zh: 打开频闪灯，检查其状态并将其关闭
高亮度白色频闪灯需“关闭”

exact.en: Strobe lights switch must be set to ON
exact.zh: 频闪灯开关须拨至“打开”

exact.en: Strut pressure indicators must be in green area
exact.zh: 支柱压力指示器必须在绿色区域

exact.en: Strut must be in good condition
exact.zh: 支柱必须处于良好状态

exact.en: Move all switches to off position
exact.zh: 将所有开关拨至“关闭”位置

exact.en: Switch altimeter on and set it correctly
exact.zh: 打开高度表并正确设置

exact.en: Switch battery off when amber flaps lights illuminate
exact.zh: 当琥珀色襟翼灯亮起时，关闭电池

exact.en: Switch exterior lights on, if required
Switch left engine starter on and wait for RPM stabilization
exact.zh: 打开左侧发动机起动器并等待转速稳定

exact.en: Switch right engine starter on and wait for RPM stabilization
exact.zh: 打开右侧发动机起动器并等待转速稳定

exact.en: Set the throttle to FLIGHT-IDLE/TAXI position for 1 minute
exact.zh: 将油门调至飞行怠速/滑行状态，保持1分钟

exact.en: Tail rotor blades must be inspected for signs of impacts
exact.zh: 必须检查尾桨旋翼叶片是否有撞击痕迹

exact.en: Taxi forward with the stick back until tail wheel lock pin is felt to engage
exact.zh: 将操纵杆向后拉，向前滑行，直到尾轮锁销啮合

exact.en: With take off power, all tachometers must indicate 2250 RPM minimum
exact.zh: 起飞时，所有转速表读数须达到最低每分钟2250转

exact.en: Check taxi and landing lights condition
exact.zh: 检查滑行灯和着陆灯状况

exact.en: Switch taxi and landing lights on, check their condition and switch them off
exact.zh: 打开滑行灯和着陆灯，检查它们的状况再关闭它们

exact.en: Turn the taxi lights ON or OFF depending on the airport and exterior conditions
exact.zh: 根据机场和外部条件选择打开或关闭滑行灯
需将滑行灯开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Set taxi lights switch to ON position.
exact.zh: 将滑行灯开关拨至“打开”位置。

exact.en: Taxi forward slightly to ensure tailwheel is locked into position
exact.zh: 稍微向前滑行，以确保尾轮锁定到位

exact.en: Autopilot and Trims switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将自动驾驶与配平开关拨至“关闭”
需将自动驾驶/配平开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Auxiliary Boost Pump must be set to "AUTO"
exact.zh: 需将辅助增压泵设置为“自动”

exact.en: Auxiliary Boost Pump must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将辅助增压泵设置为“关闭”

exact.en: Auxiliary Boost Pump must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 需将辅助增压泵设置为“开启”

exact.en: Crash lever must be on "DOWN" position
exact.zh: 防撞杆需调至“向下”状态

exact.en: Crash lever must be on "UP" position
exact.zh: 防撞杆需调至“向上”状态

exact.en: All deice switches must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将所有设备开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: DE ICE SYSTEM switches must be set according to weather condition
exact.zh: 需要根据天气调节除冰系统设置

exact.en: Press the "LTS TEST" button to check the Deice lights work properly
exact.zh: 按下“指示灯测试”按钮，查看除冰指示灯是否正常工作

exact.en: Exterior lights must be switched off
Fuel selector switch must be set to "AUTO"
exact.zh: 需将燃料选择器开关拨至“自动”

exact.en: Fuel selector switch must be set to "MANUAL"
exact.zh: 需将燃料选择器开关拨至“手动”

exact.en: Press the "SHIFT" switch and check that it switches between left and right tank
exact.zh: 按下“切换”按钮，确认可以在左右油箱间切换

exact.en: Generator switch must be set to "MAIN"
exact.zh: 需将发动机开关拨至“主要”

exact.en: Ignition switch must be set to "AUTOMATIC"
exact.zh: 需将点火开关拨至“自动”

exact.en: Ignition switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将点火开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: INERT SEP must be set according to weather condition
exact.zh: 需要根据天气调节惯性分离器设置

exact.en: Inertial Separator must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将惯性分离器设置为“关闭”

exact.en: Inertial Separator must be set to "ON"
exact.zh: 需将惯性分离器设置为“开启”

exact.en: Adjust interior lighting depending on the lighting conditions
exact.zh: 根据照明情况调整室内照明

exact.en: Interior lights must be switched off
Press the "LIGHT TEST" and "CHECK DOWN" button and check that lights work properly
exact.zh: 按下“灯光测试”与“检查”按钮，检查灯光是否工作正常

exact.en: Check that oil pressure and temperature are in the green sector
exact.zh: 确保油压与温度均处于绿色区
将空速管开关拨至“开启”

exact.en: Electric current source must be set to Battery
Set the electric current source to either Battery, or Ground Power Unit (if connected to one)
exact.zh: 将电源设置为电池或地面电源装置（若有此种装置连接）

exact.en: Wait for INERT SEP to be fully retracted (~40s), and set SOURCE to "OFF"
exact.zh: 等待惯性分离器完全收起（需要约40秒），随后将电源设置为“关闭”

exact.en: If NG has not reached 30% by 30s or 50% by 50s after engine start, abort engine start !
exact.zh: 如果发动机启动后30秒内发电机旋转速度未达到30%，或启动50秒内没有达到50%，立即中断发动机启动！

exact.en: Starter switch must be set to "OFF"
exact.zh: 需将启动器开关拨至“关闭”

exact.en: Set starter switch to "ON" for 2 sec then release
exact.zh: 将启动器开关拨至“开启”，保持两秒后放开
需将滑行灯开关拨至“开启”
油门需处于“关闭”状态（底部靠右）

exact.en: Switch throttle to LO-IDLE then back to FLIGHT-IDLE twice
exact.zh: 将油门调至低怠速状态，再回到飞行怠速状态，重复两次

exact.en: Set the throttle to FLIGHT-IDLE/TAXI position for 2 minutes
exact.zh: 将油门调至飞行怠速/滑行状态，保持2分钟

exact.en: Set the throttle to LO-IDLE position (middle-right) for 15 seconds
exact.zh: 将油门调至低怠速状态（中间靠右），保持15秒

exact.en: Set the throttle to FLIGHT-IDLE/TAXI position (middle-left)
exact.zh: 将油门调至飞行怠速/滑行状态（中间靠左）

exact.en: Set Throttle to LO-IDLE position (lower-right) when Gas Generator Speed (NG) reaches 13%
exact.zh: 当燃气发电机转速 (NG) 达到13%时，将油门调至低怠速状态（右下）

exact.en: Add power to the throttle to reach 100% Torque
There must be no deposits of ice, snow or frost
There must be no holes or tears
exact.zh: 不能有孔洞或撕裂损伤

exact.en: The 2 DDI, HUD and MCPD must be off
exact.zh: 两个DDI（数显仪表），以及HUD（抬头显示）和MPCD（多功能彩色显示器）必须关闭

exact.en: The launch bar must be retracted
The LDG/Taxi light switch must be set to off
exact.zh: LDG（着陆灯）/滑行灯开关必须关闭

exact.en: Adjust throttles to get around 1100 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门，以至每分钟约1100转

exact.en: From a fully pulled position, push throttle in by 1 centimeter
exact.zh: 在油门完全关闭的状态下，将之推动1厘米

exact.en: Throttle should be pushed in at 75% max
Throttle must be set to maintain 85% RPM for 1 minute
exact.zh: 需调整油门以持续1分钟保持在85%的转速

exact.en: Advance throttle above 2500 RPM until the ALTERNATOR light is out
exact.zh: 推进油门，使转速达到2500以上，直至交流发电机提示灯熄灭

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1000 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1000转左右

exact.en: Adjust gas throttle to get around 1000 RPM or less
exact.zh: 调整煤气节流，以达到1000转以下

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1000-1200 RPM
Adjust throttle to get around 1100 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1100转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to between 1200 and 1400 RPM
exact.zh: 将油门调整至1200到1400转之间

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1200 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1200转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1400 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1400转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1450 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1450转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1500 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1500转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1600 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1600转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to between 1650 and 1950 RPM
Adjust throttle to get around 1700 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1700转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1800 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1800转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 1900 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟1900转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 2000 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门，以至每分钟约2000转

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 2500 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门，以至每分钟约2500转

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 4000 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门，以至每分钟约4000转

exact.en: Adjust throttle to between 500 and 600 RPM
exact.zh: 将油门调整至500到600转之间

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 600 RPM
exact.zh: 调整油门至每分钟600转左右

exact.en: Adjust throttle to between 700 and 800 RPM
exact.zh: 将油门调整至700到800转之间

exact.en: Set throttle position accordingly to the flight's requirements
exact.zh: 根据飞行要求合理调整油门大小

exact.en: Push throttle fully. RPM must reach at least 2300 RPM
exact.zh: 将油门开到最大。此时发动机转速应至少达到2300转/分钟

exact.en: Throttle must be fully pushed over 2-3 seconds
exact.zh: 油门需推至最大并保持2至3秒

exact.en: Throttle must be fully open. Aim for 52" of manifold pressure and 3000 RPM (take-off power)
exact.zh: 油门需开至最大。目标歧管压力达到52"，转速达到3000（起飞功率）

exact.en: Throttle must be fully open. Aim for 61" of manifold pressure and 3000 RPM (take-off power)
exact.zh: 油门需开至最大。目标歧管压力达到61"，转速达到3000（起飞功率）

exact.en: Throttle must be set to idle (fully pulled)
exact.zh: 油门杆需推至怠速状态（推到头）

exact.en: Throttle must be set to idle
Throttle levers must be set to idle (fully pulled)
exact.zh: 油门杆需推至怠速状态（推到头）

exact.en: Set throttle levers to get desired manifold pressures
exact.zh: 调整油门杆以达到所需的歧管压力

exact.en: With throttle levers in mid position, all tachometers must indicate 1500 RPM minimum
exact.zh: 油门杆推至中间位置时，所有转速表读数需指示最低每分钟1500转

exact.en: Throttle levers must be set on "Take Up" position
Throttle lever must be set on "Idle" position within 3 to 6 seconds from previous step
exact.zh: 油门杆需在前一步骤后3到6秒内调至“怠速”状态

exact.en: Throttle lever must be set on "Max" position
Throttle lever must be set on "Nom" position
Throttle lever must be set on "Stop" position
Set throttle lever to nominal power
exact.zh: 将油门杆调至额定功率

exact.en: Throttle lever must be set on "Max Power" position
exact.zh: 油门杆需调至“最大功率”

exact.en: Throttle lever must be set on "Take Up" position
Throttle lever must be pushed to idle within 3 to 6 seconds from previous step
exact.zh: 油门杆需在前一步骤后3到6秒内推至“怠速”

exact.en: Throttle lever must be set on "VOLN" position within 3 to 6 seconds from previous step
exact.zh: 油门杆需在前一步骤后3到6秒内推至“VOLN”

exact.en: Adjust throttle to get around 2500 RPM or less
exact.zh: 调整油门，以至每分钟约2500转或以下

exact.en: Throttle must be adjusted so as not to exceed 1500 RPM
exact.zh: 需调整油门，使发动机转速不超过1500转/分钟

exact.en: Open the throttle by about 1 inch forward
Throttle must be opened to get 60" of manifold pressure and 3000 RPM
exact.zh: 油门须开至歧管压力达到60"、转速达到3000

exact.en: Throttle must be open no more than 5mm
exact.zh: 油门需开至不超过5毫米处

exact.en: You're in for one heck of a race -- but first…? Time to qualify.
exact.zh: 你一定是来见证激烈竞速的吧——但在那之前...是资格赛时间。

exact.en: There you have it, we've got our lineup. And what a lineup it is!
exact.zh: 好，参赛名单出炉了。这是多豪华的参赛阵容啊！

exact.en: And here they are, finishing their 1st lap!
exact.zh: 选手们飞过来了，完成了他们的第一圈！

exact.en: Look at 'em streaking on by, these pilots aren't holding anything back!
exact.zh: 选手们飞驰而过，所有人都在拼尽全力！

exact.en: Last lap to change the tides for our Pilots, a fierce battle in perspective!
exact.zh: 仅剩最后一圈供飞行员扭转局势了，这场比赛实在激烈！

exact.en: This is the home stretch for them, who will be the winner this time?
exact.zh: 比赛到了最后的冲刺阶段，这次谁会是赢家？

exact.en: Love the sound of these Airplanes when approaching the Home Pylon at full speed.
exact.zh: 我爱死参赛飞机全速接近重点塔架的轰鸣了。

exact.en: These guys are making it interesting, folks!
exact.zh: 伙计们，参赛选手使比赛变得有趣起来了！

exact.en: Alright, folks, it's time for the big show! You came for aerial speed and skill on display? Well it all starts now!
exact.zh: 好了，朋友们，重头赛事来了！你想见识空中高速和飞行技巧？没问题，现在就开始！

exact.en: Alright, the tides have turned, we've got a new race leader!
exact.zh: 好的，局势扭转了，我们有了一个新的领先者！

exact.en: Well now, who saw that lead-change coming?
exact.zh: 好吧，谁能料到领先飞机就这么变了呢？

exact.en: We got a change up front, folks. It's a close one!
exact.zh: 大家快看，领头的换人了。这是一次惊险的超越！

exact.en: And there you have it ladies and gentlemen, an unforgettable spectacle! What a show these pilots put on for us today!
exact.zh: 女士们，先生们，这是一场何等难忘的比赛啊！今天参赛飞行员的表现多么精彩！

exact.en: Whoo! Win or lose that's always a rush! Let's hear a big round of applause for our fearless flyers.
exact.zh: 哇哦！一瞬间就决出了胜负！为我们无畏的飞行员大声欢呼。

exact.en: Voice Chat and Text Chat settings Off
exact.zh: 语音聊天和文本聊天设置关闭

exact.en: New aircraft offer customization options but come at a higher price.
exact.zh: 新飞机提供个人定制选项，但价格相对较高。

exact.en: Used aircraft are more budget-friendly but can be more or less damaged.
exact.zh: 二手飞机的价格更亲民，但存在不同程度的损坏可能。

exact.en: It represents the difference between the total incomes and the total expenses. This metric provides an overview of all your company's financial health during that frame.
exact.zh: 它表示所有收入和支出之间的差额。通过这一指标，可以全面了解你的公司在这期间的财务情况。

exact.en: Places where you can find more missions depending on the season
exact.zh: 你可以在这里，根据季节变化，找到更多任务。

exact.en: It highlights the total outflow of money for all your companies including insurance bills, maintenance, aircraft purchase etc. during the selected period.
exact.zh: 它重点显示了：在选定的时间段内公司的总支出，包括保险费、维护费、购买飞机所用的花费等。

exact.en:
After growing as an employee, it's time to introduce you to freelance world :
  • Buy a company license
  • Earn more income from each successful mission
  • Buy your own fleet on aircraft
exact.zh:
成为雇员后，也该了解自由职业的世界了：
  • 购买公司许可证
  • 成功完成任务，赚取更多收益
  • 购买自己的飞行机队

exact.en:
Now you need to buy an aircraft to begin flying for yourself:
  • Choose between brand new or used aircraft: make sure to get the best deals.
  • Take care of your aircraft: wear and tear is persistent from one flight to the next. Your flying habits have an impact on maintenance costs.
  • Insure your aircraft: choose the option that best suits the type of missions you'll be flying!
exact.zh:
现在你需要购买一架飞机才能开始自己飞行：
  • 选择购买全新或二手飞机：确保获得最优惠的价格。
  • 保养飞机：每次飞行都会造成磨损。你的飞行习惯会影响维护成本。
  • 为飞机投保：选择最适合你飞行任务类型的选项！

exact.en:
You'll want to regularly check on the condition of all aircraft:
  • Keep in contact with the technician as each system will need regular
  • Change and manage your aircraft from the mission hangar
  • Allow other crews to fly your aircraft for you company to bring in income even when you're not in the pilot seat yourself
exact.zh:
请定期检查所有飞机的状况：
  • 与技术人员保持联系，因为每个系统都需要定期检查
  • 从任务机库更换和管理飞机
  • 让另外的机组人员为你驾驶飞机，无须你亲自驾驶，公司也有收入

exact.en: It showcases the total earnings accumulated from completed missions and passive income generated during the selected period.
exact.zh: 它展示了所选时间段内，通过完成任务和被动收入累计的总收益。

exact.en: *Aircraft used for livery visualization purpose only.
exact.zh: *仅用于展示涂装视觉效果的飞机。

exact.en: It will be displayed on your aircraft.
exact.zh: 它会展示在你的飞机上。

exact.zh: 你的公司名称违反了我们的政策。

exact.zh: 微调各个控件映射的行为。通过点击动作列表中某个动作旁边的齿轮图标进行访问。

exact.en: Adjust device-level input curves (sensitivity, dead zones) that apply to all actions using that device's axes. Accessed via the "Hardware Settings" button on the main Control Settings screen.
exact.zh: 调整设备级输入曲线（灵敏度、死区），该曲线适用于使用该设备轴的所有动作。通过主控制设置屏幕上的“硬件设置”按钮访问。

exact.en: Revert all input profiles for all aircraft and devices to default. Your custom profiles will not be deleted.
exact.zh: 将所有航空器和设备的所有输入配置恢复为默认。您的自定义配置不会被删除。

exact.en: You entered in collision with another plane.
Watch your heading…you're leaving the course
exact.zh: 注意您的航向……您快飞出比赛航道了

exact.en: Get back on course or you'll be eliminated!
exact.zh: 请尽快返回比赛航道，否则您会被淘汰！

exact.en: Careful, you're too high. If you continue like this, you'll be penalized!
exact.zh: 注意，您飞太高了。若继续如此，您将被判违规！

exact.en: Watch your altitude - you're too high!
exact.zh: 注意您的高度——飞太高了！

exact.en: Get back down to racing altitude, judges will penalize you if you stay up there!
exact.zh: 请降低至比赛高度，如果继续维持目前高度，裁判将对您判罚！

exact.en: You're too high - get back down to race altitude
exact.zh: 您飞太高了——请降低至比赛高度

exact.en: Check your altitude - get back down now!
exact.zh: 注意您的高度——请立刻下降！

exact.en: You know the drill: Run the cleanest, shortest line around the pylons as possible, any unnecessary maneuvering will cost you.
exact.zh: 你知道该怎么做吧：环绕塔架飞行，尽量飞最短最干净的线路，减少不必要的机动以免浪费时间。

exact.en: Qualifying time: keep it fast, stay on course. Let's get pole position.
exact.zh: 资格赛时间：保持高速飞行，留在赛道内，努力去夺得首发位置。

exact.en: OK, here comes qualification. Let's try to nail a good time.
exact.zh: 好的，资格赛开始。试着争取一个好成绩吧。

exact.en: Let's set the pace out there today - I know you've got what it takes to get pole position.
exact.zh: 争取今天比赛的领先顺位吧——我知道你有本事能夺得首发位置。

exact.en: Time to qualify. Go all out, let's start race day on pole.
exact.zh: 资格赛时间到。全力以赴，去争取竞速比赛的首发位置。

exact.en: Well, you didn't qualify a legal lap, but you can still win…just gotta start the race from the back.
exact.zh: 唉，您在资格赛中没有完成合规单圈，不过您仍有机会取胜……只不过得从最后面开始比赛。

exact.en: The judges have negated your qualifying time - we'll start the race at the back.
exact.zh: 裁判判定您的资格赛时间无效——就从末位起跑吧。

exact.en: You cut a pylon so we'll have to start the race at the rear.
exact.zh: 您越过了一个塔架，所以比赛时得从末位出发。

exact.en: We didn't qualify because you cut pylons, but we're still in the running, just have to start the race from the back.
exact.zh: 我们没有资格赛成绩，因为您越塔违例了，不过我们仍可以参加比赛，只是得从最后面出发。

exact.en: We didn't qualify, but it's still possible to place, just have to start the race from the rear of the pack.
exact.zh: 我们没有资格赛成绩，但仍有可能获奖，只是必须在其它飞机后面开始比赛。

exact.en: OK, Bad Luck...lap 1 invalidated – but you still have one to go
exact.zh: 好吧，运气不好……第一圈成绩无效——不过您还剩一圈。

exact.en: Dang. You cut a pylon and this lap won't count. You've got one lap left for a legal time!
exact.zh: 可惜。您越过了一个塔架，这圈成绩不算数了。您还剩一圈用来取得合规成绩！

exact.en: OK, focus! Your lap 1 time is scratched, let's keep it steady for lap 2.
exact.zh: 好吧，集中注意力！您的第一圈时间不算了，第二圈稳定发挥吧。

exact.en: Lap 1 is invalidated, you've got one more chance to qualify. You can do it!
exact.zh: 第一圈成绩无效，您还剩一次机会取得资格赛成绩。您能做到的！

exact.en: You cut the pylon so you lost the lap time. One more shot.
exact.zh: 你越过了一个塔架所以该圈时间无效。还剩一次机会。

exact.en: Your lap time won't be retained. But you're still in a good position since you registered a time on 1st Lap.
exact.zh: 这圈成绩不会保留。但因第一圈时间有效，您还是争取到了一个不错的排位。

exact.en: Shoot. Lap 2 time won't count...but that's OK because you registered in lap 1.
exact.zh: 倒霉。第二圈成绩无效……但没关系，因为您第一圈时间还算数。

exact.en: Lap 2 is not gonna count…but we're still in good shape with your lap 1 time
exact.zh: 第二圈不算数……但情况还行，毕竟有第一圈成绩。

exact.en: Pylon judges have invalidated your second lap, so it won't count.
exact.zh: 裁判已判定您第二圈成绩无效，它将不会被记录。

exact.en: You cut it too close…Lap 2 is scratched
exact.zh: 您就差一点没错过塔架……第二圈成绩无效。

exact.en: White flag, white flag. You're on the bell lap now!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗。您飞到最后一圈了！

exact.en: White flag, white flag! Keep it steady and you've got this!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗！稳住排位，您能获胜的！

exact.en: White flag, white flag! This is your race. Keep it up!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗！您快要赢下比赛了。坚持下去！

exact.en: White flag, white flag! We're on target for the win!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗！胜利唾手可得！

exact.en: White flag, white flag! One more lap - stay focused!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗！还有一圈——保持专注！

exact.en: White flag, white flag. You can still do this!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗。您仍有机会获胜！

exact.en: White flag, white flag! Last chance to see what you can do!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗！这是发挥您实力的最后机会了！

exact.en: White flag, white flag! Push for position if you can!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗！尽量争取较好的排名吧！

exact.en: White flag, white flag! Don't leave anything out there today!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗！今天可别保留实力了！

exact.en: White flag, white flag! Now's the time to show your mettle!
exact.zh: 白旗，白旗！是时候拼一把了！

exact.en: We're set up nicely. Keep the inside line and you got this.
exact.zh: 咱们准备得不错。站住内线，您可以获胜的。

exact.en: I'm not gonna lie, we've got some catching up to do.
exact.zh: 老实说，咱们得迎头追赶才行。

exact.en: Lap one is complete, stay focused!
One lap down, keep it steady.
exact.zh: 第一圈飞完了，保持这个状态。

exact.en: End of lap one, good start!
exact.zh: 第一圈结束，很棒的开局！

exact.en: Good start, that's the first lap done.
exact.zh: 开局不错，第一圈搞定了。

exact.en: You're entering the 3rd lap, keep going!

exact.zh: 很好，第二圈飞完了，第三圈开始。

exact.en: That's 2 laps done, keep it up!
End of lap two, keep it steady!
exact.zh: 第二圈结束，保持这个状态。
第二圈完成，就这么继续飞！

exact.en: Don't let up now, we're almost halfway done!
exact.zh: 现在别放弃，我们快飞完一半了！

exact.en: End of lap 3, you're doing great!
exact.zh: 第三圈结束，您做的好哇！

exact.en: You're halfway there, keep it up!
3 laps. That’s the halfway mark…keep going!
exact.zh: 已经飞三圈了。那是半程标志……继续保持！

exact.en: 3 laps down, 3 to go. Doing great!
exact.zh: 三圈飞完了，还剩下三圈。做得很好！

exact.en: Just 3 laps remain, you can do it!

exact.zh: 还剩三圈，展现你的实力吧！

exact.en: 4 down, 2 to go, stay focused, you can do this!
exact.zh: 四圈飞完，还剩两圈，保持专注，你可以的！

exact.en: Just 2 laps remain, make these count!
exact.zh: 只剩下两圈了，好好利用！

exact.en: 4 laps down, push it as hard as you can in these final 2.
exact.zh: 已经飞四圈了，在最后两圈请全力发挥。

exact.en: We're halfway home, keep it up.
exact.zh: 我们飞一半了，坚持下去。

exact.en: 4 down and you're leading the pack. Stay focused!
exact.zh: 四圈飞完，你处于领先地位。保持专注！

exact.en: You have the best view because you're up front. Just 4 laps to go to victory!
exact.zh: 您飞在最前面，享受着最棒的视野。距胜利只有四圈了！

exact.en: You lead the pack, keep it up for 4 more and you'll place 1st.
exact.zh: 您领先于其它飞机，再这样保持四圈，就会夺得第一。

exact.en: Half way down and maintaining the lead, just 4 more to go for a win!
exact.zh: 半程已过，您还保持着领先。距离取胜只有四圈了！

exact.en: 4 laps left...If you're gonna make a move, you better make it soon
exact.zh: 还剩四圈……如果你还有什么招，快快使出来吧。

exact.en: You've got 4 more laps to find your way to the front
exact.zh: 您还剩四圈的机会用来挤进前几名。

exact.en: 4 laps remaining, you can get to first place!
exact.zh: 还剩四圈，你还有机会争夺第一！

exact.en: You're halfway there...fight your way to the head of the pack
exact.zh: 您飞一半了……努力超到其它飞机前面去。

exact.en: You're doing great - 4 more laps to make your move.
exact.zh: 您做得很好——还有四圈供您发挥。

exact.en: You've finished lap 5, give it everything!
exact.zh: 您已经完成了第五圈，全力以赴吧！

exact.en: 5 laps complete, 3 to go. This can be your race!
exact.zh: 五圈完成，还剩三圈。快赢下比赛了！

exact.en: End of lap 5. Keep going, you're almost home!

exact.en:
In this game mode, the goal is to explore the world by completing photo objectives.
Some objectives, like architecture or nature, have fixed points with a recommended starting location, but you can start elsewhere. Use the mini map camera to find your subject.
For objectives involving animals or planes, it's up to you to choose the best starting point to succeed.
exact.zh:
此游戏模式中，目标是通过完成照片目标来探索世界。
某些目标（如建筑或自然）具有固定的点和建议的起始位置，但您可以从其他地方开始。使用迷你地图相机找到您的拍摄对象。
对于涉及动物或飞机的目标，您可以选择成功的最佳起点。

exact.en:
Each objective has a main goal and up to three bonus conditions. To earn all stars, capture the main objective and all requirements in a single photo.
You can complete objectives in any game mode, and a notification will appear if your photo meets the criteria.
exact.zh:
每个目标都有一个主目标和最多三个奖励条件。要获得所有星星，请在一张照片中捕捉主目标和所有要求。
您可以在任意游戏模式中完成目标，如果照片符合标准，将出现通知。

exact.en:
Some bonus conditions require specific flight settings, like using "Custom Weather & Time" or "Live Weather & Time" for real-world conditions.
Find these options in the "Flight Conditions" menu during briefing, and access the weather panel mid-flight via the toolbar.
You can use "Active Pause" to freeze your plane while adjusting weather and time.
exact.zh:
一些额外条件需要特定的飞行设置，例如使用“自定义天气和时间”或“实时天气和时间”来获取真实世界的条件。
简报期间，在“飞行条件”菜单中找到这些选项，并在飞行途中通过工具栏访问天气仪表盘。
你可以使用“主动暂停”来冻结飞机，同时调整天气和时间。
请稍候，目标验证正在进行...

exact.en: It's the ailerons wing that makes the plane turn.

___On Approach___ Follow instructions to enter the traffic pattern at the arrival airport.

For extra guidance, use the Flight Assistant panel in the Toolbar menu, or ask ATC for directions.
exact.zh:
___进近阶段___遵循指示进入到达机场的起落航线。

要获得额外指导，请使用工具栏菜单中的飞行助手界面，或向ATC寻求指引。

exact.en:
___On Approach___ Follow on-screen instructions to enter the traffic pattern at the arrival airport.

Since there are no Air Traffic Control facilities at this airport, announce your landing intentions and current position via the radio.
exact.zh:
___进近阶段___ 按照屏幕上的指示进入到达机场的起落航线。

由于该机场没有空中交通管制设施，请通过无线电公布您的着陆意图和当前位置。

exact.en:
___Assisted Landing___ This assistance option will make minor corrections to throttle and pitch angle during final approach. It also manages flaps and landing gear for applicable aircraft.

To deactivate this feature, press {STR_PAUSE_TOGGLE}
to access the Assistance Options menu, and edit the Piloting section.
exact.zh:
___辅助着陆___ 此辅助选项将在最终进近期间对油门和俯仰角进行微小的修正。它还管理适用飞机的襟翼和起落架。

要停用此功能，请按 {STR_PAUSE_TOGGLE}
以访问'辅助选项'菜单，然后编辑'驾驶'部分。

exact.en:
___ATC Communication___ To receive proper clearances throughout a flight, use the ATC Radio panel to contact Air Traffic Control. (You can access this panel via the Toolbar if it is not already open.)

Alternatively, you can ask the AI Pilot Assist to automatically control all ATC communication, via the Flight Assistant panel in the Toolbar menu.
exact.zh:
___ATC通讯___若想在飞行过程中获得合规的许可，请使用ATC无线电界面联系空中交通管制部门。（你可以通过工具栏打开此界面）

或者，你可以使用'工具栏'菜单中的飞行辅助界面，请求AI飞行员辅助自动控制所有ATC通讯。

exact.en:
___Checklists___ For an authentic experience, use the Checklist panel to validate the status of the aircraft throughout the flight. (You can access this panel via the Toolbar if it is not already open.)

Alternatively, you can ask the AI Pilot Assist to auto-complete the Checklists.
exact.zh:
___检查单___若想获得真实体验，请在飞行过程中使用检查单面板确认飞机各项状态。（ 如果检查单界面没有打开，请通过工具栏菜单访问它。）

你也可以请求AI飞行员辅助自动完成检查单的确认。

exact.en: ___Climb phase___ After completing the initial phase of take-off, maintain a steady rate of climb to reach Cruise altitude.
exact.zh: ___爬升阶段___完成起飞的初始阶段后，保持平稳的爬升速度，并升至巡航高度。

exact.en: ___Cruise phase___ Aircraft is currently at cruise altitude. Follow ATC guidance or use map, compass and other instruments to navigate toward chosen destination.
exact.zh: ___巡航阶段___飞机目前处于巡航高度。遵循ATC指导或使用地图、指南针和其他仪器导航到所选目的地。

exact.en: ___Cruise phase___ Aircraft is currently at cruise altitude with no planned destination. For an authentic experience, speak to ATC when you wish to land at a nearby airport.
exact.zh: ___巡航阶段___飞机目前处于巡航高度，没有计划的目的地。为了获得真实的体验，当你希望在附近的机场降落时，请与ATC联系。

exact.en: It's the horizontal tail, or elevator, that makes the plane pitch.
exact.zh: 水平尾翼，也就是升降舵，负责调节飞机的俯仰角。

exact.en:
___Prepare for take-off___ You now have clearance to enter your designated runway.

Gently apply throttle and use rudders to steer onto the runway center line and line up for take-off.
exact.zh:
___准备起飞___您现在已获得进入指定跑道的许可。

轻轻地踩下油门，使用方向舵转向跑道中心线并排队起飞。

exact.en:
___Prepare for take-off___ Gently apply throttle and use rudders to steer onto the runway center line and line up for take-off.

Continue to monitor ATC radio frequency and visually check for any unexpected aircraft or obstructions before beginning the take-off roll.
exact.zh:
___准备起飞___轻轻地踩下油门，使用方向舵转向跑道中心线并排队起飞。

继续监视ATC无线电频率，并在开始起飞之前目视检查是否有任何意外的飞机或障碍物。

exact.en: ___Holding Short___ Before entering the runway, visually confirm there is no outgoing or incoming traffic, and ask ATC Tower for take-off clearance.
exact.zh: ___短距等待___进入跑道前，通过目视确认没有出港或进场的航空器，随后向ATC塔台申请起飞许可。

exact.en:
___Holding Short___ Before entering the runway, visually confirm there is no outgoing or incoming traffic.

Since there are no Air Traffic Control facilities at this airport, announce your departure intentions via the radio.
exact.zh:
___短距等待___在进入跑道之前，请目视确认没有出港或进港的交通

由于该机场没有空中交通管制设施，请通过无线电公布您的离港意向。

exact.en: ___Initial Climb phase___ After take-off, adjust pitch angle and throttle as necessary to maintain a steady rate of climb.
exact.zh: ___初始爬升阶段___起飞后，视情况调节俯仰角和油门，以维持平稳的爬升速度。

exact.en:
___Disabling notifications___ To assist with procedures and controls during a flight, notifications like this will occasionally be displayed.

To customize how often these messages appear, press {STR_PAUSE_TOGGLE}
to access the Assistance Options menu, and adjust Notification frequency.
exact.zh:
___关闭通知___为了助你完成一次飞行的各项流程及辅助操控，像本提示一样的通知会偶尔显示。

要自定义这些消息出现的频率，请按{STR_PAUSE_TOGGLE}
打开'辅助选项'菜单并调整'通知'频率。

exact.en:
___Pushback___ Any large aircraft parked at an airport gate should speak to ATC and request to be pushed back by ground service vehicles before starting to taxi.

Small aircraft should maneuver themselves into position without entering the taxi movement area.
exact.zh:
___后推___任何停在闸口的大型飞机在开始滑行前，均应向ATC请求地面服务车辆后推飞机。

小型飞机则应自行就位，无须进入滑行活动区。

exact.en:
___Taking off___ To begin take off, add full power and make small steering adjustments to keep the aircraft on the center line of the runway.

After reaching take-off speed, pull back on the yoke to lift off.
exact.zh:
___起飞___开始起飞需要将引擎功率增至最大，同时小幅调整方向，确保飞机对准跑道中心线。

达到起飞速度后，向后拉控制杆升空。

exact.en:
___Taxi phase___ You now have clearance to enter the Taxiway area and follow the designated route to your assigned runway.

To begin, gently apply throttle until ground speed reaches approximately 15 knots, using rudders to steer.

Listen for ATC instruction en route, and be prepared to stop and give way to other ground traffic.
exact.zh:
___滑行阶段___你已获准进入滑行道区域，请依照指定滑行路线前往分配的跑道。

开始滑行时，请轻缓增大油门直至地面速度达15节左右，并使用方向舵转向。

听从ATC指示，并做好随时停止的准备，以避让其它地面交通单位。

exact.en:
___Taxi phase___ You can now enter the Taxiway area and follow the designated route to your selected runway.

To begin, gently apply throttle until ground speed reaches approximately 15 knots, using rudders to steer.

Since there are no Air Traffic Control facilities at this airport, take extra care and give way to other ground traffic.
exact.zh:
___滑行阶段___您已获准进入滑行道区域，请依照指定滑行路线前往分配给您的跑道。

开始滑行时，请轻缓增大油门直至地面速度达15节左右，并使用方向舵转向。

鉴于此机场没有空中交通管制设施，请多加小心，注意避让其它地面交通单位。

exact.en:
___Cursor Mode and toolbar panel___ Press {STR_CURSOR} to toggle the on-screen cursor and open the toolbar at the top of the screen.

While in Cursor mode, the left stick controls the cursor and {STR_COCKPIT_INTERACTION_LOCK} is used to select.
exact.zh:
___光标模式和工具栏界面___按{STR_CURSOR}切换屏幕光标，并打开屏幕顶部工具栏。

在光标模式下，左摇杆移动光标，{STR_COCKPIT_INTERACTION_LOCK}用于选择。

exact.en: The National Air Races continues a proud lineage of air races, dating back to the Cleaveland Air Races of the 1920s, 30s, and 40s. You’re seeing history in flight here today, people.
exact.zh: 全国航空比赛延续了飞行竞赛的光荣传统，其可追溯到20世纪20、30和40年代的克利夫兰飞行竞赛。今天，大家将在这里见证这一辉煌的飞行历史。

exact.en: The T-6 Class features high-octane racing between stock aircraft, including the original T-6 “Texan”, the Canadian-built “Harvard”, and the US Navy “SNJ”. I can’t wait to see those birds in the sky!
exact.zh: T-6级别飞机展示了经典飞机之间的高辛烷值比赛，包括最初的T-6“德州人”，加拿大制造的“哈佛”，以及美国海军的“SNJ”。我迫不及待想看到这些飞机在空中飞翔了！

exact.en: The Pitts Special Biplanes dominated world aerobatic competitions in the 1960s and 1970s. Boy, wouldn’t you have loved to have seen those!
exact.zh: 皮茨特技双翼飞机称霸了20世纪60年代和20世纪70年代的世界特技飞行比赛。哇，您一定会很想亲眼见证那些场面！

exact.en: Check this: In 1959, Tom Messick flew a Smith Miniplane on a 4,200 round trip to attend the EAA Fly-in at Rockford, Illinois and was awarded a trophy for flying the longest distance to the event. I’d say Tom earned it.
exact.zh: 来瞧瞧这个：在1959年，汤姆·梅西克驾驶一架史密斯迷你飞机进行了4200英里的往返飞行，前往伊利诺伊州的EAA飞行大会，并因飞往该活动的最长飞行距离而获得奖杯。我认为汤姆是实至名归。

exact.en: The P-51 Mustang saw action during World War 2 and the Korean War. It was originally built for the British Royal Air Force as a tactical-reconnaissance aircraft and fighter-bomber.
exact.zh: P-51野马经历了第二次世界大战和朝鲜战争。它是一款战术侦察机和战斗轰炸机，最初是为英国皇家空军而设计。

exact.en: The Hawker Sea Fury was developed during the Second World War but didn’t enter service until two years after the war ended. Since then, this old war bird has flown in countries the world over, serving their people proudly.
exact.zh: 霍克“海怒”是在第二次世界大战期间开发的，不过直到战争结束两年后才开始服役。从那时起，这只古老的战鸟就飞遍了世界诸国，自豪地为各地的人民服务着。

exact.en: The Aero L-39 Albatross was the first trainer aircraft in the world to be fitted with a turbofan powerplant. We love birds that make history!
exact.zh: Aero L-39鹈鹕是世界上第一架装备涡轮风扇发动机的教练机。我们热爱创造历史的飞机！

exact.en: In service for over 50 years as the principal training aircraft for the Polish Air Force, the Iskra was the oldest jet-propelled aircraft still in use until it was retired in 2021. What legacy! It truly is an honor to see it gracing our skies today.
exact.zh: 作为波兰空军的主力教练机，Iskra服役超过50年，直到2021年退役时仍是当时最古老的喷气式飞机。真是伟大的遗产！今天，能看到它翱翔在这片天空中，真是一种荣幸。

exact.en: The de Haviland Vampire was a plane of many firsts, including being the first jet aircraft to cross the Atlantic, and the first jet aircraft to enter the British Royal Navy service. It’s an honor to have such a history maker in our midst.
exact.zh: 德·哈维兰吸血鬼战斗机是一架斩获了众多“第一”的飞机，其中包括第一架横跨大西洋的喷气式飞机，以及第一架进入英国皇家海军服役的喷气式飞机等。能有这样一架历史性的飞机在我们身边，实属是一种荣幸。

exact.en: A bird of many names, the T-6 Texan has been used to train pilots around the world. The United States Army Air Corps designated it as the AT-6, the United States Navy the SNJ, and the British Commonwealth air forces the Harvard, the name by which it is best known outside the US. Which is your favorite?
exact.zh: T-6德州人是一款有着不同称呼的飞机，曾在世界各地用于训练飞行员。美国陆军航空队将其命名为AT-6，美国海军称之为SNJ，而英联邦空军则给其定名哈佛，这是它在美国以外最为人所知的名字。您最喜欢它的哪个名字呢？

exact.en: The fastest T-6 aircraft can post race speeds in the 220-230 mph range. Pilots will have to rely less on raw horsepower, and more on strategy and skill to win at this class.
exact.zh: 最快的T-6飞机在比赛中可以达到220-230英里每小时的速度。飞行员必须更多依赖策略和技巧，而不是单纯的马力，才能在这个级别中获胜。

exact.en: Known as the “Pilot Maker”, if you can handle the T-6, you can handle anything!
exact.zh: T-6被誉为“飞行员制造者”，如果您能驾驭它，您就能驾驭任何飞机！

exact.en: P-51 Mustangs, F-8F Bearcats and Hawker Sea Furies. These are the modified war birds you’ll see when the Unlimited Class takes to the skies! That’s history in action folks!
exact.zh: P-51野马、F-8F熊猫和霍克“海怒”。这些都是您在无限制飞行时会看到的改装战斗机！过去的历史此刻历历在目，伙计们！

exact.en: Planes from the Unlimited Class can exceed speeds of 500mph. That’ll get your heart pumping!
exact.zh: 无限制飞行的飞机速度可超500英里每小时。绝对会令您心跳加速！

exact.en: The Unlimited Class is the original class. Without it, we wouldn’t have the National Air Races today. Thank you, Unlimited Class!
exact.zh: 无限制比赛是最初的分级赛。没有它，就没有今天的全国航空比赛。感谢您，无限制比赛！

exact.en: The fastest class at the air races, the Jet Class features birds of ultimate speed, such as the Aero Vodochody L-39 “Albatros”, Provost, Iskra, L-29 and DeHavilland Vampires.
exact.zh: 作为飞行竞赛中速度最快的级别，喷气级别展示了拥有终极速度的飞机，如Aero Vodochody L-39“信天翁”、Provost、Iskra、L-29和德·哈维兰吸血鬼。

exact.en: It may not be the fastest class, but with limited visibility in the cockpit, the Biplanes are widely regarded as the most difficult class to fly. Watching pilots handle these two- winged planes with such finesse is a thing of beauty!
exact.zh: 这或许不是速度最快的机型，然而由于驾驶舱内能见度有限，双翼飞机被广泛认为是最难以驾驭的机型。观看飞行员以如此优雅的方式操控这些双翼飞机，真是一桩赏心悦目的美事！

exact.en: The Biplane class is proudly represented by small, aerobatic aircraft like the Pitts Special, the Mong, and the Smith Miniplane.
exact.zh: 小型特技飞机是双翼飞机引以为傲的代表，如皮特斯特别机、蒙克和史密斯迷你飞机。

exact.zh: 拥有更大的最大横幅长度可以让你运输更长的横幅，从而解锁新任务。

exact.en:
Freeze the altitude of the aircraft.
Freeze the altitude (pitch, bank and heading) of the aircraft.
If this key event is set, it means that the altitude of the aircraft is not being controlled by MSFS, so enabling, for example, a SimConnect client to control the altitude of the aircraft.
This can also apply to Lat/ Long and attitude. Refer to the simulation variables:
IS LATITUDE LONGITUDE FREEZE ON,
IS ALTITUDE FREEZE ON, and
IS ATTITUDE FREEZE ON

Refer also to the SimConnect_AIReleaseControl function.
exact.zh:
打开或关闭飞机高度冻结。
冻结飞机的高度（仰角、倾斜度和航向）。
如果设置此关键事件，则意味着飞机的高度不再受微软飞行模拟控制，因此这也就能够让例如SimConnect客户端来控制飞机的高度。
这同样也适用于经度/纬度和飞机姿态。参照模拟变量：
是经纬度冻结，
是高度冻结，
是姿态冻结

您也可以参考SimConnect_AIReleaseControl功能。

exact.en:
Enable a keystroke to be sent to a gauge that is in focus. The keystrokes can only be in the range 0 to 9, A to Z, and the four keys: plus, minus, comma and period.
This is typically used to allow some keyboard entry to a complex device such as a GPS to enter such things as ICAO codes using the keyboard, rather than turning dials.
exact.zh:
让击键发送至一个清晰仪表。击键只能位于0到9、A到Z，以及四个键：加号、减号、逗号和句点的范围内。
这一般是用来让一些复杂设备（如全球定位系统）能够进行键盘输入，以用键盘输入诸如ICAO代码之类的内容，而代替转动数字盘。

exact.en:
Unlike the other Racing Classes that start with racers already airborne, in the Biplanes Class all aircraft start on the runway.

The starting grid is composed of 3 rows, and each row takes off in 4-second staggered intervals.

- The 1st row take off at the race start - The 2nd Row take off 4 seconds later - The 3rd Row take off 4 seconds after that

At the end of a Biplanes race, the staggered intervals are deducted from the total times of pilots who began in the 2nd and 3rd rows.

This is shown in the Results screen, in the "Delay" column.

The race leaderboard shows the starting position of racers during a Biplanes race. Remember that racers from rows 2 and 3 will receive a time deduction at the end of a race.
exact.zh:
与其他比赛级别不同的是，在双翼飞机级别比赛中，所有航空器起跑时都是在跑道上的。8.

起跑线由3排组成，每排以4秒的时间间隔起飞。

- 第一排在比赛开始时起飞 - 第二排在4秒后起飞 - 第三排再4秒后起飞

在双翼级别比赛结束时，这个时间间隔会从第二和第三排的飞行员的总时间中扣除。

这也会显示在成绩页面的“延迟”栏中。

比赛排行榜会显示双翼级别比赛选手的起始位置。 要记住，第二排和第三排的选手在比赛结束时将会被扣减时间。

exact.en: Aerobatic aircraft like the Aviat Pitts Special S1 agile racing at speeds exceeding 200 mph on a 3.12 miles course.
exact.zh: 如Aviat Pitts Special S1这样的灵巧特技航空器，在长达3.12英里的赛道上，速度可超过200英里/小时。

exact.en: Ultra high-speed aircraft such as the Aerovodochody L-39 “Albatros” match racing at 500+ mph on a 7.91 miles course.
exact.zh: 如沃多乔迪L-39“信天翁”这样的超高速飞机，速度可超过500英里/小时，使用7.91英里的赛道。

exact.en: Stock versions of the original North American T-6 “Texan” match racing at 220-230 mph on a 4.83 miles course.
exact.zh: 驾驶北美航空公司的原厂版T-6“德州人”参赛，速度可达220-230英里/小时，使用4.83英里的赛道。

exact.en:
Reno Stead Airport in Nevada is where all the action happens.

A former WW2 military installation, Stead Airport has been home to the Reno Air Races since 1966. Above this historic plot of desert terrain, multiple air courses are laid out for the various race categories.

These overlapping ovoid courses range in length between 3 miles and 8 miles per lap, their curves and straightaways delineated with pylons made from old 50-foot telephone poles and specially-constructed drums mounted at the top.

With each race running in a counter-clockwise direction, pilots maneuver around the course to find the best line from pylon to pylon and secure the fastest time over multiple laps.

Follow the race rules, pass other planes safely, and be the first to cross the finish line at the Home Pylon before a grandstand full of adoring fans.
exact.zh:
内华达州雷诺市的斯泰德机场是举办所有赛事的地方。

斯泰德机场二战时曾是军事设施，1966年起就一直是雷诺航空竞赛的大本营。在这片历史悠久的沙漠地带之上，雷诺航空竞赛为不同类型赛事安排了数条比赛航道。

这些卵形赛道相互重叠，每圈长度为3至8英里不等，其中的直道与弯道由塔架划定。赛道所用的塔架由50英尺高电话线杆改装而来，顶部安装了特制的鼓状物。

参赛飞行员需要逆时针绕赛道飞行，并寻找塔与塔之间的最佳路径，以争取用最短时间环绕赛道多圈。

比赛终点线设在出发点塔架，就在挤满观众的大看台前面。请遵守比赛规则，安全超越其他飞机，然后努力成为率先冲过终点线的冠军吧。

exact.en: Heavily-modified WWII fighters like the North American P-51D Mustang no-holds-barred racing at speeds over 500 mph on a 7.91 miles course.
exact.zh: 驾驶北美航空P-51D野马等重度改造二战战机参加全力以赴的比赛，飞行速度超过500英里/小时，使用7.91英里的赛道。

exact.en:
In this race mode, the performance and flight model of all competing aircraft is chosen by the host.

The host can also choose to modify Race Settings in the lobby screen before each race: - Standardized Performances: Choose between the standardized aircraft performance of Quick Match or allow distinctive performance for each aircraft. - Mid-Air Collisions: Enable or disable collisions between aircraft during races. - Back-On-Track: Enable or disable the automated back on track assist. If off, any crash or disqualification will eliminate a player from the race. - Maximum Penalties: Change the maximum number of penalties permitted before disqualification. If set to 0, unlimited penalties are allowed. - Race Laps: Adjust the number of racing laps (maximum of 8 for Unlimited Class and 6 for the other classes). - Time Of Day: Change the Time Of Day of the coming race. - Weather: Change the weather of the coming race.

Playing in Private Match will not affect your Reno or Roswell score.
exact.zh:
在此比赛模式下，所有参赛航空器的性能和飞行模型均由主办方选择。

主办方还可以在每次比赛前在大厅屏幕中选择修改比赛设置： - 标准化性能：使用快速匹配内的的标准化航空器性能，或允许每架航空器的独特性能。 - 空中碰撞：启用或禁用比赛期间航空器之间的碰撞。 - 重回赛道：启用或禁用自动返回赛道辅助系统。如果关闭，任何坠毁或取消资格都会使玩家退出比赛。 - 违规上限：更改取消资格之前允许的最大违规次数。如果设置为0，则允许无限次违规。 - 比赛圈数：调整比赛圈数(无限制分类最多8圈，其他分类最多6圈)。 - 比赛时间：更改比赛时间。 - 天气：更改比赛时的天气。

参加私人比赛不会影响你的雷诺或罗斯威尔分数。

exact.en:
In this race mode, the performance and flight model of all competing aircraft is standardized to ensure a balanced competition between racers.

Multiplayer race mode.

Up to 8 Pilots compete in head-to-head racing against other people via Xbox Network.

Each match is composed of 2 phases:

- Qualification: Pilots fly alone on the course, given 1 lap to record the best valid lap time.

- Race: Pilots fly together for 6 or 8 laps (depending on the Racing Class), with Starting Grid positions determined by lap time during Qualification.

Any penalties will be applied to times at the end of a race.

After each match, pilots gain or lose points depending on their final position. These points affect rankings per Racing Class, as well as an overall Reno/Roswell ranking score.
exact.zh:
该竞赛模式下，所有参赛飞机的性能与飞行模型都会被标准化，以保证公平竞争。

多人游戏比赛模式。

通过使用Xbox Network，允许至多8名玩家在一起进行激烈比赛。

每场比赛分为两个阶段：

-资格赛：飞行员独自沿赛道飞1圈，记录最佳有效单圈时间。

-决赛：飞行员们一起绕赛道飞6或8圈（圈数由比赛级别决定），出发顺位根据资格赛单圈时间确定。

所有违规罚时将在比赛结束时统一结算。

每场比赛后，飞行员根据最终排名加减积分。这些积分将影响飞行员在各等级赛事中的排名，还影响雷诺/罗斯威尔航空赛的总排位分。

exact.zh: 在每个比赛级别中，飞行员可在2种特定比赛模式中选择。

exact.en:
In this race mode, each aircraft has a distinctive performance and flight model.

Single player race mode.

Pilots fly alone for 6 or 8 laps (depending on Racing Class), attempting to set the fastest valid lap time.

Each pilot's fastest valid time will appear on the Xbox Network leaderboards.

每个飞行员最快的有效时间将出现在Xbox Network排行榜上。
