exact.en:
For over half a century, Reno has been home to the fastest motorsport on earth. It's here that pilots push the limits of their machinery and prove their mettle in the only event on the planet where high-performance airplanes engage in head-to-head competition.
In the skies over The Biggest Little City in the World, where memories are made at 500 miles per hour and legacies are forged in the blink of an eye, every raceplane has a rich and storied history… And the greatest stories may yet to be written.
In 2024 the Reno Air Racing Association announced that Roswell, NM will be the new home of the National Championship Air Races. A former military base for the Army and Air Force, today, ROW is one of the largest centers for the commercial aviation industries of the Southwest.
Whether at Reno or Roswell, the Air Races attract only the best of the best, pilots with nerves of steel and a powerful drive to win.
This is the National Championship Air Races.
exact.zh:
五十多年来，雷诺一直是世界上最快竞速运动的大本营。允许高性能飞机同场竞技的赛事全球仅此一家，在这里，勇敢的飞行员们驾驶着各自的座机来同台竞技，超越自身的极限。
这项比赛举办于“世界上最大的小城市”雷诺上空，每架参赛飞机都有着广为流传的丰富历史，它们以时速500英里飞驰而过，眨眼间就创造了不少佳话与传奇……而最宏大的竞赛故事可能尚未被写就，正等着你来添砖加彩。
2024年，雷诺航空赛协会宣布，新墨西哥州的罗斯威尔将成为全国航空竞速锦标赛的新举办地。罗斯威尔（ROW）曾是陆军和空军的军事基地，如今是美国西南部最大的商业航空产业中心之一。
无论是在雷诺还是罗斯威尔，航空赛只吸引最顶尖的飞行员，他们拥有钢铁般的意志和强大的求胜欲。
这就是全国航空竞速锦标赛。

exact.en: Racing aircraft must remain outside all course pylons at all times, during Race and Qualification phases.
exact.zh: 资格赛与决赛期间，参赛飞机必须时刻保持位于所有赛道塔架外侧。

exact.en:
Aircraft must remain below the maximum altitude of 250 feet AGL at all times.

- If at any time an aircraft exceeds the 250-foot limit, a notification will appear warning the Pilot to return to the proper altitude.

- If the altitude violation continues, the Pilot will be respawned "Back on Track" at the last Pylon that was crossed legally.
exact.zh:
比赛时最大飞行高度为离地250英尺，参赛飞机必须时刻处于该限制高度以下。

-如果飞机超过250英尺限高，飞行员将会收到通知，要求尽快回到合规高度

-这之后如果继续高度违例，该飞机将会“重回赛道”，即传送回上一个合规通过的塔架。

exact.en: Leaving the Race Area will result in Disqualification. A notification will appear warning the Pilot that they are about to leave the Race Area.
exact.zh: 若飞离比赛区域，将取消参赛资格。 飞行员即将离开比赛区域时，会出现通知信息发出警告。

exact.en: Flying across the middle of the race track, or over any public areas (such as grandstands, pits, or hangars) is strictly forbidden and will respawn the offending Pilot back-on-track next to the last Pylon crossed.
exact.zh: 截弯取直穿越赛道、飞越任何公共区域 （如看台、停机区或机库）均被严格禁止，参赛飞机如果违例，将会被传送回赛道，回到上一个经过的塔架旁边。

exact.en: Turning inside a pylon, or having any part of the aircraft over a pylon, constitutes a Pylon Cut:
exact.zh: 飞进塔架内侧，或飞机任何部分越过了塔架上方，将被视为越塔违例：

exact.en: During the Qualification phase, cutting any pylon will invalidate a pilot's lap time, meaning they will begin the Race phase from last position.
exact.zh: 资格赛阶段，越塔违例将导致飞行员的单圈时间无效，这意味着该飞行员在决赛阶段将从最末位出发。

exact.en: Any Pilot cutting pylons during the Race phase will be penalized (16 seconds per pylon for the Unlimited class and 12 seconds for other classes). The penalty time will be added to the race time at the end of the race.
exact.zh: 决赛阶段，越塔违例将被处罚时（无限制级中违例一次罚时16秒，其它级别一次12秒）。罚时将在比赛结束时加到比赛时间中。

exact.en: If a Pilot cuts 5 pylons during a single race, they will be disqualified.
exact.zh: 如果飞行员在单场比赛中越塔违例5次，将被取消参赛资格。

exact.en:
At the end of each race, pilots will receive a positive or negative points score based on their performance. Both Reno and Roswell have their own scores, which pilots will contribute to by racing in those tracks.

Within each Racing Class, the points each pilot accumulates per race are used to allocate a "Class Score", which will rank a pilot's overall performance in that class.

The separate Class Scores are then added together to create an overall "Reno Score" or "Roswell Score", which is used to rank the best of all Reno Racers!

You can see your rank for each Class Score and the Reno/Roswell Score in the Leaderboards section from the National Championship Air Race home page home page.
exact.zh:
每场比赛后，每个飞行员将获得基于其比赛表现而定的正负积分。雷诺赛与罗斯威尔赛拥有各自独立的积分榜，飞行员通过参加各自比赛来累计积分。

在每个竞赛级别中，飞行员的所有比赛积分相加得到“级别总分”，用以体现飞行员在该级别赛事中的整体表现与排名高低。

然后，各个“级别总分”汇总将得到“雷诺赛总分”或“罗斯威尔赛总分”，用以决出总体表现最优秀的参赛者！

您可以在全国航空竞速锦标赛主页面的“排行榜”中查看您的“雷诺赛/罗斯威尔赛总分”和所有“级别总分”，以及对应的排名位置。

exact.en: Complete a race in each category to be entered into the Global Leaderboard. An empty leaderboard means no players have gained an ELO.
exact.zh: 完成每个类别的一场比赛，即可进入全球排行榜。若排行榜为空，则代表尚未有玩家获得ELO。

exact.en: Before leaving the gate, remember to contact ATC to ask for taxi clearance and validate your flight plan.
exact.zh: 离开闸口前，记得联系空管要求滑行许可并验证您的飞行计划。

exact.en: CENTER LINE: The maximum distance reached from the center of the runway will be used to evaluate this parameter. The closer to the center, the more points you earn.
exact.zh: 中心线：这一项参数取决于你降落时距跑道中线的最大距离。距离中心线越近，你的得分就越高。

exact.en: Be mindful of your vertical speed on touch-down; damaging your landing gear will cause the plane to crash.
exact.zh: 注意触地时的垂直速度，起落架损坏会导致飞机坠毁。

exact.en: The square painted on the runway represents the touch-down target. For maximum points, try to aim for it!
exact.zh: 在跑道上的圆圈代表着触地目标。如果想要得到最高分数，试着瞄准它！

exact.en: Bouncing even once can drastically decrease your score; let the plane lower itself to the runway instead of pushing down on the yoke.
exact.zh: 着陆时哪怕弹跳一次，你的得分也会大大降低；不要猛推控制杆，让飞机自己降到跑道上。

exact.en: You can discover other locations or access any activity using the pause menu
exact.zh: 您可以探索其他地点或使用暂停菜单参与任何活动

exact.en: You can choose whether to display all POI names or just the targeted one via Assistance Options > POI section
exact.zh: 您可以通过“帮助”选项>“兴趣点”部分选择显示所有兴趣点名字或是仅显示一个

exact.en: POI names are only displayed when in the center of the screen
exact.zh: 兴趣点名称仅在屏幕中央显示

exact.en: The Flight Assistant panel from the toolbar can lead you to nearby POIs, or fly you there
exact.zh: 工具栏的飞行助手面板可以引导您到附近的兴趣点，或带您飞到那里

exact.en: GROUND ROLL DISTANCE: Your score depends on the distance from your Touchdown point to where you stop your plane. The shorter the distance, the more points you earn.
exact.zh: 地面滑跑距离：你的得分取决于触地点与飞机停止的位置之间的距离。距离越短，你的得分就越高。

exact.en: LANDING PRECISION: Your score depends on the longitudinal distance from your touchdown point to the target center. The closer to the target, the more points you earn.
exact.zh: 着陆精度：您的分数取决于从触地点到目标中心的纵向距离。离目标越近，您的分数也就越高。

exact.en: LANDING SMOOTHNESS: Your score depends on your Vertical Speed (fpm) at touchdown. The closer to 0 fpm, the more points you earn.
exact.zh: 着陆平稳性：着陆平稳性的评估将取决于着陆时的垂直速度（英寸/分）。越接近0英寸/分，你的分数就越高。

exact.en: When starting your approach, try to keep your plane at 1.3 Vs (Stall Speed). This is equivalent to 48 kts for the Cessna 172.
exact.zh: 当你开始进近时，试着让你的飞机保持在1.3 Vs（失速速度）。这相当于塞斯纳-172型飞机的48节速度。

exact.en: The A320neo incorporates two new engine choices – Pratt and Whitney’s PurePower PW1100G-JM geared turbofan and CFM International’s LEAP-1A – along with Sharklet™ wingtip devices.
exact.zh: A320neo采用了两种新的发动机选择——普·惠公司的PurePower PW1100G-JM齿轮传动涡轮风扇发动机和CFM国际集团的Leap-1A发动机，以及Sharklet™的翼尖装置。

exact.en: The A320neo began operation in 2014, and has since become the fastest selling commercial aircraft ever.
exact.zh: A320neo于2014年开始投入运行，并成为有史以来销售速度最快的商用飞机。

exact.en: The Icon A5 made its public debut at the 2014 EAA AirVenture in Oshkosh, Wisconsin.
exact.zh: Icon A5飞机在2014年威斯康星州奥什科什的EAA空中探险展会上首次亮相。

exact.en: The Super Hornet first flew on 29 November 1995
exact.zh: 超级大黄蜂战斗机于1995年11月29日首飞

exact.en: Over 600 Super Hornets have been built
exact.zh: 已有600多架超级大黄蜂问世

exact.en: If you're in a rush, you can skip the checklist process to take off faster.
exact.zh: 如果你赶时间，你可以跳过检查单程序从而更快地起飞！

exact.en: Most airports have a 20 kts speed limit while taxiing, so be mindful of your speed.
exact.zh: 大多数机场在滑行时都有20节的限速，所以请您多加注意速度。

exact.en: When on Approach, follow ATC instructions or published procedures to bring the aircraft to the aerodrome and prepare for landing.
exact.zh: 进近时，请按照ATC的指示或已发布的程序将飞机带至机场并准备着陆。

exact.en: The typical cruising airspeed for a long-distance commercial passenger aircraft is approximately 475-500 knots.
exact.zh: 长途商用客机的典型巡航空速约为475～500节。

exact.en: The Descent phase gets the aircraft to an appropriate altitude for approach and landing.
exact.zh: 下降阶段时，使飞机达到适当的高度，以便进近和着陆。

exact.en: On Final, the aircraft should be lined up with the runway and configured for landing.
exact.zh: 在最终边时，飞机应已对准跑道，并完成着陆相关的调整。

exact.en: The Takeoff phase starts when the aircraft is in position and has ATC clearance to depart.
exact.zh: 起飞阶段从飞机就位并获得空中交通管制许可后开始。

exact.en: Taxi begins when the aircraft has been pushed back from the gate, and the ATC has given clearance to taxi to the active runway.
exact.zh: 飞机被从闸口推回、且空管已批准滑行进入现用跑道，即是滑行开始的时点。

exact.en: At approximately 520 miles south of the geographic North Pole, Alert Airport in Canada is the northernmost airport in the world.
exact.zh: 加拿大的阿勒特机场位于地理北极以南约520英里处，是世界上最北端的机场。

exact.en: Frankfurt Airport has the largest number of non-stop destinations of any airport in the world.
exact.zh: 法兰克福机场是世界上直达目的地最多的机场。

exact.en: First opening in 1929, London Heathrow is Europe's busiest airport, and combines with neighboring airports to make London the world's busiest metropolitan area by passenger traffic.
exact.zh: 伦敦希思罗机场于1929年首次开放，是欧洲最繁忙的机场。它与邻近机场合力，令伦敦成为了全球最繁忙的大都市区。

exact.en: Barra Airport in Scotland is infamously the only airport in the world where scheduled flights use a beach as the runway.
exact.zh: 苏格兰的巴拉机场是世界上唯一一家以海滩为航班飞行跑道的机场。

exact.en: In Amsterdam, Schiphol Airport's newest runway, Polderbaan, is more than 3 miles (5 km) from the terminal building requiring a lengthy 15 minute taxi to and from it.
exact.zh: 在阿姆斯特丹，史基浦机场最新的跑道Polderbaan（波尔德班）距离航站楼有3英里多（5千米）之远，往返滑行于该航站楼需要15分钟的时间。

exact.en: Svalbard Airport in Norway is the northernmost airport in the world with scheduled public flights.
exact.zh: 挪威斯瓦尔巴机场是世界上最北端的有定期公共航班的机场。

exact.en: Built in 1954, Cape Town Int'l Airport is the fourth busiest in Africa.
exact.zh: 开普敦国际机场建于1954年，是非洲第四繁忙的机场。

exact.en: Cairo Int'l Airport is around 9 miles (15 km) northeast of the city center, and is the second busiest in Africa.
exact.zh: 开罗国际机场位于市中心东北方约9英里（15千米）处，是非洲第二繁忙的机场。

exact.en: With regular flights from Chicago and Los Angeles, Aspen-Pitkin County Airport in Colorado is the most served ski resort airport in North America.
exact.zh: 科罗拉多的阿斯彭机场有从芝加哥和洛杉矶出发的定期航班，是北美服务最繁忙的滑雪胜地机场。

exact.en: Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson Int'l Airport has been the world's busiest airport by passenger traffic since 1998.
exact.zh: 自1998年以来，亚特兰大的亚特兰大杰克逊国际机场一直是世界上最繁忙的客运机场。

exact.en: College Park Airport in Maryland is the world's oldest continuously operated airport having been in service since December 1911.
exact.zh: 马里兰州的马里兰大学公园机场是世界上最古老的一直持续的运营机场，自1911年12月投入使用以来一直运行。

exact.en: Denver Int'l Airport's Runway 16R/34L, with a length of 16,000 feet (4,877 m), is the longest public use runway in the United States.
exact.zh: 丹佛国际机场的跑道16R/34L长16000英尺（4877米），是美国最长的公共使用跑道。

exact.en: Nanwalek Airport in Alaska is America's shortest commercial runway with only 850 feet of usable distance.
exact.zh: 阿拉斯加的南华莱克机场是美国最短的商业跑道，只有850英尺的可用距离。

exact.en: Visit the birthplace of heavier-than-air flight, Kitty Hawk and Kill Devil Hills, North Carolina.
exact.zh: 记得参观位于北卡罗莱纳州的重航空器飞行诞生地——基蒂霍克和斩魔山。

exact.en: After their first successful landing at Lake County Airport in Colorado, pilots receive a certificate noting their arrival at North America's highest airport.
exact.zh: 在科罗拉多的莱德维尔机场首次成功着陆后，飞行员将收到一份证书，记录他们抵达了北美最高的机场。

exact.en: Chicago O'Hare airport reclaimed the title of busiest airport by aircraft movement in 2018.
exact.zh: 芝加哥奥黑尔机场在2018年通重回了航班动态“最繁忙机场”的宝座。

exact.en: Opened in 1944, Seattle-Tacoma Int'l Airport is the primary commercial airport serving the Seattle metropolitan area.
exact.zh: 1944年开放的西雅图-塔科马国际机场是服务西雅图大都市区的主要商业机场。

exact.en: The Courchevel airport is considered dangerous, as it features a difficult approach, an upward-sloping runway and ski runs in the adjacent area
exact.zh: 由于难以进近、跑道向上倾斜和附近地区有滑雪道的特点，库尔舍韦勒机场堪称险象环生。

exact.en: Located at 1,240 ft (378 m) below mean sea level, Bar Yehuda Airfield in Israel is the lowest airport in the world.
exact.zh: 以色列的巴尔·耶胡达机场位于平均海平面以下1240英尺（378米），是世界上最低的机场。

exact.en: The runway at Gibraltar Airport has a public road crossing it, requiring careful management of both air and ground traffic.
exact.zh: 直布罗陀机场的跑道有一条公共道路横跨其中，使得相关人员需要非常谨慎地同时管理空中和地面交通。

exact.en: The approach to Toncontín Int'l Airport in Honduras is considered one of the most difficult in the world!
exact.zh: 洪都拉斯的通孔廷国际机场被认为是世界上进近最困难的机场之一！

exact.en: Located at Amundsen–Scott South Pole Station, the Jack F. Paulus Skiway is the southernmost airport in the world.
exact.zh: Jack F. Paulus滑雪道位于阿蒙森-史考特南极站，是世界上最南端的机场。

exact.en: Dubai is the world's busiest airport by international passenger traffic.
exact.zh: 迪拜国际机场是世界上最繁忙的国际客运机场。

exact.en: Guardiamarina Zañartu in Chile is the southernmost airport in the world with scheduled public flights.
exact.zh: 智利的瓜玛丽娜·萨纳图机场是世界上最南端的机场，有定期公共航班。

exact.en: Mataveri Int'l Airport on Easter Island is more than 1,600 miles (2,600 km) from any other landing strip making it the remotest airport in the world.
exact.zh: 位于复活节岛的马塔维利国际机场是世界上最偏远的机场，距离最近的起降跑道也有着超过1600英里（2600千米）的距离。

exact.en: Located in a canyon, Chagual Airport in Peru is infamously one of the world's most difficult approaches due to the surrounding mountains.
exact.zh: 秘鲁的Chagual机场位于峡谷中，因周围的群山而臭名昭著，是世界上最难进近的机场之一。

exact.en: Atyrau Airport in Kazakhstan is the lowest commercial airport in the world at 72 ft (22 m) below sea level.
exact.zh: 哈萨克斯坦的阿特劳机场位于水平面72英尺（22米）以下，是世界最低的商业机场。

exact.en: Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Int'l Airport is the world's busiest single-runway airport.
exact.zh: 孟买的贾特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉国际机场是世界上最繁忙的单跑道机场。

exact.en: The runway at Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla, Nepal is one of the shortest in the world at just 1700 feet, and has a steep drop at the southern end.
exact.zh: 尼泊尔卢卡拉的丹增希拉里机场的跑道是世界上最短的跑道之一，只有1700英尺，南端有陡峭的下降坡。

exact.en: Due to its high altitude, Qamdo Bamda Airport in China has the longest publicly used paved runway in the world at 3.4 miles (5.5 km).
exact.zh: 由于海拔高，中国的昌都邦达机场拥有世界上最长的公共使用铺面跑道，有足足3.4英里（5.5千米）。

exact.en: At 14,472 ft (4,411 m) above sea level, Daocheng Yading Airport in China is the world's highest civilian airport.
exact.zh: 中国的稻城亚丁机场位于海拔14472英尺（4411米）处，是世界上最高的民用机场。

exact.en: Remember to always check the approach path for traffic before entering a runway. You can never be too careful!
exact.zh: 记住在进入跑道前要检查进近路径。千万要多加小心！

exact.en: The angular difference between an airplane's axis and the natural horizon.
exact.zh: 飞机轴线与自然地平线之间的角差。

exact.en: The attitude is the aircraft nose position relative to the horizon
exact.zh: 姿态是飞机机头相对于地平线的位置

exact.en: Notice and remember the horizon position in your windshield for a given attitude
exact.zh: 注意并记住挡风玻璃中的地平线位置，以便采取特定的姿态。

exact.en: The pitch and throttle settings translate into speed, altitude and heading: ATTITUDE + POWER = PERFORMANCE
exact.zh: 俯仰角和油门设置换句话来说即为速度、高度和航向：姿态+功率=性能

exact.en: In this Training, make sure to maintain the same attitude to observe the effect of power changes
exact.zh: 在本次培训中，一定要保持相同姿态来观察功率变化的影响

exact.en: The first transatlantic flight by the Boeing 747 was on January 22, 1970.
exact.zh: 波音747的首次跨大西洋飞行是在1970年1月22日。

exact.en: Under normal conditions the usual takeoff speed of a fully-loaded Boeing 747 is around 160 KIAS.
exact.zh: 在正常情况下，满载的波音747飞机正常起飞速度约为160KIAS（海里/小时）。

exact.en: The Boeing 787-10 entered commercial service in 2018.
exact.zh: 波音787-10于2018年投入商业运营。

exact.en: In base leg, reduce throttle to idle and take the best gliding speed 65 knots
exact.zh: 在第四边时，减少油门至怠速，并获得65节的最佳滑翔速度。

exact.en: Always gain altitude when heading towards mountains; you'll need it!
exact.zh: 飞往山岳地带时，务必要抬升高度。不然到时候后悔也来不及了！

exact.en: Remember: Using the 'Back On Track' feature in Bush Trips will prevent you from earning an Achievement upon their completion.
exact.zh: 记住：若在郊野之行中与空管对话，或使用“回到正轨”功能，即使完成航行也无法获得成就。

exact.en: The 'Get Me Back On Track' Feature will present you with a new heading in the Nav Log, and a line on the VFR map, to help you find the nearest waypoint.
exact.zh: “回到正轨”功能将在导航日志中为你提供一个新的航向，并在目视飞行规则地图上显示一条线，来帮助你找到最近的航路点。

exact.en: Bush Trips are long VFR flights focused on sightseeing.
exact.zh: 郊野之行是以观光为主的长途目视飞行。

exact.en: You should try to keep a distance of around 1000 feet between you and the ground.
exact.zh: 你应该尽量与地面保持1000英尺左右的距离。

exact.en: In this Training you will learn about the following: 1 - AILERON, 2 - FLAPS, 3 - RUDDER, 4 - ELEVATOR
exact.zh: 在本次培训中，您将了解以下内容：1-副翼，2-襟翼，3-方向舵，4-升降舵

exact.en: In this Training you will learn about the following: 1 - AIRSPEED INDICATOR, 2 - ATTITUDE INDICATOR, 3 - ALTIMETER, 4 - TURN AND SLIP INDICATOR, 5 - HEADING INDICATOR, 6 - VARIOMETER, 7 - TACHOMETER
exact.zh: 在本次培训中，您将了解以下内容：1-空速指示器，2-姿态指示器，3-高度计，4-转弯侧滑指示器，5-航向指示器，6-升降速度仪，7-转速表

exact.en: The Cessna 152 was in production from 1977 to 1985 with over 6500 aircraft built.
exact.zh: 塞斯纳152型飞机于1977年至1985年投产，共制造了6500多架飞机。

exact.en: More than 40,000 Cessna 172s have been built since the model first flew in 1955.
exact.zh: 自1955年首飞以来，人们已经建造了超过40000架塞斯纳172飞机。

exact.en: The Cessna 172 is the most produced airplane in the world.
exact.zh: 塞斯纳172型飞机是世界上生产量最大的飞机。

exact.en: The stall speed of a Cessna 172S with flaps fully extended is 40 KIAS.
exact.zh: 塞斯纳172S襟翼完全扩展的状态下的失速速度是40KIAS。

exact.en: Newer models of the Cessna 172S are equipped with the Garmin G1000 glass cockpit.
exact.zh: 塞斯纳172S的新型号配备了GarminG1000玻璃驾驶舱。

exact.en: The Cessna Grand Caravan EX is an upgraded 2013 version of the Cessna 208B Caravan, and has an improved rate of climb and higher cruise speed than its predecessor.
exact.zh: 塞斯纳Grand Caravan EX是2013年塞斯纳208B“大篷车”小型飞机的升级版，其爬升速度比前代机型更高，巡航速度也更快。

exact.en: The crab method is one way to maintain runway alignment with strong crosswinds on final approach.
exact.zh: 侧航法是在最后进近时利用强侧风保持跑道对齐的一种方法。

exact.en: Shorter runways have far less margin for error, so keep an eye on your ground speed during landing.
exact.zh: 较短的跑道容错率要低得多，所以在着陆时要注意地速。

exact.en: You will earn higher scores for landing smoothly at a gentle speed and proceeding along the runway.
exact.zh: 以平缓的速度平稳着陆，并沿着跑道行进，你将获得更高的分数。

exact.en: To fly with a cruise attitude, align your cockpit just below the horizon.
exact.zh: 以巡航姿态飞行，将驾驶舱对准地平线以下。

exact.en: Pro-tip: Once you find a camera position you like, you can save a shortcut to easily get back to that view any time.
exact.zh: 进阶小提示：找到喜欢的摄像机位置后，可为其保存一个快捷方式，以便随时轻松返回该视图。

exact.en: The Diamond DA62's 3-blade, hydraulic constant-speed MT-Propellers feature advanced blade geometry for efficient performance, smoothness and low noise.
exact.zh: 钻石DA62的3桨叶式液压恒速MT-Propeller螺旋桨具有先进的刀片几何形状，性能高效、平滑并且噪音低。

exact.en: The DA62 series is powered by the Austro Engine E4P-C engines with single power lever control.
exact.zh: DA62系列是由奥地利Austro Engine公司的E4P-C发动机与单油门杆控制。

exact.en: When you Delegate Control, the AI Co-Pilot will fly the plane for you, following the flight plan.
exact.zh: 当您委托控制时，AI副驾驶将按照飞行计划为您驾驶飞机。

exact.en: When switching to a descent attitude, remember to reduce power first to avoid overspeeding your engine.
exact.zh: 当切换到下降姿态时，记得先降低功率避免发动机超速。

exact.en: In this Training, you will learn about the following: 1 - DOWNWIND, 2 - BASE, 3 - FINAL
exact.zh: 在本次培训中，您将了解以下内容：1-三边，2-四边，3-五边

exact.en: In downwind keep the runway along the middle of the wing strut of the aircraft to stay at a gliding distance from the airport.
exact.zh: 处于第三边时，尽量保持跑道与航空器机翼支柱正中平行，以此与机场保持滑翔距离。

exact.en: A good distance from the runway is a gliding distance, you can judge by seeing the runway from the cockpit at about 2/3 of the strut under the wing.
exact.zh: 与跑道的良好距离是一个滑行距离，你可以从驾驶舱看到机翼下支柱2/3处的跑道来判断。

exact.en: Fly-by-Wire controls will maintain attitude and auto trim so you don't need to make constant manual adjustments
exact.zh: 电传飞行控制将保持姿态和自动配平，因此您不需要不断进行手动调整。

exact.en: Anticipate the wind for your final turn to not overshoot the runway.
exact.zh: 最后一次转弯时要考虑风向风速，以免错过跑道。

exact.en: Most aircraft have a "Take off" level of flaps, so don't forget to adjust them.
exact.zh: 大多数飞机的襟翼默认处于“起飞”高度，记得调整它们。

exact.en: On final approach, you can extend more flaps to increase lift and drag, allowing you to fly slower and land more safely.
exact.zh: 在最后进近时，你可以延展更多襟翼，以增加升阻力，让你飞得更慢，降落更安全。

exact.en: When extending flaps, you need to lower the nose of the aircraft to maintain your speed -- which also makes it easier to see over the nose.
exact.zh: 在延展襟翼时，您需要降低飞机机头以保持速度，这也能使你更容易越过机头看到事物。

exact.en: The instant before landing, lift the airplane's nose in order to further slow the descent rate. This is called the flare. Don't overdo it and balloon, though!
exact.zh: 着陆前的瞬间，抬起飞机的机头，以进一步减慢下降速度。这就是所谓的拉平。不过也不要做得太过火了！

exact.en: In this Training you will learn about the following: 1 - CROSSWIND, 2 - DOWNWIND, 3 - BASE, 4 - FINAL
exact.zh: 在本次培训中，您将了解以下内容：1-二边，2-三边，3-四边，4-五边

exact.en: If the CFD feature is enabled in Assistance Options, a visual representation of air mass flow will be shown around the aircraft during flight.
exact.zh: 如果在辅助选项中启用了CFD功能，则在飞行过程中，飞机周围将以可视化方式显示气团流量。

exact.en: Activate the Tow Plane Assist feature to help stay behind the aerotow during the glider's initial climb.
exact.zh: 激活牵引飞机辅助功能，以帮助滑翔机在初始爬升过程中保持在牵引飞机的后面。

exact.en: Enable visualization of thermals during a flight using the Weather panel, accessed via the toolbar.
exact.zh: 使用可通过工具栏访问的天气仪表盘，实现飞行过程中热气流的可视化。

exact.en: Gamepad users can switch to a bespoke glider control scheme in the Controls Options menu.
exact.zh: 游戏手柄用户可以在控制选项菜单中切换到定制的滑翔机控制方案。

exact.en: With the Free look control, you can control your view to look around and interact with your cockpit.
exact.zh: 通过自由视角控制，您可以控制自己的视角，环顾四周并与驾驶舱进行交互。

exact.en: When flying IFR (instrument flight rules), keep in contact with Air Traffic Control to receive clearances and directions.
exact.zh: 当采用IFR（仪器飞行规则）飞行时，与空中交通管制保持联系，以接收许可和指示。

exact.en: Don't worry, your Training Instructor is there to help throughout the flight.
exact.zh: 别担心，你的训练教练在整个飞行过程中都会提供帮助。

exact.en: Use the Instrument Camera to take a closer look at your instruments.
exact.zh: 使用仪表摄像机仔细观察您的仪表！

exact.en: Always arrive 500 ft at least above the traffic pattern altitude.
exact.zh: 飞行高度始终要在500英尺以上，至少要高于起落航线高度。

exact.en: Some instruments allow multiple interactions -- for example rotating a dial clockwise or counter-clockwise.
exact.zh: 某些仪器允许多种交互，例如顺时针或逆时针旋转表盘。

exact.en: The King Air 350i took to the skies in 2009 with a redesigned interior and improved noise reduction.
exact.zh: 空中国王350i在2009年采取了内部重新设计并改善降噪。

exact.en: To land, the airspeed and the rate of descent are reduced such that the plane descends at a low enough rate to allow for a gentle touch-down.
exact.zh: 着陆时，降低空速和下降速度使飞机以足够低的速度平缓下降。

exact.en: When landing, try to stay aligned with the center line of the runway.
exact.zh: 着陆时尽量与跑道的中心线保持一致。

exact.en: Check you are in landing configuration: speed, flaps extended
exact.zh: 检查您是否处于着陆配置：检查速度，以及襟翼是否已展开。

exact.en: In VFR, use landmarks (airports, roads, rivers) to start the navigation and confirm your position en-route
exact.zh: 在启用目视飞行规则时，使用地标（机场、道路、河流）来启动导航并确认您在途中的位置

exact.en: Use two or three nearby landmarks to confirm your position
exact.zh: 使用附近的两到三个地标来确认您的位置

exact.en: In a "Left-hand pattern" all your turns will be to the left.
exact.zh: 在“左起落航线”中，所有转弯都是左转。

exact.en: The first installment of the Microsoft Flight Simulator series was released in 1982.
exact.zh: Microsoft Flight Simulator 系列的第一款游戏于 1982 年发布。

exact.en: Use the Flight Assistant panel from the toolbar for assistance with navigation, radio communications, or flying the aircraft.
exact.zh: 使用工具栏中的飞行助手面板来协助导航、无线电通信或驾驶飞机。

exact.en: Use the Toolbar during flight to access Maps, Checklists, ATC and more.
exact.zh: 在飞行过程中使用工具栏访问地图、检查表、空中交通管制等。

exact.en: Active Pause lets you freeze the aircraft in its current position while still being able to move the camera or adjust various world settings with the Toolbar.
exact.zh: 动态暂停可以让您飞机在当前位置冻结，同时仍然能够移动摄像机或使用工具栏调整各种世界设置。

exact.en: If you need to take a breath during a thrilling flight, use Active Pause.
exact.zh: 如果您想要在惊心动魄的飞行途中稍事休息一下，请使用动态暂停。

exact.en: You can access a variety of camera angles during flight, both inside the cockpit and outside the plane.
exact.zh: 无论是在驾驶舱内还是在飞机外部，您都可以在飞行过程中查看各种摄像机角度。

exact.en: If you need guidance to control the aircraft, switch Assistance to “All Assists” to enable on-screen notifications at regular intervals during a flight.
exact.zh: 如果您需要指引来控制飞机，请将帮助功能切换到“全程辅助”，以便在飞行期间定期收到屏幕上的通知。

exact.en: The Assistance menu allows you to customize the level of assistance and the types of aircraft errors you receive.
exact.zh: 帮助菜单允许您自定义帮助等级和您收到的飞机错误类型。

exact.en: Try the Flight Training section to learn more about aircraft controls, cameras, cockpit interactions and more.
exact.zh: 尝试进行飞行训练，了解更多有关飞机控制、摄像机、驾驶舱交互等内容。

exact.en: You can fly using an Xbox controller only, connect a keyboard & mouse for cockpit interactions, or supported HOTAS, yokes, and pedals to improve control and immersion. The choice is yours!
exact.zh: 你可以仅使用Xbox手柄来控制飞行，连接键盘鼠标进行驾驶舱交互，或者选择游戏支持的HOTAS、控制杆和踏板以改善控制和沉浸体验。请随意选择！

exact.en: To know at which speed you need to rotate, look for the magenta arrow on the PFD speedtape as you accelerate
exact.zh: 想要了解需要以什么速度进行旋转，请在加速时查找主飞行显示速度带上的品红色箭头

exact.en: During taxi, RPM should be reduced to 1000 RPM or even Idle if needed to slow down the aircraft
exact.zh: 在滑行期间，如果需要飞机减速，那么应将转速降低到1000RPM，甚至怠速。

exact.en: When approaching a runway in heavy crosswinds and a crab, use the rudder just before touch-down to realign yourself with the runway.
exact.zh: 当在强烈的侧风中侧航向跑道进近时，触地前使用方向舵重新调整位置，使机身与跑道对齐。

exact.en: If you can't find your destination airport, contact ATC and ask for directions.
exact.zh: 如果您找不到目的地机场，请联系空中交管并询问方向。

exact.en: The Pitts Special family has dominated worldwide aerobatics for more than 75 years.
exact.zh: 毕氏特制飞机已经主宰了世界特技飞行超75年。

exact.en: The Quickviews are immensely useful -- letting you glance quickly left or right
exact.zh: 快速视图非常有用，这个功能可以让你快速向左或向右看

exact.en: Bespoke Assistance Options are available for helicopters to help control the tail rotor and cyclic.
exact.zh: 直升机具有定制辅助选项，可以帮助控制尾翼和周期变距杆。

exact.en: Gamepad users can switch to a bespoke helicopter control scheme in the Controls Options menu.
exact.zh: 游戏手柄用户可以在控制选项菜单中切换到定制的直升机控制方案。

exact.en: Use the filter view on the World Map to find helipads and heliports.
exact.zh: 使用世界地图上的过滤器视图来查找直升机停机坪和直升机机场。

exact.en: The green range on the tachometer represents the normal operating range
exact.zh: 转速表上的绿色范围表示正常操作范围

exact.en: On the Cessna 152, below the tachometer's green range, you have to pull the carburetor heat to avoid icing and engine failure
exact.zh: 如果时塞斯纳152飞机，如果转速表指示低于绿色范围，那你必须拉动开启化油器加热，以避免结冰和发动机故障
如要爬升，请拉至全油门

exact.en: Reduce the RPM to start a descent
For many planes, steering on the ground is done with the rudder, but some planes use a tiller or even differential braking.
exact.zh: 对于许多飞机来说，地面转向是用方向舵来操控的，但有些飞机使用舵杆，甚至差动刹车来完成地面转向。

exact.en: The rudder pedals are also the braking system. In order to brake, press the upper part of your pedals with your feet.
exact.zh: 方向舵操纵踏板也是制动系统的一部分。如要刹车，请用脚踩踏板的上部。

exact.en: The rudder is located on the vertical tail of the plane, and helps you make a more precise, coordinated turn.
exact.zh: 方向舵位于飞机的垂直尾翼上，可以帮助更精确地转弯。

exact.en: Use the rudder to align the slip indicator to counter the left turn tendency due to prop wash.
exact.zh: 由于螺旋桨涡流，飞机将产生左转弯的倾向。您可以使用方向舵调整侧滑仪读数来对抗这种倾向。

exact.en: Use the rudder to turn your aircraft while taxiing on the ground.
exact.zh: 在地面滑行时用方向舵操纵飞机转向。

exact.en: The Smart Cam system helps you find nearby Points of Interest such as airports or landmarks, don't hesitate to use it.
exact.zh: 智能摄像系统可帮助您找到附近的兴趣点，如机场或地标，不要犹豫，用用看。

exact.en: The Cirrus SR-22 has been the best-selling GA aircraft in its class for most of the 21st century.
exact.zh: 西锐SR22飞机在21世纪很长时间内都占据了同类飞机中最畅销GA型飞机的宝座。

exact.en: The stall speed increases with bank angle.
exact.zh: 失速速度随倾斜角的增大而增大。

exact.en: Stall speed is slowest speed a plane can fly to maintain level flight.
exact.zh: 失速速度是飞机保持平直飞行所需的最低速度。

exact.en: Your plane's attitude and engine power together translate into overall aircraft performance.
exact.zh: 您的飞机姿态和引擎功率共同表现为当前的整体性能。

exact.en: During the Initial Climb, you should maintain the runway heading.
exact.zh: 在起始爬升过程中，应保持航向与跑道方向一致。

exact.en: Taking off is easier than landing, but it can still be dangerous if you don't pay attention to your surroundings.
exact.zh: 起飞比着陆要容易，但如果不注意周围环境，仍然也很危险。

exact.en: The Daher TBM 930 was introduced in 2016 with an enhanced avionics system and an upgraded interior.
exact.zh: Daher TBM930于2016年推出，装配有更强劲的航空电子设备，内饰也全新升级。

exact.en: Single-lever power control and auto-starter shutoff make the Daher TBM 930 one of the simplest PT6A-powered aircraft to manage.
exact.zh: 单杆功率控制和自动启动关闭使达赫TBM 930成为最简单的PT6A动力飞机之一。

exact.en: The Daher TBM 930 has a maximum demonstrated crosswind component of 20 knots.
exact.zh: Daher TBM930的最大侧风分量为20节。

exact.en: The Daher TBM 930 can climb to its certified service ceiling of 31,000 ft in just over 18 minutes.
exact.zh: Daher TBM930可以在18分钟内爬到31000英尺的实用升限。

exact.en: While maintaining the same attitude, reducing the throttle will lower your altitude.
exact.zh: 保持相同姿态并减小油门会降低你的飞行高度。

exact.en: The toolbar is a quick access menu, on top of your screen, that allows you to control various aspects of the simulation.
exact.zh: 屏幕顶端的“工具栏”是快速访问菜单，您可以通过工具栏来控制模拟的各项内容。

exact.en: You should land on the main 2 wheels first.
The trim helps you maintain a desired attitude
exact.zh: 配平有助于飞机保持理想的姿态

exact.en: The trim wheel moves the trim tab at the end of the elevator
exact.zh: 配平板操作手轮用于移动升降舵末端的配平调整片

exact.en: Regular turns are below 30° of bank
For a perfect turn, coordinate yoke control with rudder to keep the sideslip ball centered
exact.zh: 想要完美转弯，请用方向舵协调共轭控制，以保持侧滑球处于中心位置

exact.en: Horizon position relative to the aircraft, or attitude, is also important in turns: try to remember your attitude at 20° of bank
exact.zh: 相对于飞机的地平线位置，或者说是姿态，在转弯时也很重要：试一试记住你在倾斜20°时的姿态

exact.en: A normal turn is up to 30° of bank.
Training missions teach new techniques, but you will need to practice on your own in order to perfect them.
exact.zh: 训练任务会教授你新的技巧，但需要您加以练习才能完善。

exact.en: 1 - AILERON, 2 - FLAPS, 3 - RUDDER, 4 - ELEVATOR, 5 - TRIM ELEVATOR
exact.zh: 1-副翼，2-襟翼，3-方向舵，4-升降舵，5-升降舵配平

exact.en: "Broken clouds" describes a cloud layer that covers between 5 and 7 eighths of the sky.
exact.zh: “疏松云层”描述的是覆盖天空5/8至7/8的云层。

exact.en: "Few clouds" describes a cloud layer that covers between 1 and 2 eighths of the sky.
exact.zh: “稀薄云层”描述的是覆盖天空1/8至2/8的云层。

exact.en: There are three main forms of high-level clouds: Cirrus, Cirrostratus and Cirrocumulus.
exact.zh: 高层云主要有三种形式：卷云、毛卷层云和絮状卷积云。

exact.en: You can set the weather you like, or use the Live Weather for more realism.
exact.zh: 你可以设定你喜欢的天气，或者使用实时天气来获得更多的真实感。

exact.en: Overcast conditions describe a cloud layer that covers the entire sky.
exact.zh: “阴天”描述的是覆盖整个天空的云层。

exact.en: "Scattered clouds" describes a cloud layer that covers between 3 and 4 eighths of the sky.
exact.zh: “零散云层”描述的是覆盖天空3/8至4/8的云层。

exact.en: Clear blue skies are perfect flying conditions, but beware of cloud formations.
exact.zh: 晴朗的蓝天是完美的飞行条件，但要注意云的形态。

exact.en: Mind the wind direction and speed to correct the heading and stay on track
exact.zh: 注意风向和风速，以纠正航向，并保持正轨

exact.en: Wind direction and speed varies with the altitude
exact.zh: 风向和风速随海拔高度而变化

exact.en: To control the plane, a plug-in yoke or joystick can make a huge difference!
exact.zh: 要控制飞机，外接控制杆或摇杆都可以大大改善你的体验！

exact.en: The yoke is like a steering wheel; you can turn, but you can also pitch.
exact.zh: 外接控制杆就像方向盘；你可以利用它让飞机转弯，也可以调整飞机的俯仰角。

exact.en: Akureyri Airport is a small single-runway international airport located in northern Iceland.
exact.zh: 阿库雷里机场是一个位于冰岛北部的小型单跑道国际机场。

exact.en: As with the rest of Iceland, Ísafjörður experiences high winds and very few clear days throughout the year.
exact.zh: 和冰岛其他地方一样，伊萨菲尔德全年大风，鲜有晴朗的日子。

exact.en: Lynden Pindling International Airport is the largest airport in the Bahamas.
exact.zh: 林丁平德林国际机场是巴哈马最大的机场。

exact.en: Adjacent to Renton Municipal Airport, you can find the Boeing Renton Factory.
exact.zh: 你可以在毗邻伦顿市政机场之地找到伦顿波音工厂。

exact.en: North of Renton, you can find Microsoft headquarters in Redmond.
exact.zh: 你可以在伦顿以北的雷蒙德找到微软总部。

exact.en: The International Terminal of SFO is the largest one in North America and the largest building in the world built on base isolators to protect against earthquakes
exact.zh: 旧金山国际机场的国际航站楼是北美最大的航站楼，也是世界上基于基础隔离器的最大防震建筑。

exact.en: SFO was one of the first U.S. airports to conduct a residential sound abatement retrofitting program
exact.zh: 旧金山国际机场是美国最早实施住宅消声改造计划的机场之一。

exact.en: SFO Museum is the first museum in an International Airport.
exact.zh: 旧金山国际机场博物馆是第一个位于国际机场中的博物馆。

exact.en: San Francisco is the highest rated American city on World Liveability rankings.
exact.zh: 旧金山是世界宜居城市中排名最高的美国城市。

exact.en: Don't worry, the copilot will help all along the flight!
exact.zh: 别担心，副驾驶会在整个飞行过程中协助你！

exact.en: WARNING: You are moving too far away from the flight plan. Please follow the correct direction.
exact.zh: 警告：你已严重偏离飞行计划。请按正确方向飞行。

exact.en: Be conscious of the remaining fuel onboard before deviating from your route.
exact.zh: 在偏离航线之前，请注意飞机剩余的燃油。

exact.en: As part of routine in-flight checks, the Heading Indicator should be manually realigned with the compass heading every ten to fifteen minutes.
exact.zh: 作为例行飞行检查的一部分，航向指示器应每十到十五分钟与指指南针朝向重新手动对准一次。

exact.en: Rule of thumb : For each degree off your route, over a distance of 60 Nautical Miles (NM), it will result in 1 NM off course
exact.zh: 一条经验法则：每偏离航线一度超过60海里（NM），将导致偏离航线1海里

exact.en: Don't forget to log your time at each waypoint to keep track of your ETE (Estimated Time En-Route) between them.
exact.zh: 别忘了记录每个航路点的时间，以便跟踪它们之间的预计时间（ETE）。

exact.en: When approaching an airport for landing, the traffic pattern should be entered at a 45° angle to the downwind leg.
exact.zh: 当进近机场准备着陆时，应以45°角进入三边。

exact.en: During a complete Traffic Pattern, the name of the different legs are: Crosswind, Downwind, Base, and Final Approach.
exact.zh: 在完整的起落航线中，不同边的名称分别是：一边、二边、三边和最终边（五边）。

exact.en: Under normal conditions, the usual takeoff speed of a fully-loaded jumbo jet is around 160 knots.
exact.zh: 在正常情况下，满载的大型喷气式飞机通常起飞速度为160节左右。

exact.en: Follow each step on the checklist to begin the pre-flight sequence.
exact.zh: 按照检查单上的步骤逐一开始飞行准备程序。

exact.en: To have the AI Co-Pilot complete the checklist process, enable Assisted Checklist in the Assistance menu, then choose the Auto-Complete option in the Checklist panel.
exact.zh: 要让AI副驾驶完成检查表流程，请在协助菜单中启用辅助清单，然后在“清单”面板中选择自动完成选项。

exact.en: The TBM 930 has a maximum demonstrated crosswind component of 20 kts.
You can go anywhere in the world!
exact.zh: 你可以去到世界上任何角落！

exact.en: Go to Chamonix to fly over Mont Blanc!
exact.zh: 去查莫尼克斯飞越勃朗峰吧！

exact.en: Active Pause lets you freeze the aircraft in its current position while still able to move the camera or adjust world settings.
exact.zh: 动态暂停可以让您飞机在当前位置冻结，同时仍然能够移动摄像机或使用工具栏调整各项世界设置。

exact.en: Flying during VFR weather minimums requires extra pilot attention.
exact.zh: 在目视飞行规则规定的最低天气条件下飞行要求飞行员格外注意。

exact.en: Use ground details such as buildings and vegetation for reference when flying VFR.
exact.zh: 按目视飞行规则飞行时，请参照建筑物和植被等地物细节。

exact.en: Communicate with ATC at Hollywood-Burbank before initiating a landing.
exact.zh: 在开始着陆前与好莱坞-伯班克的空管联系。

exact.en: Turning inside a pylon, or having any part of the aircraft over a pylon, constitutes a Pylon Cut. During Qualification, you will not register a time. During Race, a time penalty will be added to your total time at the end (final ranking is based on time).
exact.zh: 飞进塔架内侧，或飞机任何部分越过了塔架上方，将被视为越塔违例。资格赛中越塔违例，将使您的单圈时间无效。决赛时越塔违例，比赛结束时您的总时间将被加上处罚时间（最终排名以结算后时间确定）。

exact.en: Aircraft must remain below the maximum altitude of 250 feet AGL at all times. Waypoint markers above the Pylons are placed at this altitude for guidance.
exact.zh: 比赛时最大飞行高度为离地250英尺，参赛飞机必须时刻处于该限制高度以下。塔架上方的导航点标记高度即为该限制高度，以供参考。

exact.en: Biplanes Class races begin on the ground, with a staggered starting grid taking off at 4-second intervals. This time handicap is subtracted from the total time at the end of the race.
exact.zh: 双翼机级别比赛从地面开始，参赛飞机排在交错的出发机位上，以4秒为间隔依次起飞。比赛结束时，将从各参赛机的总时间里减去出发延迟时间。

exact.en: When in the Race lobby, access the Race Settings tab to adjust visual assistances, such as highlighting Pylons or on-screen HUD visibility.
exact.zh: 位于比赛大厅时，可以打开“比赛设置”选项各种调整视觉辅助功能，如高亮显示塔架、屏幕HUD能见度。

exact.zh: 无法创建缓存父路径：%s。需要以具有写入权限的用户身份登录。目标磁盘可能已满或被设为只读，也可能已有同名文件存在。点击“放弃”以退出。

exact.en:
Brand-new Marketplace with:
  • New Layout: to allow simpler and more streamlined navigation.
  • New Categories and Filters: to help find content of interest more quickly and easily.
  • New Rating System: to distinguish scores for visual quality, technical quality, and realism.

全新的市场包括：
  • 新的布局：助力更简单和更流畅的导航。
  • 新的类别和过滤器：帮助更快更容易找到感兴趣的内容。
  • 新的评级系统：区分视觉质量、技术质量和逼真度的分数。

exact.en:
You will be able to:
  • Rent an item for limited periods of time, with the option to purchase for a discounted price.*
  • Gift an item or virtual currency to a friend.
  • Stream content upon rental or purchase, without having to wait for a download to complete.

*Available for all Microsoft content, but non-Microsoft developers need to opt into this feature for their content.
exact.zh:
您将能够：
  • 在有限时间内租赁一件物品，并可选择以折扣价购买。*
  • 赠予朋友一件物品或虚拟货币。
  • 在租赁或购买后即可播放内容，无需等待下载完成。

*适用于所有Microsoft内容，但非Microsoft开发人员需要为其内容选择此功能。

exact.en:
• Automatically access owned MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024 content in My Library, with a few exceptions.*
  • Content will automatically be Streamed through the Internet, allowing faster access to purchased items on the Marketplace.
  • My Library also offers the option to locally install items if desired.

*A small number of MSFS 2020 content may not be compatible with MSFS 2024.
exact.zh:
• 自动访问“我的游戏库”中拥有的 MSFS 2020 和 MSFS 2024 内容，但有一些例外。*
  • 内容将自动通过互联网进行传输，从而可以更快地访问市场上的已购项目。
  • “我的游戏库”还可根据需要在本地安装项目。

*少量的 MSFS 2020 内容可能与 MSFS 2024 不兼容。

exact.en: Fly a commercial airline route anywhere in the world
exact.zh: 在世界各地进行商业航线飞行

exact.zh: 进行各种F/A-18的活动来庆祝《壮志凌云：独行侠》上映

exact.en: Bush Trip adventures across open country.

exact.en: The basic steps to handle an aircraft.
Get to grips with the skills required for gravel runways, mountain flying and water operations.
exact.zh: 掌握砾石跑道起降、山地飞行和水上作业所需的技能。

exact.en: Once you lose your visual references you are forced to rely on your cockpit instruments. Learn how to find your way even after the clouds have rolled in.
exact.zh: 失去视觉参照时，飞行员能依靠的便只有驾驶舱仪器。学习如何在浮云蔽目时找到自己的路吧。

exact.en: Learn how to maneuver around an airport, enter a runway, and take to the skies.
exact.zh: 学习如何在机场内机动，如何进入跑道，以及如何飞向天空。

exact.en: How to safely approach an airport and follow a predictable pattern prior to landing.

exact.en: Learn about Visual Flight Rules (VFR) and how to use the outside world to navigate.

exact.en: Assign the notation "Heavy" to your call sign. This is used in ATC communication to quickly indicate larger aircraft which require longer runways and cause more wake turbulence.
exact.zh: 将“重型”附加到您飞机的呼号中。这将用于ATC通信中，以快速识别需求更长跑道、会引起更多尾流紊流的大型飞机。

exact.en: Assign a call sign for your aircraft. This will be used in radio communications with Air Traffic Control.
exact.zh: 为您的飞机分配一个呼号，该呼号将用于与空中交通管制的无线电通信。

exact.en: Adjust the maximum deflection angle by up to 2 degrees (positive or negative) to refine the elevator authority.
exact.zh: 调节升降舵的最大偏斜角度，以改进升降舵效能，至多2度（正或负）。

exact.en: Adjust control surface authorities and aspects of the aircraft's flight model.
exact.zh: 调整控制面限度和飞机飞行模型的方方面面。

exact.en: Create a flight number for your flight plan.
exact.zh: 为您的飞行计划创建一个航班号

exact.en: Adjust the maximum deflection angle by up to 2 degrees (positive or negative) to refine the rudder authority.
exact.zh: 调整方向舵的最大偏斜角度，至多2度（正或负），以改进方向舵效能。

exact.zh: 设置是否需要在飞行过程中将其他飞机的机尾编号显示在屏幕上。

exact.en: Assign a tail number for your aircraft. This will appear on the aircraft exterior.
exact.zh: 为您的飞机分配一个机尾编号。改编号将显示在飞机外部。

exact.en: Simulate the aircraft's performance degradation due to wear and tear by adding up to 10% parasite drag
exact.zh: 通过增加最多10%废阻力，模拟因磨损导致的飞机性能损失。

exact.en: Adjust the air flow visualization settings.
Choose one of the preset Assistance options. Changing this will affect all other settings below.
exact.zh: 选择一个预设的辅助选项。更改此设置将影响下面所有设置。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior for Focus mode.

Hold: Hold the input to enter Focus mode. Release the input to reset camera POV.

Toggle: Tap the input once to enter Focus mode. Tap the input a second time to reset camera POV.
exact.zh:
设置聚焦模式的默认行为。

按住：按住按键进入聚焦模式。松开按键重设摄像机POV。

切换：按键一次进入聚焦模式。再按键一次重设摄像机POV。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior for Free Look mode.

Hold: Hold the input to enter Free Look mode. Release the input to reset camera POV.

Toggle: Tap the input once to enter Free Look mode. Tap the input a second time to reset camera POV.
exact.zh:
设置自由视角模式的默认行为。

按住：按住按键进入自由视角模式。松开按键重设摄像机POV。

切换：按键一次进入自由视角模式。再按键一次重设摄像机POV。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior for Head Up mode.

Hold: Hold the input to enter Head Up mode. Release the input to reset camera POV.

Toggle: Tap the input once to enter Head Up mode. Tap the input a second time to reset camera POV.
exact.zh:
设置抬头模式的默认行为。

按住：按住按键进入抬头模式。松开按键重设摄像机POV。

切换：按键一次进入抬头模式。再按键一次重设摄像机POV。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior for Instrument View mode.

Auto: Enables mouse navigation; if cursor is close to a screen border it will automatically trigger the next Instrument View in that direction.

Manual: User must utilize dedicated inputs to navigate to the next or previous Instrument View.
exact.zh:
设置仪表视图模式的默认行为。

自动：启用鼠标导览；如果光标接近屏幕边缘，将自动切换至该方向的下一个仪表视图。

手动：用户需结合使用有关按键才能切换至其它仪表视图。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior for Instrument View mode.

Hold: Hold the input to enter Instrument View mode. Release the input to reset camera POV.

Toggle: Tap the input once to enter Instrument View mode. Tap the input a second time to reset camera POV.
exact.zh:
设置仪表视图模式的默认行为。

按住：按住按键进入仪表视图。松开按键重设摄像机POV。

切换：按键一次进入仪表视图。再按键一次重设摄像机POV。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior to reset External camera POV while in Free Look mode.

Auto: External camera will reset to its default position when user exits Free Look mode.

Manual: External camera remains in its current position when user exits Free Look mode.
exact.zh:
设置自由视角模式中重设驾驶舱摄像机POV的默认行为。

自动：退出自由视角模式时，驾驶舱摄像机将回到默认位置。

手动：退出自由视角模式时，驾驶舱摄像机将保持在当前位置。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior to reset Cockpit camera POV while in Free Look mode.

Auto: Cockpit camera will reset to its default position when user exits Free Look mode.

Manual: Cockpit camera remains in its current position when user exits Free Look mode.
exact.zh:
设置自由视角模式中重设驾驶舱摄像机POV的默认行为。

自动：退出自由视角模式时，驾驶舱摄像机将回到默认位置。

手动：退出自由视角模式时，驾驶舱摄像机将保持在当前位置。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior for Quick View function.

Hold: Hold the input to enter Quick View mode. Release the input to reset camera POV.

Toggle: Tap the input once to enter Quick View mode. Tap the input a second time to reset camera POV.
exact.zh:
设置快速查看功能的默认行为。

按住：按住按键进入快速查看模式。松开按键重设摄像机POV。

切换：按键一次进入快速查看模式。再按键一次重设摄像机POV。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior for Smart Camera mode.

Hold: Hold the input to enter Smart Camera mode. Release the input to reset camera POV.

Toggle: Tap the input once to enter Smart Camera mode. Tap the input a second time to reset camera POV.
exact.zh:
设置智能摄像机模式的默认行为。

按住：按住按键进入智能摄像机。松开按键重设摄像机POV。

exact.en:
Set the default behavior for Zoom function.

Manual: Use dedicated inputs to zoom-in/zoom-out.

Focus: Enable Focus mode. {STR_COCKPIT_FOCUS} in cockpit camera or {STR_CHASE_FOCUS} in external camera to zoom into the center of the screen. If an instrument is targeted in Free Look, the camera will switch automatically to the associated instrument view.
exact.zh:
设置缩放功能的默认行为逻辑。

手动：使用指定的输入操作来进行缩放。

聚焦：启用聚焦模式。在驾驶舱视角下按 {STR_COCKPIT_FOCUS} 或在外部视角下按 {STR_CHASE_FOCUS} 放大屏幕中心。若在“自由视角”下将准心对准某仪表，镜头将自动切至该仪表的特写视图。

exact.en: Set the Flashlight mode to Auto or Manual.
exact.zh: 将手电筒模式设置为自动或手动。

exact.en: Enable developer mode. This is intended for developers of custom add-ons to be able to create and debug their own packages, and enabling it may have unintended consequences for regular users.
exact.zh: 启用开发者模式。该模式是为了让自定义附加内容的开发者能创建自己的封包、且对其进行除错。若启用，或会对一般用户造成意外后果。

exact.en:
Enable Home Cockpit mode.
This places the camera in the center of the cockpit and disables the virtual cockpit from rendering.
exact.zh:
启用家庭驾驶舱模式。
这将把摄像机置于驾驶舱中心，并停止渲染虚拟驾驶舱。

exact.en: Set default camera view used during flight.
exact.zh: 设置飞行期间使用的默认摄像机视图。

exact.en:
Set default position for Cockpit Camera.

Landing: Camera is positioned slightly above the cockpit's board. Allows for a good view of the surroundings but no view of the instruments.

Wide Angle: Camera is positioned close to the pilot's seat. Allows for a view of both the surroundings and the instruments, although Instruments may be difficult to read at distance.

Close: Camera is positioned close to the cockpit's board. Allows for a good view of the instruments but obscured view of most of the surroundings.

HUD : Camera is focused on the plane's HUD if available. If there's no HUD available in the selected plane, the default camera will fall back on the wide angle option instead.
exact.zh:
为驾驶舱镜头设置默认位置。

着陆：镜头略高于驾驶舱控制面板。方便环顾周围环境，但无法看到仪表。

广角：镜头靠近飞行员座椅。可以同时观察周边环境与仪表，但可能因距离较远而难以看清仪表读数。

接近：镜头靠近驾驶舱控制面板。可以很好地观察仪表，但几乎看不清周围情况。

HUD：镜头会尽可能集中在飞机的HUD上。如果选择的飞机没有HUD面板，则默认镜头会回到广角选项。

Shows all available inputs for the selected device.
Click an input name to assign it to the action.
Toggle switches deactivate individual inputs (preventing accidental input).
Assignment Field: Located at the top of the list. Click to scan for Input.
exact.zh:
显示所选设备的所有可用输入。
点击输入名称以将其分配至该动作。
切换开关可停用单个输入（防止意外输入）。
分配区域：位于列表顶部。点击以扫描并输入。

exact.en:
Input Repetition: Set (press once) or Repeat (hold).
Delayed Input: Requires holding the input for 2 seconds.
Set Control on Release: Triggers the action on input release.
Set Inverted Axis: Reverses axis direction.
Input Value: Set a custom output value (default: 1). Smaller values = finer control.
Device Input Curve Override: Enable/disable the action-specific input curve. OFF uses the hardware curve.
Tweak Action Curve: Open the curve editor for this action.
Primary/Secondary: Switch between primary and secondary mappings.
Conflicts Panel: List of actions that have the same mapping input than the current action.
exact.zh:
输入重复：设置（按一次）或重复（按住）。
延迟输入：需要按住输入2秒。
释放时设置控制：释放输入时触发动作。
设置反转轴：反转轴的方向。
输入值：设置自定义输出值（默认：1）。值越小，控制越精细。
设备输入曲线超控：启用/禁用特定动作的输入曲线。关闭时使用硬件曲线。
调整动作曲线：打开该动作的曲线编辑器。
主/次：在主映射和次映射之间切换。
冲突面板：与当前动作具有相同映射输入的动作列表。

exact.en: Shows a visual representation of the input response curve.
exact.zh: 直观显示输入响应曲线。

exact.en:
Sensitivity + / Sensitivity -: Adjust overall responsiveness.
Neutral: Adjust the center point.
Dead Zone: Ignore small movements around the center.
Extremity Dead Zone: Ignore input at the extreme ends of the axis.
exact.zh:
灵敏度+/灵敏度-：调整整体响应速度。
居中：调整中心点。
死区：忽略中心附近的小幅移动。
极限死区：忽略轴端的输入。

exact.en:

exact.zh: 警告：此操作不建议选用按键输入。

exact.en: Displays all available in-game actions, organized by category (e.g., Flight Control Surfaces, Engine). Click an action to assign inputs to it.
exact.zh: 显示所有可用的游戏内动作，按类别划分（例如，飞行控制面、发动机）。点击一个动作进行输入。

exact.en:
To assign a control to an action:
Select the action in the Actions List.
Click on an empty assignment slot ("Primary" or "Secondary"). The slot will show "Scanning...".
Press the desired button/key, or move the desired axis on your selected device. The input will be automatically detected.
You can map the same input to multiple actions, but be aware that they will all trigger simultaneously.
exact.zh:
要为动作指定操作：
在动作列表中选择该动作。
点击一个空的分配栏位（“主要”或“次要”）。该栏位将显示“扫描中...”。
按下所需的按钮/键位，或在所选设备上移动用到的轴。即可自动检测输入。
你可以将相同的输入映射到多个动作，但请注意，它们将同时触发。

exact.en:
General: These actions apply to all aircraft.
Aircraft Category: These actions are specific to a type of aircraft.
Aircraft Specific: These actions are unique to a particular aircraft model.
exact.zh:
通用：这些动作适用于所有飞机。
飞机类别：这些动作专门用于某种类型的飞机。
特定飞机：这些动作针对特定飞机型号。

exact.en: Select the aircraft to configure. Control settings are specific to each aircraft.
exact.zh: 请选择要配置的飞机。每款飞机都具有特定的控制设置。

exact.en: See in real time what input is active on the selected device.
exact.zh: 实时查看所选设备上生效的输入。

exact.en: Select the input device (Mouse, Keyboard, Controller, Joystick, etc.) you want to configure.
exact.zh: 选择要配置的输入设备 (鼠标、键盘、控制器、摇杆等 )。

exact.en: Select the input device (Mouse, Keyboard, DualSense® controller, Joystick, etc.) you want to configure.
exact.zh: 选择要配置的输入设备 (鼠标、键盘、DualSense®控制器、操作杆等 )。

exact.en: Access settings for device-level input curves (sensitivity, dead zones). These settings affect all actions using that device's axes as opposed to action curves that only affect their associated action.
exact.zh: 访问设备级输入曲线的设置（灵敏度、死区）。这些设置会影响使用该设备轴的所有动作，而不是仅影响其关联的动作曲线。

exact.en: Configure control inputs (buttons, keys, axes) for your connected devices and each aircraft. Settings are saved per aircraft, allowing for customized control schemes. The main screen provides access to device selection, preset management, action mapping, and filtering.
exact.zh: 配置已连接设备和所有飞机的控制器输入（按钮、按键、轴）。设置按飞机保存，允许设置自定义控制方案。主屏幕提供了设备选择、预设管理、动作映射和筛选的访问内容。

exact.en: Allow to manage presets : create, duplicate, rename, etc.
exact.zh: 允许管理预设：创建、复制、重命名等。

exact.en: Choose a pre-defined control mapping (a "preset") for the selected device and aircraft. Presets provide a starting point for your configuration.
exact.zh: 为所选设备和飞机选择预定义的控制映射（“预设”）。预设为配置提供了一个起点。

exact.en: Find specific actions by typing their name, or by pressing the input (button, key, axis) you want to assign.
exact.zh: 通过键入动作名称或按下要分配的输入（按钮、按键、轴）来查找特定动作。

exact.en: Adjust the amount of data bandwidth being used at any time. If this is set to Unlimited, Microsoft Flight Simulator will attempt to make full use of your internet bandwidth.
exact.zh: 随时调整游戏所使用的数据带宽。如果设置为无限，Microsoft Flight Simulator 将尝试充分使用您的网络带宽。

exact.en: Determines which data services you are connected to. Actual usage is determined by flight settings and features used.
exact.zh: 决定您会连接到哪些数据服务。实际使用情况将根据飞行设置和使用功能而决定。

exact.en: See how much data is being used by Flight Simulator on a monthly basis.
exact.zh: 查看 Flight Simulator 每月使用了多少网络流量。

exact.en: Limit how much data Microsoft Flight Simulator can use per month.
exact.zh: 限制 Microsoft Flight Simulator 每月可以使用多少网络流量。
实时现实世界空中交通

exact.en: Connect to live air traffic services.
exact.zh: 连接空中交通实况服务。

exact.en: Allows you to save 3D photogrammetry data, elevation map data, and the online vegetation mask of an area of your choosing to your local hard drive.
exact.zh: 允许您将3D摄影测绘数据、高程图数据、您选定区域的线上植被数据保存到本地硬盘中。

exact.en: Allows you to save 3D photogrammetry data, elevation map data, and the online vegetation mask of an area of your choosing to your console storage.
exact.zh: 允许你将自选区域的3D摄影测绘数据、高程图数据、在线植被蒙版保存至你的主机存储空间。

exact.en: Connect to multiplayer services. Other players you see in flight are determined by your Flight Conditions.
exact.zh: 连接到多人游戏服务。您的飞行条件决定了您在飞行时将如何看到其它玩家。

exact.en: Your current Xbox settings prevent you from playing online multiplayer.
exact.zh: 当前Xbox设置已阻止您参与在线多人游戏。

exact.en: Adjust whether you want to allow internet connectivity during your session.
exact.zh: 设置是否希望在使用程序期间连接到互联网。

exact.en: Stream photo-realistic 3D buildings in supported areas (potentially gigabytes of data).
exact.zh: 在支持区域流式传输相片级真实的3D建筑物数据（可能会消耗数GB网络流量）。

exact.en: Set a day of the month to reset data tracking, for example if you have a metered internet connection that resets on a specific date each month.
exact.zh: 设定一天作为每月重置网络流量统计的日子，例如选择您可用流量重置的那天。

exact.en: This will delete your currently selected rolling cache file. Note that the rolling cache option will also be turned off, and will have to be turned back on to create or select a new file.
exact.zh: 这将删除您当前选定的滚动缓存文件。注意这样做的同时也会关闭滚动缓存选项，必须重新打开此选项，才能创建新或选择新的缓存文件。

exact.en: Enable rolling cache functionality, which allows information to be stored on your system for quicker access.
exact.zh: 启用滚动缓存功能，这将使存储在系统中的信息的访问速度更快。

exact.en: Set a limit for rolling cache on your local hard drive.
exact.zh: 设置本地硬盘中的滚动缓存上限。

exact.en: Set a limit for rolling cache on your console storage.
exact.zh: 设置主机存储空间的滚动缓存上限。

exact.en: Set a location for rolling cache on your local hard drive.
exact.zh: 在本地硬盘上设置滚动缓存的存储位置

exact.en: Ability to cache streamed data on your hard disk while you are flying.
exact.zh: 飞行时将流式数据缓存至硬盘中的功能。

exact.en: Set a level at which you wish to be warned about monthly data usage.
exact.zh: 设置每月网络数据用量达到多少时会发出警告。

exact.en: Stream high-quality aerial imagery (potentially gigabytes of data).
exact.zh: 流式传输高质量航空图像（可能使用数GB网络流量）。

exact.en: Adjust the default starting time for flights, using Universal Time Coordinated (UTC).
exact.zh: 使用通用时间（协调世界时）协调航班的默认启动时间。

exact.en: You will be redirected to the Title Screen. All option settings (General, Experience and Controls) will be reset to default values. Confirm?
exact.zh: 你将重新回到到标题画面。所有选项设置（通用、体验和控件）将被重置为默认值。确认执行此操作吗？

exact.en: Switches between DirectX 11 and DirectX 12. DirectX 11: the default graphics API DirectX 12 (BETA): new graphics API. DirectX 12 support is currently in development and can show performance and GPU memory utilization regressions compared to DirectX 11. Due to higher GPU memory consumption, the simulator may be oversubscribing memory, which negatively impacts performance. Lowering graphics settings can help avoid this situation.
exact.zh: 在DirectX 11和DirectX 12之间切换。DirectX 11：默认显卡API；DirectX 12 (BETA)：新的显卡API。DirectX 12支持目前正在开发中，与DirectX 11相比，它可以显示性能和GPU内存利用率回归。由于GPU内存消耗较高，模拟器可能会超额订用内存，从而对性能产生负面影响。降低显卡设置有助于避免这种情况。

exact.en:
Switch between DirectX 11 and DirectX 12.

The VR mode is not compatible yet with DirectX 12.
exact.zh:
在DirectX 11和DirectX 12之间切换。

VR模式尚未与DirectX 12兼容。
阅读支持文档与版本说明

exact.en: Adjust the rotation speed of the first person camera.
exact.zh: 调整第一人称镜头的旋转速度。

exact.en: No air or marine traffic will be displayed in the sim.
exact.zh: 模拟飞行中将不会显示任何空中或海上交通。

exact.en: Air and marine traffic will be set to pre-existing patterns. Their density can be modified in the Options menu.
exact.zh: 空中和海上交通将遵循预设模式运行。其密度可在“选项”菜单中调整。

exact.en: When All players is selected, every player with their Multiplayer ON will be visible.
exact.zh: 选择“所有玩家”时，系统将显示所有已开启“多人游戏”模式的玩家。

exact.en: Live players are only available in Live Weather & Time, and only if you don’t change the time of day. When selected, you will only see live players while flying.
exact.zh: “实时玩家”仅在启用“实时天气与时间”且未手动更改当天时间的情况下生效。选择后，你在飞行时只会看到实时玩家。

exact.en: Air and marine traffic specifics such as aicraft and boat type, location and behavior in the sim will be based on live data.
exact.zh: 模拟飞行中的空中和海上交通细节（例如飞机和船只类型、位置与行为）将基于实时数据。

exact.en: No other players will be visible, except for group members.
exact.zh: 除了小组成员，其他玩家将不可见。

exact.en: Customize the exact weather parameters for a flight.
exact.zh: 自定义飞行的具体天气参数。

exact.en: Use the history time slider to go back over the last 24 hours with real-time weather data. Once a flight plan is set, the time slider automatically updates to the local time at your flight’s location.
exact.zh: 使用历史时间滑块回溯过去24小时的实时天气数据。设置飞行计划后，时间滑块会自动更新为航班所在位置的当地时间。

exact.en: Set any time, date, and weather preset you like. The Live Weather preset will only use the current weather and cannot access weather data from the past 24 hours.
exact.zh: 设置你喜欢的任何时间、日期和天气预设。实时天气预设将仅使用当前天气，无法访问过去24小时的天气数据。

exact.en: Step into the pilot's seat of a Boeing 737-8 Max.
exact.zh: 坐上波音737-8 Max的飞行员位置。

exact.en: Take to the skies in a classic Cessna 152
exact.zh: 驾驶经典的塞斯纳152飞上蓝天

exact.en: Learn fundamental skills and techniques to fly like a professional
exact.zh: 学习基本技能和技巧，像专业人士一样飞行

exact.en: One or more required items are missing. Go to the Marketplace to acquire them.
exact.zh: 一个或多个必需物品缺失。请去市场获取它们。

exact.en: Your version of Microsoft Flight Simulator is outdated. Restart and update the sim to access multiplayer modes.
exact.zh: 您的 Microsoft Flight Simulator 版本过旧。 请重启并更新软件，以便使用多人游戏模式。

exact.en: These settings are affected by the Global Rendering Quality setting above.
exact.zh: 上面的全局渲染质量选项会影响这些设置。

exact.en: Selects the best DLSS Mode for the current output resolution.
exact.zh: 选择当前输出分辨率的最佳DLSS模式。

exact.en: Offers both optimized performance and image quality.
Alternative location for DLAA if not in Anti-Aliasing setting
exact.zh: 未采用抗锯齿设置时的DLAA替代位置

exact.en: Offers a higher performance boost than balanced mode.
exact.zh: 与平衡模式相比，性能更高。

exact.en: Offers a higher image quality than balanced mode.
exact.zh: 与平衡模式相比，图像质量更高。

exact.en: Offers the highest performance boost. Recommend for 8k gameplay only.
exact.zh: 将性能提升到最高，仅推荐用于8K游戏。
将图像质量提升到最高。

exact.en: Dynamic Settings will adjust settings automatically to maintain target frame rate.
exact.zh: 动态设置将自动调节设置，以保持目标帧率。

exact.en:
Enable or disable anti-aliasing and choose from different anti-aliasing methods.

TAA: Temporal Anti-Aliasing.

NVIDIA DLSS 4: uses AI to produce higher resolution frames from lower resolution inputs. This feature requires a GeForce RTX graphics card.

AMD FSR 4: uses AI to produce higher resolution frames from lower resolution inputs (uses FSR 3 if your GPU is not supported).
exact.zh:
启用或禁用抗锯齿，并可选择不同的抗锯齿方法。

TAA：时序抗锯齿。

NVIDIA DLSS 4：利用AI技术，将低分辨率输入生成更高分辨率画面。该功能需要GeForce RTX显卡。

AMD FSR 4：利用AI技术，将低分辨率输入生成更高分辨率画面（如果GPU不支持，则使用FSR 3）。

exact.en: Adjust the quantity for airports services
Adjust the variety for airports services

Adjust the level of anisotropic texture filtering.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调节各向异性过滤级别。
数值越高图像效果越好，但可能会影响性能。

exact.en: Choose whether to enable bright light lens bloom.
exact.zh: 选择是否使开启的强光镜头泛光。

exact.en:
Adjust the visual quality of procedurally-generated buildings.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整程序生成建筑物的视效质量。
数值越高图像效果越好，但可能会影响性能。

exact.en: Adjust the quantity for secondary characters.
Adjust the variety for secondary characters.
exact.zh: 调整次要 角色种类。

exact.en: Enable or disable a detailed relief method for close terrain.
exact.zh: 启用或禁用近距地形的精细地貌法。

exact.en:
Frame Generation boosts frame rates by using AI to render additional frames. This feature requires a GeForce RTX 40 Series graphics card.

Display Hardware-accelerated GPU Scheduling (HWS) must be enabled via Windows Settings : System : Display : Graphics : Change default graphics settings.
exact.zh:
DLSS帧生成借助人工智能来渲染其他帧。此功能需要使用GeForce RTX 40系列显卡。

显示硬件加速GPU调度（HWS）必须通过Windows设置：系统-显示-图形-改变默认图形设置。

exact.en: NVIDIA DLSS uses AI super resolution to provide the highest possible frame rates at maximum graphics settings. DLSS requires an NVIDIA RTX graphics card.
exact.zh: NVIDIA DLSS利用人工智能超分辨率技术，能在最高图形设置下提供尽可能高的帧率。若要DLSS，需使用NVIDIA RTX显卡。

exact.en:
Adjust depth of field quality.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调节景深质量。
数值越高图像效果越好，但可能会影响性能。

exact.en: Adjust the draw distance. Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh: 调整绘制距离。较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en: Bias the auto exposure value, making picture darker or brighter.
exact.zh: 调整自动曝光值，使图片更暗或更亮。

exact.en: Adjust the density, quality and display distance for fauna.
exact.zh: 调整动物群的密度、质量和显示距离。

exact.en:
Activate or deactivate one of the Frame Generation techniques.

NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation:
Uses AI to boost frame rates by generating one or more additional high-quality frames. DLSS Frame Generation requires a GeForce RTX 40 Series GPU or higher (RTX 50 Series for multiple frames).

AMD FSR Frame Generation:
Uses AI to boost frame rates by generating one additional high-quality frame. (uses older FSR 3 if GPU is not supported)
exact.zh:
启用或禁用某种帧生成技术。

NVIDIA DLSS帧生成：
使用AI生成一个或多个高质量帧，提升帧率。DLSS帧生成需GeForce RTX 40系列或更高显卡（RTX 50系列支持多帧）。

AMD FSR帧生成：
使用AI提升帧率，生成一个高质量帧。（如果GPU不支持，则使用旧版FSR 3）

exact.en:
AMD FSR 4: uses AI to produce higher resolution frames from lower resolution inputs (uses older FSR 3 if GPU is not supported)

NativeAA: 100% render scale

Quality: 67% render scale

Balanced: 59% render scale

Performance: 50% render scale

Ultra Performance: 33% render scale
exact.zh:
AMD FSR 4：利用AI技术，将低分辨率输入生成更高分辨率画面（如果GPU不支持，则使用旧版FSR 3）

NativeAA： 100%渲染比例

质量：67%渲染比例

平衡：59%渲染比例

性能：50%渲染比例

超级性能：33%渲染比例

exact.en: Enable/Disable condensation trails on player’s plane, AI traffic & multiplayer.
exact.zh: 启用/禁用玩家飞机、AI交通和多人游戏上的凝结尾迹。

exact.en: Enable/Disable visual effects when landing on asphalt, grass and dirt.
exact.zh: 开启/关闭飞机着陆在沥青、草地、泥土上的各种视觉效果。

exact.en:
Adjust the visual quality of grass
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整草地的视效质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust the resolution of long range terrain shadows.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整远距离地形阴影的分辨率。
较高值会提高视觉质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust quality of light shafts.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整光轴渲染质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en: Multiply your frame rates by 2. With a GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics card, can multiply by 3 or 4.
exact.zh: 将帧率提高2倍。使用GeForce RTX 50系列显卡，可以提高3倍或4倍。

exact.en:
Adjust level of detail for other objects.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调节其他对象的细节水平。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en: Adjust the quantity for parked aircrafts
exact.zh: 调整停放的航空器数量

exact.en: Adjust the variety for parked aircraft
exact.zh: 调整停放的航空器种类

exact.en: Adjust the quality of visual effects particles
exact.zh: 调整视觉效果粒子质量

exact.en: Adjust the quality for passive aircraft.

Adjust the visual quality of plants.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整植被的视效质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en: Choose whether to enable dirt effects.
exact.zh: 选择是否启用污垢效果。

exact.en: Choose whether to enable a film grain effect.
exact.zh: 选择是否启用胶片颗粒滤镜效果。
选择是否启用画面条纹。

exact.en: Choose whether to enable camera lens distortion correction.
exact.zh: 选择是否启用摄像机失真效果。

exact.en: Choose whether to enable camera lens flare.
exact.zh: 选择是否启用摄像机光晕效果。

exact.en: Choose whether to enable a vignette effect around the edges of the screen.
exact.zh: 选择是否在屏幕边缘启用暗角效果。

exact.en: Enable or disable the use of raytracing to create more detailed shadows.
exact.zh: 启用或禁用光线追踪以产生更细致的光影效果。

exact.en:
Adjust the resolution of the reflections cubemap.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整立方贴图反射的分辨率。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en: NVIDIA reflex reduces system latency and increases PC responsiveness.
exact.zh: NVIDIA反射可降低系统延迟并提高PC 响应能力。

exact.en:
Scale the resolution of 3D scene rendering. User interface is unaffected by this parameter.
Lower scaling improves performance; higher scaling improves quality.
It is recommended to use the Temporal anti-aliasing technique (TAA) when below 100% to get the best upsampling quality.
Using more than 100% will super sample the rendering (SSAA).
exact.zh:
调整3D场景渲染的分辨率。用户界面不受此参数的影响。
较低的渲染比例可以提高性能；较高的渲染比例可以提高质量。
建议在渲染比例低于100%时搭配使用时间抗锯齿（TAA），以获得最佳的取样质量。
渲染比例超过100%时将对渲染进行超级采样（SSAA）。

exact.en:
Adjust the visual quality of rocks.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整岩石的视效质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust the shadow map resolution.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整阴影贴图的分辨率。
较高值将提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en: AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (CAS) algorithm adjusts the amount of sharpening per pixel to target an even level of sharpness across the image.
exact.zh: AMD FidelityFX对比度自适应锐化（CAS）算法可以调节每个像素的锐化程度，使整个图像均匀锐化。

exact.en:
Adjust the quality of ambient occlusion shadows.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整环境光遮蔽阴影的质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust the quality of precise screen space shadows.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整精确屏幕空间阴影的质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust the quality of raymarched reflections.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整光线步进反射的质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust the quality of supersample key materials, such as floor markings.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整对关键物体材质（如地标）的超采样质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust the visual quality of terrain.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整地形的视效质量。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust the quality of textures.

exact.zh:
调整纹理质量。
必须重新启动 Flight Simulator 才能使这些更改生效。

exact.en: Adjust the quantity for the aircraft traffic

Adjusts the amount of different aircraft models used for air traffic, groups and multiplayer.

Higher values may affect performance.

Low: 1 model variant for traffic, 5 for groups and 4 for multiplayer

Medium: 10 model variants for traffic, 5 for groups and 10 for multiplayer

High: 60 model variants for traffic, 10 for groups and 30 for multiplayer

Ultra: unlimited model variants
exact.zh:
调节用于空中交通、组与多人游戏的不同飞机模型数量。

设置较高可能会影响性能表现。

低：空中交通1种、组5种，多人游戏4种

中：空中交通10种、组5种、多人游戏10种

高：空中交通60种、组10种、多人游戏30种

超高：模型数量无限制

exact.en: Adjust the density, quality and display distance for airport traffic.
exact.zh: 调整机场交通的密度、质量和显示距离。

exact.zh: 调整空中交通的密度、质量和显示距离。

exact.zh: 调整道路交通的密度、质量和显示距离。

exact.zh: 调整海上交通的密度、质量和显示距离。

exact.en:
Adjust the visual quality of trees.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.

调整树木的视效质量。
较高值会提高视觉质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en: Adjust the quality of clouds. Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh: 调整云层质量。较高值会提高视觉质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust the resolution level of wave simulation.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整波浪模拟的分辨率级别。
较高值会提高画面质量，但也可能影响性能。

exact.en:
Adjust quality of rain effects and reflections on the windshield.
Higher values will improve visual quality but may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整挡风玻璃上的雨水效果和反射质量。
较高的值将提高画面质量，但可能会影响性能。

exact.en: This options requires a VR headset with eye tracking for optimal use. When active, uses quad views rendering technique to improve your GPU performance. The higher the resolution, the higher the gain. Can add some CPU overhead.
exact.zh: 此选项需配备支持眼动追踪的VR头显方能达到最佳效果。 启用后，系统将采用四视图渲染技术来提升显卡性能。 游戏分辨率越高，效果越好。 但可能会略微增加处理器的运算负担。

exact.en: Change the scale of the focus area. Reducing it can improve further GPU performance but will decrease outer area quality.
exact.zh: 更改焦点区域的比例。缩小比例可进一步提升GPU性能，但会降低外围区域的质量。

exact.en: Frame rate target used by Dynamic Settings.
exact.zh: 动态设置使用的帧率目标。

exact.en: Sets an upper limit on frame rate. This cap is enforced prior to any frame generation methods.
exact.zh: 设置帧率上限。此上限会在任何帧生成方法之前强制执行。
数位化驾驶舱显示屏刷新率

exact.en:
Adjust the refresh rate of glass cockpit displays in supported aircraft.
Higher values may affect performance.
exact.zh:
调整部分飞机的数位化驾驶舱中显示屏的刷新率。
较高的值可能会影响性能。

exact.en: Switch between PC and VR settings

Choose between a series of presets that affect all other graphics options.

Note that applying high settings on lower-spec machines may significantly impact load times.
exact.zh:
从一系列预设图效方案中选择一套设置画面，这会影响所有其它画面设定。

请注意，在低性能主机上应用过高设置可能会显著延长加载时间。

exact.en: HMD can use the depth buffer, and motion vector, to improve the smoothness of your experience. Motion Vector is not available for all headsets. Reprojection can bring graphical artifacts to the screen. The better your framerate is, the lesser artifacts are visible. (it works best with framerate above ½ HMD’s native refresh rate)
exact.zh: HMD利用深度缓存和运动矢量技术来提高游戏的流畅性。 所有头戴设备均不支持运动矢量功能。 二次投影可能会使屏幕显示失真，帧率越高，失真程度越小。（在帧率高于HMD原生刷新率的一半时效果最佳）

exact.en:
Select a display mode for Microsoft Flight Simulator.

Full Screen: Mouse cursor is not locked, allowing you to quickly switch to other applications on other monitors.

Windowed: You can resize this window and quickly access other applications on your main monitor.
exact.zh:
为 Microsoft Flight Simulator 选择显示模式：

全屏：鼠标光标不锁定，您可以快速切换至屏幕上其它应用程序。

窗口：您可以调整窗口大小，并可以操作主屏幕上的其它应用程序。

exact.en: Adjust the resolution when in Full Screen display mode.
exact.zh: 调整全屏显示模式下的分辨率。

Adjust whether seatbelts are visible inside the cockpit.

exact.zh:
调整驾驶舱内安全带是否可见。
启用此选项可能会影响性能。

exact.en: Adjust the visual fidelity of air traffic
exact.zh: 调整空中交通的视觉保真度。

exact.zh: 图形配置错误。设置已重置为默认值。如需自定义，请转到选项菜单。

exact.zh: 最新版本的 Microsoft Flight Simulator 中图形设置已变更，您以前的设置已重设为默认值。您可以在选项菜单中自定义图形设置。

exact.en: Controls how often the graphics card presents frames to the screen in relation to the monitor’s refresh rate.
exact.zh: 控制显卡向屏幕显示帧的频率与显示器刷新率的关系。

exact.en: Slider to adjust the world size perception in VR (percentage value, 100% is default)
exact.zh: 使用滑块调整VR中看到的世界大小（百分比值，默认为100%）

exact.en: Total distance to next waypoint, and estimated time en route (ETE)
exact.zh: 距离下一个航点的总路程，以及预计航路时间（ETE）

exact.en:
Information for the flight, including compass headings
Rows expand to display in-depth descriptions to help find the next waypoint

这次飞行的信息，包括罗盘航向
在展开行内以查看更深入的描述，以助您找到下一个航路点。

exact.en:
Use GPS navigation to see your aircraft position on the route and follow your Bush Trip. Access it from the EFB Flight Planner map or the Mini Map on your HUD.

If you prefer visual navigation, pilotage, and dead reckoning, stay on the Navlog page and minimize or remove the Minimap using the “Minimap and compass” setting in General Settings > Flight Interface.
exact.zh:
使用GPS导航可查看航空器在路线上的位置，方便你完成郊野之行。可通过EFB飞行计划器地图或HUD上的小地图访问。

如果你更喜欢视觉导航、目视导航和推算导航，请保持在飞行日志页面，并通过“小地图和指南针”设置（总设置 > 飞行界面）最小化或关闭迷你地图。

exact.en: The Navlog in the EFB Flight Planner helps you follow your route waypoint by waypoint using headings, distances, and estimated times.
exact.zh: EFB 飞行计划器中的导航日志可帮助你通过航向、距离和预计时间，逐个航路点跟踪你的航线。

exact.en: Start the stopwatch when you pass a waypoint. When it reaches the ETE for the next waypoint, you should be close to it.
exact.zh: 通过航路点时启动秒表。当秒表达到下一个航路点的预计飞行时间时，你应该已经接近该航路点。

exact.en: Lists each waypoint with heading, distance, ETE, and optional visual guidance.
exact.zh: 列出每个航路点，包括航向、距离、预计飞行时间，以及可选的视觉导航提示。

exact.en: Shows the total route distance, estimated enroute time, and selected TAS. Actual timing may vary depending on wind and aircraft performance.
exact.zh: 显示总路线距离、预计航程时间和所选实际空速(TAS)。实际飞行时间可能会因风况和飞机性能而有所变化。

exact.en: The Navlog is a vital resource when navigating via waypoints. It contains several key bits of data:
exact.zh: 导航日志是在航路点间导航的重要资料。它包含了几类关键数据：

exact.en:
Designed with experienced flight simmers in mind, Bush Trips are marathon, multi-leg journeys that put a pilot's navigational skills to the test.
Pilots must follow a chain of "Points of Interest" as they travel across some of the most beautiful regions in the World.

Tools like the Navlog or the GPS Navigation will be available during flight in the EFB, to open it press {STR_MENU_SR_EFB_TOGGLE}
exact.zh:
郊野之行专为有经验的模拟飞行用户设计，是由多个航段组成的长途飞行旅程，旨在考验飞行员的导航能力。
飞行员需沿着一系列“兴趣点”，穿越世界上最美丽的地区。

飞行过程中可以使用飞行日志或GPS导航工具，这些均可在EFB中打开。如需打开 EFB，请按下{STR_MENU_SR_EFB_TOGGLE}。

exact.en:
Designed with experienced flight simmers in mind, Bush Trips are marathon, multi-leg journeys that put a pilot's navigational skills to the test.

Operating exclusively under Visual Flight Rules (VFR), with no GPS or on-screen waypoint markers, pilots must follow a chain of "Points of Interest" as they travel across some of the most beautiful regions in the world.

Two tools will be available during flight for assistance:
exact.zh:
郊野之行由资深模拟飞行用户设计，是一种马拉松式的多航段旅行，将考验飞行员的导航技能。

飞行员将在没有GPS或屏幕航路点标记的情况下，仅遵循目视飞行规则（VFR）驾驶飞机，沿着由“兴趣点”串成的航线，飞越世界上最美丽的地区。

作为辅助，飞行中还有两种工具可用。

exact.en:
Current time, both Local and Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)
Also includes a manual Stopwatch, to optionally measure progress
exact.zh:
当前时间，包括本地时间和协调世界时（UTC）
另外还包括一个手动秒表，用来评估进度。

exact.en:
The VFR Map is not a GPS -- however it does provide a detailed 2D view of nearby surroundings.

If lost, pressing the Back On Track button will temporarily display the aircraft's current position along with a line to the next waypoint.

Note: To earn the achievement available for each Bush Trip, pilots must complete the full trip without any Back On Track assistance.
exact.zh:
VFR地图并不是GPS——但它确实提供了有关附近环境的详细2D视图。

如果您迷路了，按下“带我回正轨”按键将短暂显示一条从飞机当前位置到下一个航路点的提示线。

注意：飞行员必须完成整个航程且不使用任何“带我回正轨”辅助，才能获得郊野之行有关成就。

exact.en: This activity relies on Visual Flight Rules (VFR) and is therefore best enjoyed in Online Mode to ensure accurate world representation.
exact.zh: 此活动依赖于目视飞行规则（VFR）进行导航，因此最好在在线模式中游玩，以保证地形表现精确而便于识别。

exact.en: Open the upper-left panel to choose an aircraft and adjust details such as fuel level, payload and ATC registration.
exact.zh: 打开左上方界面选择飞机，并设定各项细节诸如油位、载荷和ATC注册信息。

exact.en:
Every flight requires at least a Departure or Arrival assignment.
If only a Departure point is assigned in advance, pilots can create a flight plan with Arrival details from the cockpit using aircraft instruments.
If both Departure and Arrival assignments are made in advance, a route will be calculated and displayed on the World Map. In addition, a new menu item will appear below the Aircraft Selection panel with the option to switch between VFR and IFR planning.
If the assigned Departure point is an airport, the flight will begin with the aircraft on the runway, engine running and cleared for take-off.
If the assigned Departure point is outside of an airport -- or if only an Arrival point is assigned (i.e. no Departure point) -- the flight will begin with the aircraft airborne.
For a full pre-flight experience, pilots can zoom into an airport and select a gate or parking spot, which will begin the flight with the aircraft Cold & Dark, engine off and no ATC clearance issued.
exact.zh:
每次飞行均需要分配至少一个出发地点或到达地点。
如果飞行前仅安排了一个出发地点，飞行员可以在飞行中使用驾驶舱仪表创建包含到达地点的飞行计划
如果飞行前出发地点和到达地点均已分配，一条航线将被自动生成并显示在世界地图上。此外，飞机选择界面中还会出现新的菜单项目，用于选择VFR或IFR飞行规划。
如果出发地点是机场，这次飞行将会开始于该机场跑道上，且飞机初始状态为已启动发动机、已获得起飞许可。
如果出发地点设置在机场外——或仅设置了到达地点（没有出发地点）——这次飞行将会以飞机在空中的状态开始。
若想获得完整的起飞前体验，您可以放大机场并选择一个闸口或驻机坪，作为这次飞行的起始位置，这种情况下飞机的初始状态为冷舱&未通电、发动机关闭、未申请ATC许可。

exact.en: Access the top-right panel for the option to fly privately or in a shared world with other online users and/or AI air traffic based on live data. In addition, this panel allows for customization of Weather and Time of Day settings.
exact.zh: 访问右上角界面以设置飞行条件，可选择自己一个人飞，或与其它玩家共享一个世界，还可以开关基于实时数据的AI空中交通。此外，该界面还能让您自定义天气和时间。

exact.en: When at least one point of Departure or Arrival is assigned, press the Fly button to begin the flight.
exact.zh: 当至少分配了一个出发地点或到达地点时，按下“飞行”按钮开始飞行。

exact.en: Star Airports - Airports featuring the highest level of visual detail, as well as the most authentic gate, parking and taxiway information.
exact.zh: 星标机场—具有最高级视效细节水准的机场，还包含最真实的闸口、驻机坪和滑行道数据。

exact.en: Star Points of Interest - Curated POIs such as landmarks, monuments and areas of particular beauty worth visiting from the skies.
exact.zh: 星标兴趣点—精心制作的POI诸如地标、纪念碑和具有特别美感的区域，值得从空中参观。

exact.en: Assessing the maximum distance deviated from the center of a runway at any point during a challenge. The closer a pilot stays to the center line, the more points will be awarded.
exact.zh: 用于在挑战中评估飞机偏离跑道中线的最大距离。飞行员若能保持飞机距中心线越近，获得分数就越高。

exact.en: Measuring the length of runway from an aircraft's touch-down point to a complete stop. The shorter the distance, the more points will be awarded.
exact.zh: 用以计量从飞机着陆点到完全停止点的跑道距离。这个距离越短，获得分数就越高。

exact.en: Calculating the distance between an aircraft's touch-down point and a touch-down target visible on the runway. The closer a pilot gets to the target, the more points will be awarded.
exact.zh: 飞机着陆点和跑道上可见着陆目标点之间的距离。飞行员降落时距目标点越近，获得分数就越高。

exact.en: Gauging an aircraft's Vertical Speed (feet per minute) at touch-down. The closer a pilot gets to 0 fpm, the more points will be awarded.
exact.zh: 测量飞机着陆时刻的垂直速度（英尺每分钟）。该测量值越接近0 fpm，飞行员获得的分数就越高。

exact.en:
Set at famous and demanding airports around the world, Landing Challenges are designed to test a pilot's ability to overcome environmental obstacles and land safely at a pre-determined runway. Each challenge begins in the air, on final approach, with clearance to land already granted. All piloting and navigation assists are disabled.

Scores are determined by the following criteria:
exact.zh:
着陆挑战设在全球知名的、要求严苛的机场，旨在测试飞行员克服环境阻碍安全着陆在预定跑道的能力。每项挑战均开始于空中，飞机处于最终进近阶段，且已获得着陆许可。挑战中所有驾驶和导航辅助都被禁用

挑战分数根据以下标准确定：

exact.en:
Marine Corps Air Station (MCAS) Miramar, located ten miles north of downtown San Diego, is one of the most legendary military aviation facilities in history. The story of MCAS Miramar stretches back decades, with roots in World War I where it was used as a U.S. Army infantry training ground. It was first used by aircraft in 1940, when the 1st Marine Air Wing arrived in December of that year just after the construction of its first runways. Miramar reached international fame decades later as the home of the United States Navy Fighter Weapons School. Popularly known as “TOPGUN,” this training regimen for the most proficient of U.S. Naval Aviators earned MCAS Miramar the nickname “Fightertown USA.”

Due to the direction and velocity of the wind, you’ll need to land your F/A-18E Super Hornet using a runway 6L approach, instead of the typical runway 24. Remember to keep your aircraft far away from the residential areas to the north of the base, and then carefully roll into final on your way to touching down at this storied airfield.
exact.zh:
米拉马尔海军陆战队航空站（MCAS）位于圣地亚哥市中心以北10英里处，堪称历史上最具传奇色彩的军事航空设施之一。米拉马尔MCAS的起源可以追溯到几十年前的第一次世界大战，当时它还被用作美国陆军步兵训练场。1940年，这里的第一条跑道建成，同年12月第一海军航空队抵达，这座设施开始为飞机服务。几十年后，米拉马尔作为美国海军战斗机武器学校的所在地而享誉国际。这所学校提供的教学计划俗称“TOPGUN”（电影《壮志凌云》的原名由来），许多艺高人胆大的美国海军飞行员都从这里走出，为米拉马尔MCAS赢得了“美国战机城”的美名。

考虑到风的方向和速度，你需要驾驶F/A-18E超级大黄蜂降落于6L跑道，而非一般情况下的24跑道。记得让飞机远离基地以北的住宅区，小心转入最终边，平安降落在这个传说中的机场。

Choose how to render multiplayer replicated aircraft.

High Fidelity: Loads the full-fidelity model of the aircraft for maximum detail, which can reduce performance.

Simplified: Loads a lightweight, optimized model, prioritizing performance over the highest visual detail and accuracy.
