exact.en:
Change communication option behavior:

Default: All audio plays through the Default Audio Device.

Headphone Simulation: Applies a simulation of headphone acoustics that filters the external sound environment.

Communication Output: Radio communications play through the Default Communication Device, while all other audio plays through the Default Audio Device. Default Audio Device and Default Communication Device can be set up in the Sound Control Panel of your system.
exact.zh:
变更通讯设置的运作方式：

默认：所有音响使用默认音频输出设备播放。

飞行帽耳机模拟：通过滤掉外部环境音源，模拟飞行帽耳机的听觉效果。

通讯音频输出：无线电通讯通过默认通讯设备播放，其余音响通过默认音频设备播放。默认音频设备和默认通讯设备可在您操作系统的音量控制面板中设置。

exact.en:
Change communication option behavior:

Default: All audio plays through the Default Audio Device.

Headphone Simulation: Applies a simulation of headphone acoustics that filters the external sound environment.

Controller Speaker : Radio communications play through the controller speaker output while all the other audio sources play through the default speaker configuration.
To adjust the radio communication volume, go to the PS5 sound options to adjust controller speaker volume.
exact.zh:
变更通讯选项行为：

默认：所有音频使用默认音频输出设备播放。

耳机模拟：应用耳机声学模拟，过滤外部声音环境。

控制器扬声器：无线电通信通过控制器扬声器输出进行播放，而所有其它音频来源通过默认扬声器配置播放。
如需调整无线电通信音量，请在PS5声音选项中调整控制器扬声器音量。

exact.en:
Change communication option behavior:

Default: All audio plays through the Default Audio Device.

Headphone Simulation: Applies a simulation of headphone acoustics that filters the external sound environment.

Communication Output : Radio communications play through the controller headset output while all the other audio sources play through the default speaker configuration.
To adjust the radio communication volume, go to the Headset chat mixer in the Xbox quick-start menu.
To hear exclusively radio communication through your headphone, set the level slider at 100%.
exact.zh:
变更通讯设置的运作方式：

默认：所有音响使用默认音频输出设备播放。

飞行帽耳机模拟：通过滤掉外部环境音源，模拟飞行帽耳机的听觉效果。

通讯音频输出：无线电通讯通过手柄耳机输出播放，其余音响通过默认扬声器播放。
要调整无线电通讯音量，请前往Xbox快速启动菜单的耳麦聊天混音页面。
若希望无线电语音仅通过耳机播放，混音滑条应设置为100%。

exact.en: Select the output device for in-flight radio communications (for example, if you want to output ATC radio comms to your headphones while all other audio continues to output via speakers).
exact.zh: 选择机上无线电通信（如，若您想将ATC无线电通信输出至您的耳机、而其他所有语音则依旧输出至扬声器）的输出设备。

exact.en: Convert all audio output in Flight Simulator to Mono.
exact.zh: 将《Flight Simulator》的所有音频输出转换为单声道。

exact.en: Adjust volume level of engines in the user's aircraft.
exact.zh: 调整玩家飞机的发动机音量大小。

exact.en: Adjust volume level of the environment, including weather, airports, urban and biome sounds.
exact.zh: 调整环境音响大小，包括天气、机场、城区和生物群的声音。

exact.en:
Apply a simulation of headphone acoustics to filter primary sound sources (aircraft & environment sounds).

This option is available only if you choose the same output for both Main Device and Communication Device above.
exact.zh:
应用耳机声学模拟，以过滤主要音源（飞机声、环境声）。

仅当使用同一个主要设备与通信设备输出时，此选项才可用。

exact.en:
Choose the option that matches your setup for the best audio experience.

Hi-Fi: Recommended for soundbars and stereo speakers.

TV: Recommended when using built-in television speakers.

Headphones: Recommended when using headphones.

Home Theatre : Recommended for surround sound (Dolby AtmosTM, 7.1 , 5.1).
exact.zh:
选择与您的设置相匹配的选项，以获得最佳音频体验。

高保真：建议用于条形音箱和立体声扬声器。

电视：建议用于电视内置扬声器。

耳机：建议用于耳机。

家庭影院：建议用于环绕声（Dolby AtmosTM，7.1，5.1）。

exact.en: This option adjusts the level of aircraft to ensure sound level consistency throughout the Microsoft Flight Simulator experience.
exact.zh: 此选项可调整飞机的级别，以确保在整个Microsoft Flight Simulator体验中声音级别保持一致。

exact.zh: 选择用于播放所有非通信音频（飞机声、环境声）的输出设备。

exact.en: Select your favorite Microsoft Flight Simulator music.
exact.zh: 选择您最爱的 Microsoft Flight Simulator 音乐。

exact.zh: 当应用程序位于后台或未聚焦时，禁用 Flight Simulator 的所有音频播放。

exact.en:
Choose whether to populate the world with Real-Time Online Traffic, AI offline Traffic or no traffic. This setting only applies to Aircraft and Sea Traffic.

Real-Time Online: Simulates real-world traffic. This option requires a persistent internet connection.

AI offline (Experimental): Generates artificial traffic and uses the settings below to customize traffic density.

Off: Disables all traffic.
exact.zh:
选择是否在世界中生成实时在线交通：实时在线交通、AI离线交通或无交通。此设置仅适用于飞机与海上船舶交通。

实时在线：模拟现实世界中的实时交通状况。此选项需要持续的网络连接。

AI离线：生成虚拟交通，并可使用下列设置自定义交通密度

关闭：禁用所有交通。

Take charge of flight 1337 from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport to LaGuardia to test landing diversions. Tonight's flight begins at dusk and will travel roughly 2400 miles across the continental United States, scheduled to arrive 6 hours later at dawn. The flight begins parked at the Seattle-Tacoma gate and ends when you arrive at the designated LaGuardia gate. As the captain of the flight you will be responsible for all communications, navigation and piloting of the aircraft, although you may delegate some tasks to your co-pilot.
exact.zh: 你将负责驾驶从西雅图-塔科马国际机场飞往拉瓜迪亚的1337航班，测试着陆改道。今晚的航班将在黄昏时分起飞，在约2400英里的航程中飞越大陆、穿过美国，预计6小时后的黎明时分抵达目的地。航程从飞机停靠在西雅图-塔科马登机口开始，直到你抵达拉瓜迪亚指定登机口结束。作为机长，你将负责飞机的所有通信、导航和驾驶工作，你也可以把一些任务委托给你的副驾驶员。

exact.en: This challenge requires you to land a TBM 930 at Lynden Pindling International Airport, the principal airport of Nassau in the Bahamas. However, this landing will be made more difficult due to strong crosswinds, and your approach and landing will be scored based on their smoothness and accuracy. You can then compare your score against other players in a dedicated leaderboard. The challenge begins in the air, above the south coast of Nassau. Keep a heading of 310 degrees until you reach the Killarney lake, then lower your speed and aim for runway 27, facing west.
exact.zh: 这一挑战要求你在巴哈马拿骚的主要机场——林丁平德林国际机场降落一架TBM930。然而，由于强大的侧风，这次着陆将难上加难。你将根据进近和着陆的平滑性和准确性得到相应的分数，尔后你可以在专门的排行榜上与其他玩家一较高下。挑战开始于拿骚南海岸上空的空域。请保持310度的航向，直到抵达基拉尼湖。然后降低你的速度，瞄准27号跑道向西飞行。

This short private flight takes you across the city of Los Angeles, taking off from Van Nuys Airport and landing 8 miles east at Hollywood Burbank Airport. A storm is approaching, which will reduce visibility. Also, as the Cessna 172 is a light plane, the strong winds will make the navigation and approach difficult. Once you leave the Van Nuys controlled airspace, contact Burbank Airport to request landing clearance. If you are not familiar with the area, you can request directions from Burbank control tower.
exact.zh: 此次短暂的私人飞行会带你穿越洛杉矶市。你将从范努伊斯机场起飞，在好莱坞布尔班机场西面8英里以外着陆。由于暴风雨即将来临，能见度会降低。此外，由于塞斯纳172是一架轻型飞机，强风将加大导航和进近难度。一旦离开范努斯管制空域，请联系伯班克机场获取着陆许可。如果你不熟悉该地区情况，可向布尔班控制塔台请求指引。

exact.en: Microsoft Flight Simulator is best experienced with an internet connection, which enables higher-quality 3D environments, real-time air traffic and live weather, as well as online multiplayer action with other users. However, a persistent internet connection is not required to use Microsoft Flight Simulator offline.
exact.zh: Microsoft Flight Simulator 在连接互联网的情况下方能达到最佳体验，使您能以流媒体方式加载更高质量的三维环境、访问实时空中交通状况和实时天气，并在游戏中与其他用户联机。不过，脱机使用 Microsoft Flight Simulator 不需要持久的网络连接。

exact.en: Streaming high-quality 3D environments provides the best Flight Simulator experience, but note this may use several gigabytes of data over your internet connection.
exact.zh: 高质量的流式三维环境能够提供了最佳的 Flight Simulator 体验，但请注意这可能会消耗您大量的网络数据流量。

exact.en: Offline Mode will not attempt to connect to the internet during your session. This means you will not have access to high-quality 3D environments, real-time air traffic or live weather. You will also not be able to play online with other users.
exact.zh: 脱机模式下，游戏不会在运行期间尝试连接网络。这意味着您将无法访问高质量的三维环境、实时空中交通状况或实时天气。您也将无法与其他用户联机游戏。

exact.en: You can change your assistance level at any point from the Options/Assistance menu.
exact.zh: 您可以随时从选项/辅助菜单更改您的辅助等级。

exact.en: Choose from 3 preset Assistance levels, or expand each category to customize individual options.
exact.zh: 请从3个预设的辅助级别中进行选择，或展开每个分类来自定义单个选项。

exact.en: You can change your Graphics settings at any point from the Options/General/Graphics menu.
exact.zh: 您可以随时从选项/通用/图形菜单更改图形设置。

exact.en: Based on your system capabilities, we recommend the following Graphics preset.
exact.zh: 根据您的系统性能，我们建议使用以下图形预设方案。

exact.en:
Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 offers a screen narration option that uses text-to-speech to read the on-screen menus.

You can enable this feature here, or at any point from the settings menu.
exact.zh:
《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024》提供屏幕旁白选项，将通过文本转语音功能阅读屏显菜单。

您可在此启用此功能，也可随时在设置菜单中启用此功能。

exact.en: By clicking See and Set Assistance, you are able to define your own CUSTOM ASSISTANCE level.
exact.zh: 通过单击“查看和设置辅助”，你可以定义适合自己的“自定义辅助”级别。

exact.en: Note that your custom settings will be lost if you switch back to any preset Assistance level.
exact.zh: 请注意，如果切换回任何预设辅助级别，你的自定义设置将丢失。

exact.en: In HIGH ASSISTANCE, you will receive significant assistance from your copilot or autopilot when controlling the aircraft to avoid stalling, going off-course or flying at the wrong altitude. Aircraft structural damage will be disabled and fuel levels will be unlimited.
exact.zh: “强协助”模式下，你将在控制飞机时得到副驾驶或自动驾驶仪的鼎力协助，以避免失速、偏离航线或在错误高度飞行。飞机结构损坏将被禁用，燃料将无限供应。

exact.en: There will be visual waypoints to assist navigation throughout the flight, and radio communication will be handled automatically.
exact.zh: 在整个飞行过程中都将有可视化的航路点协助导航，且无线电通信将得到自动处理。

exact.en: In LOW ASSISTANCE, you will receive occasional reminders from your copilot or autopilot when controlling the aircraft if making significant deviation from the expected speed, heading or altitude.
exact.zh: ”弱协助“模式下，若你在控制飞机时与预期的速度、航向或高度存在重大偏差，你会不时收到副驾驶或自动驾驶仪的提醒。

exact.en: Navigation waypoints will only be shown if you go off course.
exact.zh: 只有当你偏离航线时，导航才会显示航路点。

exact.en: In MEDIUM ASSISTANCE, you will receive regular reminders from your copilot or autopilot when controlling the aircraft to minimise errors in speed, heading or altitude.
exact.zh: ”中等辅助“模式下，你会收到副驾驶或自动驾驶仪的定期提醒，以将航空器速度、航向或高度误差保持在最低水平。

exact.en: There will be visual waypoints to assist navigation during cruise, but not during takeoff or landing.
exact.zh: 在巡航过程中会有可视化航路点辅助导航，但在起飞或着陆过程中并没有这类协助。

exact.en: In NO ASSISTANCE, all aviation, navigation and communication support is disabled.
exact.zh: ”无辅助“模式下，所有的航空、导航和通信支持都被禁用。

exact.en: Any warning systems or instruments that are built into the real-life aircraft will still be active.
exact.zh: 任何内置在真实飞机上的警告系统或仪表都将继续工作。

exact.en:
The Chicane is a series of pylons you must fly between as fast as possible.

There are no penalties for incorrect level flying here, so you can slice your way between the pylons as close as possible. Keep in mind, however, that pylons need to be passed banking in the direction of the pylon to avoid negative G forces. In other words, avoid flying with the plane's belly facing the pylons.
exact.zh:
减速弯道由一系列塔架组成，需要尽可能快地于其中穿行。

此处将不会对未正确保持水平作出处罚，因此您可尽可能地靠近、以斜切的方式通过各个塔架。不过还请记住，必须向着塔架所朝的方向倾斜通过以避免出现负重力。换句话说，不要以飞机腹部向着塔架的情况下飞行。

exact.zh: 您进行的操作与简报机动相去甚远

exact.en: Make sure to pass a double gate with your head in the upper 40% of the Air Gate marked in red and flying with your wings level with a max of 10 degrees left and right bank angle margin.
exact.zh: 确保将头部保持在标红飞行闸门上方40%处通过双门，且将机翼保持在水平位置、左/右倾斜角不得超过10度。

exact.en:
Since it was officially launched in 2003, the Red Bull Air Race World Championship has become globally renowned as one of the most exhilarating motorsport series on the planet.

Pilots are required to complete a 5-6 kilometer-long track as fast as possible, while navigating between several air gates in a specific order.

Failure to do this correctly results in penalty seconds being added to their race time. For more serious breaches of the rules, pilots may be ruled as DNF, or 'did not finish' and will have no result time.

The aircraft used in Red Bull Air Races are high performance machines. As such, it is recommended to have some familiarity with the basics of flying before engaging in a race. Flight training can be found in the Training section of the Activities page.
exact.zh:
自2003年正式推出以来，红牛航空竞速世界锦标赛已成为全球公认的、最刺激的竞速系列赛事之一。

飞行员必须尽快完成5-6公里长的航线，同时按照特定顺序在几个空中门之间航行。

如果未能正确操作，飞行员的比赛时间将被罚秒。对于更严重的违规行为，飞行员可能会被判定为DNF，即“未完成比赛”，因而没有任何成绩时间。

在红牛航空竞速赛中使用的飞机都是高性能机型。因此，建议在参加比赛前先对飞行基础知识进行了解。玩家可以在“活动”页面的“训练”部分找到飞行训练。

exact.en:
Pilots may pick between four difficulty settings: Novice, Intermediate, Expert, and True to Life

Novice - Pilots have reduced penalties for various infractions. Infractions which would cause a DNF are reduced to penalties, or trigger a Back on Track (BoT) aircraft position reset. In addition, the race course is modified to make it easier to complete, and aircraft fly at a reduced speed.
Intermediate - Pilots use the same Simplified ruleset as in Novice. In addition, the race course is modified to make it slightly easier to complete.
Expert - Pilots use the same Simplified ruleset as in Novice, but fly in the real Red Bull course.
True to Life - Pilots experience all the same rules and penalties as a real Red Bull pilot would, while flying the same course as the Red Bull pilots flew.
exact.zh:
飞行员可以选择四种难度设置：新手、中级、专家和拟真

新手 - 飞行员所受到的各种违规行为处罚将会降低。一些会导致“未完成比赛”（DNF）的违规行为也会改为处罚，或触发“返回航线（BoT）”飞机位置重置。此外，赛道已做修改，更容易完成，并且飞机的飞行速度更低。
中级 - 飞行员使用与新手难度相同的简化规则。此外，赛道已做修改，相对更容易完成。
专家 - 飞行员使用与新手模式相同的简化规则，但在真实的红牛飞行赛道上飞行。
拟真 - 飞行员会体验与真实红牛飞行员完全相同的规则和处罚，并且在与红牛飞行员相同的赛道上飞行。

exact.en: Each course features four leaderboards, one for each difficulty setting. These leaderboards allow pilots to compare their times with their friends and globally.
exact.zh: 每条赛道都有四个排行榜，分别对应一种难度设置。通过这些排行榜，飞行员可以与好友以及全球的玩家比较自己的时间成绩。

exact.en: Pilots can choose to race against the ghosts of other pilots, to see how they flew the course and what their time was. To choose a ghost, select a pilot from a leaderboard. A menu will appear where the ghost can be selected.
exact.zh: 飞行员可以选择与其他飞行员进行幽灵赛，了解他们的飞行方式与飞行时间。要选择幽灵机，请从排行榜上选择一名飞行员。这时会出现一个菜单，可以选择幽灵机。

exact.en:
Before entering a track, pilots must activate their smoke. This is to ensure the plane can be seen at all times.

Pilots will be reminded before entering the track with the words 'Smoke on".
Smoke can be activated by pressing: {STR_SMOKE}
exact.zh:
进入航迹之前，飞行员必须激活烟雾。这是为了确保飞机始终保持醒目。

在进入航迹前飞行员会收到“释放烟雾”字样的提醒。
可以通过按下按钮激活烟雾：{STR_SMOKE}

exact.en:
Pilots want to pass through the Start Gate as fast as possible, without exceeding 201 knots.

Going too fast will result in a time penalty, and potentially a DNF.
exact.zh:
飞行员想要尽可能快地飞过起跑闸口，但不要超过201节。

如果飞行速度太快会受到时间惩罚，且可能会被取消资格。

exact.en:
Height: Make sure to pass a double gate with the pilots head in the upper 40% of the Air Gate, marked in red.

Rotation: Gates must be passed with the aircraft flying with level wings, with a maximum of 10 degree bank angle margin (30 degrees in the Simplified ruleset).
exact.zh:
高度：通过双重闸口时，确保飞行员的头部位于空中闸口上部40%的标红区域内。

旋转：必须在机翼水平飞行的情况下通过闸口，最大倾角容差为10度（简化规则设置中为30度）。

exact.en:
The Chicane is a series of pylons which must be flown between in order.

There are no penalties for incorrect level flying here, so pilots can slice their way between the pylons as close as possible. Keep in mind that pylons must be passed while banking in the direction of the pylon to avoid negative G forces.
exact.zh:
减速弯道由一系列塔架组成，需要尽可能快地按顺序于其中穿行。

未保持水平并不会受到处罚，因此飞行员可尽可能地靠近塔架、以斜切的方式通过。请记住，必须向着塔架所朝的方向倾斜通过以避免出现负重力。

exact.en:
The Quadro Gate is a set of four pylons placed in a grid, which must be passed at a knife-edge (a 90-degree angle).

The Quadro is a tricky gate and is not featured in every track.
exact.zh:
四角闸口由四个网格状排列的塔架组成，必须以“侧飞”的方式飞过（90度）。

四角闸口非常具有挑战性，不过并不是每条航迹都会出现。

exact.en:
Like the Quadro gate, these blue gates must be flown through at a 90-degree angle, or in "Knife Flight".

To achieve the proper angle, roll the aircraft to the left or the right until it is perpendicular to the ground.
exact.zh:
一如飞过四角闸口，你必须以90度即“笔直侧飞”的方式飞过这些蓝色闸口。

若想达到适当的角度，将飞机向左或向右侧翻滚，直到其与地面垂直。
减速弯道塔架和四角闸口

exact.en:
One of the most difficult maneuvers is the Vertical Turn. Here, pilots must take off vertically and then spin the plane around until they are level again and facing the course.

To begin, pull up hard after passing through the gate, being careful not to exceed 10.9 G's. Keep pulling until you are pointing toward the next gate.
exact.zh:
最困难的动作之一是垂直转弯。这一操作要求飞行员必须垂直起飞，然后旋转飞机，直到再次达到水平并面朝航线。

首先，经过闸口后用力拉起，注意不要超过10.9重力加速度。继续拉动，直到指向下一个闸口。

exact.en: While upside-down, use your ailerons to roll into an upright position, in the direction of your next gate.
exact.zh: 位于颠倒位置时，利用副翼向着下一个闸口所朝的方向横滚、回到直立位置。

exact.en: The pilot crosses the safety line which surrounds the track
exact.zh: 飞行员越过了环绕赛道的安全线

exact.en: The pilot misses the next air gate in the course
exact.zh: 飞行员错过了航程中的下一个空中闸口

exact.en: The pilot flies too low to the ground between air gates: below 15 meters
exact.zh: 飞行员超低空飞行到地面，距空中闸口：15米以下

exact.en: The pilot fails to activate their safety smoke
exact.zh: 飞行员未能启动安全烟雾

exact.en: The pilot's speed is between 201.01 and 201.99 knots through the starting gate
exact.zh: 飞行员通过起跑闸口的速度在201.01节到201.99节之间

exact.en: The pilot's speed exceeds 201.99 knots through the starting gate
exact.zh: 飞行员通过起跑闸口的速度超过201.99节

exact.en: The pilot's head passes below or above the gate bands
exact.zh: 飞行员的头部从闸口的下方或上方通过

exact.en: The pilot's plane rotation does not match the gate's required rotation
exact.zh: 飞行员的飞机旋转速度与闸口所需的旋转速度不匹配

exact.en: The pilot's plane is ascending or descending through an air gate
exact.zh: 飞行员的飞机正在一边上升或下降，一边通过空中闸口

exact.en: The plane experiences over 11G's of force for more than 0.6 seconds
exact.zh: 飞机在0.6秒以上的时间内承受了超过11G的力

exact.en: The plane experiences over 12G's of force
exact.zh: 飞机承受了超过12重力加速度的力

exact.en: The pilot collides with the ground

exact.zh: 已超过最大重力加速度

exact.en: The pilot collides with a pylon
exact.zh: 飞行员与一个塔架相撞了

exact.en: The pilot collides with a third pylon
exact.zh: 飞行员与第三个塔架相撞了

exact.en:
Land as close as possible to the center of the helipad on top of the Burj Al Arab.
The pad is located 728ft above sea level, there are 7kts of constant wind coming from 033°.
The plane is equipped with a small amount of nitro in case you need some extra power to go-around or take-off.
exact.zh:
尽可能接近帆船酒店上空直升机停机坪的中心着陆。
该停机坪位于海拔728英尺处，这里有来自033度的恒定风，风速为7海里/小时。
这款飞机配备了少量氮气提供额外动力，以备复飞或起飞使用。

exact.en:
The score is based on the distance between the landed aircraft and the center of the helipad.
The aircraft’s center is defined with respect to the pilot’s position.
A shorter distance results in a higher score on the leaderboard.
Unlike the traditional landing challenges, the smoothness and orientation of the landing are not taken into account.
exact.zh:
得分基于降落飞机与直升机停机坪中心之间的距离。
飞机的中心是根据飞行员的位置来定的。
距离越短，排行榜上的得分就越高。
与传统的着陆挑战不同，无需考虑着陆的平稳性和方向性。
精准着陆 - 红牛靶心

exact.en: Like the Quadro Gate, these blue gates must be flown through at a 90-degree angle, or in "Knife Flight".
exact.zh: 如飞过四角闸口时一样，您必须以90度或“侧飞”的方式飞过这些蓝色闸口。

exact.en: Select a time to see its ghost replay in game
exact.zh: 选择一个记录，在游戏内查看幽灵机回放

exact.en: Feel the adrenaline rush of a Red Bull Air Race pilot while racing in authentic tracks at iconic locations. Experience the thrill of high speed maneuvering, where precision and timing are key to success.
exact.zh: 在全球精选的传奇赛道上，体验高速精准操控的极致快感。

exact.en: Select a player to toggle their in-game visibility
exact.zh: 选择玩家以切换其在游戏中的能见度

exact.en: When banking into a turn, remember to pull up slightly to compensate for the loss of altitude.
exact.zh: 倾斜进入弯道时，记得稍微拉起一点以补偿高度损失。

exact.en: When turning into a chicane, pull up slightly to counteract the loss of altitude.
exact.zh: 转入减速弯道时，稍微向上拉起，以补偿高度损失。

exact.en: Congratulations! You've completed a full run of the track. You can continue practicing or leave the flight at any time via the pause menu.
exact.zh: 恭喜！你已经完成了一圈完整赛道。你可以继续练习，或者随时通过暂停菜单离开飞行。

exact.en: Quadro gates must be passed through vertically. To achieve the proper angle, roll the aircraft to the left or the right until it is perpendicular to the ground.
exact.zh: 四角门必须垂直飞过。若想达到适当的角度，将飞机向左或向右侧翻滚，直到其与地面垂直。

exact.en: Remember to activate smoke before the first gate.
exact.zh: 记得在飞过第一个闸门前激活烟雾。

exact.en: Gates colored in blue must be flown through at a 90 degree angle. To achieve the proper angle, roll the aircraft to the left or the right until it is perpendicular to the ground.
exact.zh: 蓝色闸门必须以90度角垂直飞过。若想达到适当的角度，将飞机向左或向右侧翻滚，直到其与地面垂直。

exact.en: For the vertical loop, pull up hard after passing through the gate. Keep pulling until you are pointing toward the next gate, then roll the aircraft until it is facing upright.
exact.zh: 执行垂直筋斗时，经过闸门后使劲向上拉起。对准下一个闸门前保持拉杆状态，随后横滚飞机改平至正飞姿态。

exact.en: Private Multiplayer or Single Player game mode.
exact.zh: 私人多人游戏或单人玩家游戏模式。

exact.en: Up to 8 friends fly alongside one another on a chosen track and rule leniency.
exact.zh: 最多8位朋友可以在选定的航迹上并肩飞行，规则宽松。

exact.en: The session leader can end the session at any point.
exact.zh: 游戏赛段领先者可以随时结束游戏。

exact.en: Fly endlessly as you attempt to set the best time possible and cement your name on the world leaderboard.
exact.zh: 在长时间的飞行中争取创造最佳时间，努力冲击世界排行榜。

exact.en: Up to 8 players fly alongside one another on a chosen track and rule leniency.
exact.zh: 最多8位玩家可以在选定的赛道上并肩飞行，规则宽松。

exact.en: After the 10 minutes is up, begin searching for another session.
exact.zh: 10分钟后，可以开始另一赛段游戏。

exact.en: Pilots have 10 minutes to set the best time possible and cement their names on the world leaderboard.
exact.zh: 飞行员们还有10分钟去创造最佳时间，努力冲击世界排行榜。

exact.en: Pull hard after passing through the gate, but be careful not to stall and not to exceed 9.9g's. Keep going until you are pointing toward the next gate.
exact.zh: 通过闸门后使劲拉动，不过切记别陷入失速状态、也不要超过9.9G。如此坚持下去，直至朝向下一个闸门。

exact.en: It's time to look at a couple of unique sections of the track: the Chicane Pylons, and the Quadro Gate. These have special rules that differ from the regular Air Gate.
exact.zh: 来看看航迹的几个独特部分吧：减速弯道塔架和四角闸口。它们与普通空气闸口有着不同的特殊规则。
减速弯道塔架和四角闸口

exact.en:
Next is the Quadro Gate, four pylons placed in a grid that you must pass at a knife-edge.

The Quadro is a tricky gate, and does not feature in every track. It was not used in the Red Bull Air Race latest Championship (2014-2019).
exact.zh:
接下来是四角闸口，由四个网状排列的闸口组成，必须以侧飞的方式飞过。

四角闸口非常具有挑战性，不过并不是每条赛道中都会出现。最近的红牛航空竞速锦标赛（2014-2019）均没有使用过。

exact.en: Make sure you're level when passing through the next Air Gate and not descending or ascending, else you will receive a penalty.
exact.zh: 确保飞机在通过下一个飞行闸门时处于水平状态，而非正在下降或上升，否则将受到处罚。

exact.en: From upside-down, use your ailerons to roll out to be upright again in the direction of your next gate.
exact.zh: 从颠倒位置开始，利用副翼向着下一个闸门所朝的方向横滚、再次回到直立位置。

exact.en: The Chicane consists of three single pylons 125 meters apart that must be passed in slalom flight (pass through the gates in a zigzag fashion). The pylons must be passed banking in the direction of the pylon the pilot is passing.
exact.zh: 该减速弯由三个相距125米的单独塔架组成，需要以回转飞行的方式飞过（人字形通过闸口）。同时，飞行员必须向着塔架所朝的方向倾斜通过。

exact.en: Like the Quadro Gate, these blue gates must be flown through at a 90-degree angle.
exact.zh: 如飞过四角闸口时一样，您必须以90度飞过这些蓝色闸口。

exact.en: Must be passed with wings level and a max of 10 degrees left or right bank angle.
exact.zh: 通过时，机翼必须保持在水平位置、向左/向右的倾斜角不得超过10度。

exact.en: The Quadro is made up of four pylons positioned in a a square. It must be passed in knife-edge (the aircraft turned vertically at a 90-degree angle).
exact.zh: Quadro由四个正方形塔架组成。需要以刀锋飞行的方式飞过（飞机以相对地面90度角垂直飞行）。

exact.en: Must be passed at a max speed, as directed by the track. Going above the max speed will incur a penalty and a potential DNF.
exact.zh: 必须按照赛道的指示以规定的最大速度通过。一旦超过规定的最大速度，将会受到处罚，且有可能会被取消比赛资格。

exact.en: The air gates are made up of one or two pylons, each 25 metres (82ft) high, and spaced exactly 13 metres apart. Colored bands show the pilot where they must pass between.
exact.zh: 飞行闸门由一个或两个高25米（82英尺）的塔架组成，每个之间相距13米。彩带标出飞行员必须通过的位置。

exact.en: True to life rules leniency I
True to life rules leniency II
Pilots are required to complete the 5-6 kilometer-long (3.1-3.7 mi) track and fly between the air gates following a predetermined race track configuration.
exact.zh: 飞行员需要完成5-6千米（3.1-3.7英里）长的赛道，并按照预定的赛道配置在飞行闸口之间飞行。

exact.en: Failure to do this correctly results in penalty seconds being added to their race time.
exact.zh: 未能正确执行此操作会导致其比赛时间增加罚秒。

exact.en: Penalty seconds can be added for an incorrect passing of an air gate or passing an air gate in an incorrect orientation.
exact.zh: 如果通过飞行闸口时的方式或方向错误，将会增加罚秒。

exact.en: For more serious breaches of the rules, pilots may be ruled as DNF, or 'did not finish', where their time is removed and they are not allowed to continue.
exact.zh: 对于更严重的违规行为，飞行员可能会被取消资格或被判定为“未完成”，其比赛时间将被取消、不允许再继续参赛。

exact.en: The Red Bull Air Race is held mainly over water near cities, but are also held at airfields or natural wonders. They are accompanied by a supporting program of show flights. Races are usually flown on weekends with the first day for qualification then knockout finals the day after. The events attract large crowds and are broadcast, both live and taped, in many nations.
exact.zh: 红牛航空赛的场地主要是城市附近的水域，以及机场或自然奇观。比赛通常在周末进行，通常伴有助兴的飞行表演节目，第一天是资格赛，第二天是淘汰赛、直至决出冠军。这些赛事吸引了大量观众，并会在许多国家/地区进行直播和录播。

exact.en: Tracks consist of several air gates that must be navigated in a specific order, usually requiring pilots to complete 2 laps as fast as possible.
exact.zh: 赛道由几个飞行闸口组成，必须按特定顺序通过，通常要求飞行员尽可能快地完成2圈。

exact.en: Since it was officially launched in 2003, the Red Bull Air Race World Championship has become globally renowned as one of the most exhilarating motorsport series on the planet.
exact.zh: 自2003年正式启动以来，红牛航空世界锦标赛 — 全球最激动人心的空中竞速比赛之一 — 已经享誉世界。

exact.en: The specially designed aerial racetracks are the result of extensive research and a combination of high speed, low altitude and extreme manoeuvrability makes the sport accessible only to the world's most exceptional pilots.
exact.zh: 专门设计的空中赛道凝聚了众多研究的成果，将高速、低空和极高的机动性结合起来，使这项运动成为世界上最杰出飞行员们的专属项目。

exact.en: The pilot flies low to ground between air gates: below 15 meters.
exact.zh: 飞行员低空飞行到地面，距飞行闸门：15米以下。

exact.en: The pilot collides with the ground.
The pilot misses the next air gate in the course.
exact.zh: 飞行员错过了航程中的下一个飞行闸门。

exact.en: The pilot crosses the safety line which surrounds the track.
exact.zh: 飞行员越过了环绕赛道的安全线。
取消比赛资格（12重力加速度，1秒）
取消比赛资格（1重力加速度）

exact.en: The pilot's speed exceeds 201.99kts through the starting gate.
exact.zh: 飞行员通过起跑闸口的速度超过201.99节。

exact.en: The plane experiences over 11Gs of force for more than 0.6 seconds. Intermediate leniency of 12Gs for 1 second.
exact.zh: 飞机在超过0.6秒的时间里承受超过11G的力。中级难度下放宽至12G、持续1秒。
已超过最大重力加速度

exact.en: The pilot collides with a pylon.
exact.zh: 飞行员与一个塔架相撞了。

exact.en: The pilot collides with a third pylon.
exact.zh: 飞行员与第三个塔架相撞了。

exact.en: The plane's wings are not level passing a standard gate, nor knife-edge when passing a Quadro or Knife-Edge gate.
exact.zh: 通过标准闸口时机翼没有保持在水平位置，或没有以侧飞的方式飞过四角闸口/侧飞闸口。

exact.en: The pilot's plane rotation does not match the gate's required rotation.
exact.zh: 飞行员的飞机旋转速度与闸口所需的旋转速度不匹配。

exact.en: The pilot's plane rotation does not match the gate's required rotation. Leniency of 10°.
exact.zh: 飞行员的飞机旋转速度与闸口所需的旋转速度不匹配。容错度为10°。

exact.en: The pilot's plane rotation does not match the gate's required rotation. Intermediate Leniency of 20°.
exact.zh: 飞行员的飞机旋转速度与闸口所需的旋转速度不匹配。中等容错度为20°。

exact.en: The pilot's plane rotation does not match the gate's required rotation. Beginner Leniency of 30°.
exact.zh: 飞行员的飞机旋转速度与闸口所需的旋转速度不匹配。初学者容错度为30°。

exact.en: The plane suffers from negative Gs at any point during their run.
exact.zh: 只要在运行过程中，不管什么时候飞机都会遭受负重力加速度。

exact.en: The pilot's plane is ascending or descending through an air gate.
exact.zh: 飞行员的飞机正在一边上升或下降，一边通过飞行闸口。

exact.en: The pilot fails to activate their safety smoke.
exact.zh: 飞行员未能启动安全烟雾。

exact.en: Speed is between 200.01kts and 201.99kts through the starting gate.
exact.zh: 通过起跑闸口的速度在200.01节到201.99节之间。

exact.en: The pilot's head passes above the gate's upper band.
exact.zh: 飞行员的头部从闸门的上方通过。

exact.en: The pilot's head passes above the gate's upper band. Beginner leniency of +10 meters.
exact.zh: 飞行员的头部越过了闸口的上边缘。初学者容错度为+10米。

exact.en: The pilot's head passes above the gate's upper band. Intermediate leniency of +5 meters.
exact.zh: 飞行员的头部越过了闸口的上边缘。中间的容错度为+5米。

exact.en: The pilot's head passes beneath the gate's lower band.
exact.zh: 飞行员的头部从闸门的下方通过。
游戏结束 - 最后一圈

exact.en:
Before entering a track, pilots must activate their smoke. This is to ensure the plane can be seen at all times.

Don't worry, you'll be reminded before entering a track. Just keep an ear out for the words 'Smoke on.'
exact.zh:
在进入赛道之前，飞行员必须激活烟雾。这是为了确保飞机始终保持醒目。

放心，在进入赛道前会收到提醒。只需留意“释放烟雾”的信号即可。

exact.en:
It's time to enter the track. You want to pass through the Start Gate as fast as possible without exceeding 200kts.

Going too fast will result in a time penalty and potentially a DNF.
exact.zh:
是时候进入赛道了。尽可能快地飞过起跑闸口，但不要超过200节。

如果速度太快，有可能会被取消比赛资格。
飞过入口闸口时速度太快

exact.en: Select a track and race in an attempt to set the best time possible. Select your Rule Leniency, and race alongside other pilots, your friends or alone.
exact.zh: 选择航迹并尽力创造最短时间。选择规则宽松度。可以与其他玩家、朋友一起飞行，或者单飞。

exact.en: Select a track and attempt to set the best time you can. You can fly alongside other players, friends, or simply fly solo.
exact.zh: 选择赛道并尽力创下最短时间。可以与其他玩家、朋友一起飞行，或者单飞。

exact.en: Let's get you through some of the basics so you can start making a name for yourself. How about the fastest pilot in the skies?
exact.zh: 让我们先了解一些基础知识，随后你就可以开始大显身手了。如何成为天空中最快的飞行员？

exact.en: One of the most beautiful settings for the Red Bull Air Race, with a dramatic sea backdrop.
exact.zh: 红牛航空赛最美丽的地点之一，以壮丽的大海为背景。

exact.en: The Hungarian capital is a favorite stop on the tour with its picturesque old-world charm.
exact.zh: 匈牙利的首府拥有来自旧世界风景如画的魅力，是这次旅行中最受欢迎的一站。

exact.en: The birthplace of Japanese civil aviation, the City of Flowers. The action unfolds in Makuhari Seaside Park, facing Tokyo Bay.
exact.zh: “鲜花之城”是日本民航航空的诞生地。故事发生在幕张海滨公园，面向东京湾。

exact.en: Monument Valley is a part of a ruggedly beautiful territory in the Four Corners region of Utah and Arizona.
exact.zh: 纪念碑谷位于犹他州和亚利桑那州四角地区崎岖而美丽的领土上。

exact.en: As the second largest city in Brazil, Rio De Janeiro is known for its beautiful coastline and exciting beach culture. In 2007, one million spectators packed the beaches to witness the biggest-ever sporting event in Brazilian history.
exact.zh: 里约热内卢是巴西的第二大城市，以其美丽的海岸线和令人兴奋的海滩文化而闻名。2007年，近百万名观众涌上海滩，共同见证巴西历史上规模最大的体育赛事。

exact.en: In the green and expansive Styrian Mountains, the Red Bull Ring serves as the venue for the Austrian Formula One Grand Prix.
exact.zh: 在绿茵绵亘的施蒂里亚山脉，红牛环赛道是奥地利一级方程式大奖赛的场地。

exact.en: Abu Dhabi offers a blend of modern luxury and traditional culture from the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque to the Yas Marina Circuit.
exact.zh: 阿布扎比将现代奢华和传统文化融为一体，从谢赫扎耶德大清真寺到亚斯滨海赛道，应有尽有。

exact.en: There are so many hidden gems in Budapest, from the Chain Bridge to the Shoes on the Danube Bank memorial, the thermal baths, to the trendy ruin pubs.
exact.zh: 布达佩斯隐藏着无数瑰宝，从链桥到多瑙河畔的铁鞋雕塑，从温泉浴场到时尚的废墟酒吧。

exact.en: With beautiful beaches, stunning mountains, and lush greenery, Chiba Prefecture is a nature lover’s paradise and even more beautiful from the air.
exact.zh: 千叶县拥有美丽的海滩、壮丽的山脉和郁郁葱葱的绿色植物，是大自然爱好者的天堂，从空中看更是无比美丽。

exact.en: From historical temples and traditional festivals to vibrant music scenes and thriving film industry, Chiba offers a perfect blend of tradition and modernity.
exact.zh: 从历史悠久的寺庙和传统节日到充满活力的音乐场景和繁荣的电影业，千叶是传统与现代的完美融合。

exact.en: Since 2003, the Red Bull Air Race World Championship has become known as one of the most exhilarating and demanding motorsport series on the planet.
exact.zh: 自2003年以来，红牛航空竞速世界锦标赛已成为全球最刺激、最具挑战性的竞速系列赛事之一。

exact.en: The specially designed aerial racetracks provide a combination of high speed, low altitude and extreme manoeuvrability, challenging the skills of even the world's most exceptional pilots.
exact.zh: 精心设计的空中赛道结合了高速、低空和极限机动性的多重考验，对世界上最优秀飞行员的技能提出挑战。

exact.en: The Red Bull Air Race takes place across the globe, usually held over water near cities, and occasionally at airfields or dramatic natural wonders.
exact.zh: 红牛航空竞速赛在全球各地举行，通常在城市附近的水域上空，有时也会在机场或壮丽的自然奇观旁举办。

exact.en: Pilots must be careful to follow the rules while flying. Failing to do so will result in costly time penalties or worse, a DNF.
exact.zh: 飞行员必须谨遵飞行规则。否则将遭受代价严重的时间处罚，甚至更糟 — 取消比赛资格。

exact.en: Capable of a 420 degree per second roll rate and a 3,700 foot per minute climb rate, the Zivko Edge 540 has been victorious on the international Unlimited aerobatics circuit many times since the mid-1990s.
exact.zh: Zivko Edge 540拥有每秒420度的滚转率和每分钟3700英尺的爬升率，自20世纪90年代中期以来，多次在国际无限制特技飞行赛场上获胜。

exact.en: Regarded as the highest performance aerobatic airplane in the world, the MXS has won an entire decade of US National Aerobatic Championships and World 4 Minute Free Style Championships.
exact.zh: MXS是公认的世界上性能最强的特技飞机，曾在整整十年间称霸美国国家特技飞行锦标赛和世界四分钟自由特技锦标赛。

exact.en: The Corvus Racer 540 first appeared at the 2009 AERO Friedrichshafen show in Germany. A year later it made its racing debut at the Red Bull Air Race in Windsor, Ontario, Canada.
exact.zh: 2009年，Corvus Racer 540首次亮相于德国举行的腓特烈港国际航空展览会。一年后，它在加拿大安大略省温莎举办的红牛航空竞速赛中首次登场。

exact.en: Some of these iconic red sandstone buttes rise over 1,000 feet above the valley floor.
exact.zh: 其中一些标志性的红砂岩山丘高出谷底1000多英尺。

exact.en: Numerous films have been filmed in Monument Valley such as "Forrest Gump", "Back to the Future Part III", and "The Lone Ranger".
exact.zh: 大量的电影都是在纪念碑谷拍摄的，如《阿甘正传》、《回到未来3》和《独行侠》等。

exact.en: Rio de Janeiro’s harbor is recognized by UNESCO and has a rich history dating back to Portuguese exploration in the 1500s.
exact.zh: 里约热内卢的港口被联合国教科文组织认可，其悠久的历史可以追溯到16世纪的葡萄牙探险。

exact.en: Sugarloaf Mountain, standing at 396 meters, offers a panoramic view of the harbor, and serves as a symbol of Rio’s glorious natural wonders.
exact.zh: 舒格洛夫山海拔396米，能从其上欣赏到海港的全景，是里约热内卢壮丽自然奇观的象征。

exact.en: First opened in 1969 as the Österreichring, the venue is now often referred to simply as "Spielberg", a joke with the German word Spiel meaning "play" and Berg meaning "mountain".
exact.zh: 该场馆于1969年作为奥地利赛道首次开放，现在通常被简称为“施皮尔贝格”，这是一个梗，由德语单词“Spiel”和“Berg”组成，前者的意思是“游戏”，而后者的意思则是“山”。

exact.en: You deviated too far from the vertical manoeuvre, resulting in a DNF
exact.zh: 您进行的操作与垂直机动相去甚远，故被取消比赛资格

exact.en: You flew too close to the crowd. That's a DNF.
exact.zh: 您飞得太过靠近观众了，已被取消比赛资格。
已超出202节的入场速度限制。

exact.en: Welcome to the blue waters and desert sands of the Persian Gulf, home to United Arab Emirates capital, Abu Dhabi.
exact.zh: 欢迎来到碧海与黄沙相接的波斯湾，这里是阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比的所在地。

exact.en: Welcome to the Hungarian capital of Budapest, with its old-world charm and a modern, passionate fanbase.
exact.zh: 欢迎来到匈牙利首都布达佩斯，这里既有古老的魅力，也有现代的热情粉丝群体。

exact.en: Welcome to Chiba, the City of Flowers, and the birthplace of Japanese civil aviation.
exact.zh: 欢迎来到“鲜花之城”千叶，这里是日本民用航空的发源地。

exact.en: Welcome to Monument Valley, a part of the ruggedly beautiful territory in the Four Corners region of Utah and Arizona.
exact.zh: 欢迎来到纪念碑谷，该山谷位于犹他州和亚利桑那州四角地区崎岖而美丽的领土上。

exact.en: Welcome to Rio de Janeiro where, in 2007, one million wildly cheering Air Race fans packed the beaches, creating the biggest-ever sporting event in Brazilian history.
exact.zh: 欢迎来到里约热内卢，2007年，百万名航空比赛的狂热观众涌上海滩，缔造了巴西历史上规模最大的体育赛事。

exact.en: Welcome to Spielberg, Austria, where the Red Bull Ring nestles in the Styrian Mountains and serves as the venue for the Austrian Formula One Grand Prix.
exact.zh: 欢迎来到奥地利施皮尔贝格，红牛环赛道坐落在此地的施蒂里亚山脉中，是奥地利一级方程式大奖赛的举办地。

exact.en: Penalties incurred will alter your time after each run.
exact.zh: 所产生的处罚将在每次飞行后改变时间。

exact.en: You can quit at any point and create a new session with a new track or rules leniency.
exact.zh: 可以随时退出并创建具有新航迹或规则宽松度的新赛段。

exact.en: Runs can be restarted at any point without effecting the other players.
exact.zh: 可以在任何时候重新开始飞行且不会影响其他玩家。

exact.en: Choose whether to have other players appear within the track, or just have their names visible on the HUD.
exact.zh: 选择是否显示航迹中的其他玩家，或是在抬头显示器上显示其名字。

exact.en: You didn't save your changes. Would you like to return to customizing? Or continue without saving?
exact.zh: 您尚未保存更改。是否返回定制？抑或要在没有保存的情况下继续？

exact.en: The final and most difficult maneuver is the Vertical Turn. Here, pilots must take off vertically and then spin the plane around until they are level again and facing the course.
exact.zh: 最后也是最困难的动作是垂直转弯。这一操作要求飞行员必须垂直起飞，然后旋转飞机，直到再次达到水平并面朝航线。

exact.en: Welcome to the Red Bull Air Race.
exact.zh: 欢迎来到红牛航空赛。

exact.en: Do you want to kick this player from your lobby?
exact.zh: 您想从大厅踢出这位玩家吗？

exact.en: Welcome to the biggest little city in the world! Home of the Reno National Championship Air Races!
exact.zh: 欢迎来到世界上最大的小城市！雷诺全国飞行锦标赛的主场！

exact.en: Welcome to Reno Stead Airport, home of the Reno Air Races since 1966!
exact.zh: 欢迎来到雷诺斯泰德机场 — 自1966年起，此处便一直是雷诺飞行赛的举行场地！

exact.en: Reno is the only place on earth where you can race an airplane to its maximum capabilities.
exact.zh: 雷诺是世界上唯一能让飞机在比赛中发挥最大性能的地方。

exact.en: The Jet class was inaugurated in 2002, featuring match racing with check built L-39 Albatros Jets.
exact.zh: 喷气机类项目于2002年启动，特色赛事中使用了经过经过检验的L-39“信天翁”喷气机。

exact.en: Did you hear that sound? That's a P-51. A pure symphony.
exact.zh: 有听到那个声音吗？是一架P-51。真是如听仙乐耳暂明。

exact.en: Sixcat is the most decorated plane of the T-6 class.
exact.zh: “六猫”是T-6级别中获得最多荣誉的飞机。

exact.en: In Unlimited class you'll see the fastest piston powered airplanes in the world.
exact.zh: 在无限制比赛中，您将看到世界上最快的活塞动力飞机。

exact.en: In 2017 Voodoo set a new piston speed record of 531.5 miles per hour, just before the Reno event!
exact.zh: 2017年，刚好就在雷诺赛事开启之前，“巫毒”创造了531.5英里/小时的新活塞动力速度记录！

exact.en: Everything went perfectly during this flight!
Earned because you are worth it.
Reach B reputation or more to unlock them.
exact.zh: 达到B级或以上声誉以解锁。

exact.en: Welcome to the home of the National Air Races, the Roswell Air Center, New Mexico!
exact.zh: 欢迎来到全国航空比赛的举行场地 — 新墨西哥州的罗斯威尔航空中心！

exact.en: The Roswell Air Center is a former military base for the Army and Air Force, and is now one of the largest centers for commercial aviation industries in the Southwest.
exact.zh: 罗斯维尔空军中心曾是陆军和空军的军事基地，现在是西南地区最大的商业航空工业中心之一。

exact.en: While you’re here, why not visit the Walker Aviation Museum, enjoy the animals at the Spring River Zoo or explore the Carlsbad Caverns? You could even come back in the summer to attend the annual UFO Festival, and experience something truly out of this world!
exact.zh: 来到这里后，你何不参观一下沃克航空博物馆，或是去斯普林河动物园观赏动物，亦或是去卡尔斯巴德洞窟探险一番呢？你甚至可以在夏天回来参加一年一度的UFO节，体验真正的天外之物！

exact.en: It was here that, in 1947, a UFO allegedly crashed during a thunderstorm. Sounds like poor piloting to me. One of our racers could teach those aliens a thing or two about flying!
exact.zh: 据传在1947年，有一架UFO在雷暴中坠毁此地。听起来像是飞行技术不佳。我相信我们的选手可以教教那些外星人如何飞行！

exact.zh: 您的系统不符合最低配置要求。在游戏中可能会遇到问题。

exact.en: Your system does not meet the minimum requirements. You may experience issues while running the sim.
exact.zh: 您的系统不符合最低配置要求。运行《Microsoft Flight Simulator》时可能会遇到问题。

exact.en: Cannot find appropriate video mode. Please make sure your hardware is supported by this application.
exact.zh: 找不到适合的视频模式。请确认您的硬件是否支持此应用程序。

exact.en: You will be returned to the main menu to select an account to sign in.
exact.zh: 你将返回主菜单，选择一个帐户登录。

exact.en: The {GAMEMODE_NAME} will be unavailable due to maintenance scheduled for {MAINTENANCE_DAY} at {TIME_MAINTENANCE} (local time).
exact.zh: 我们将于{MAINTENANCE_DAY}{TIME_MAINTENANCE}（当地时间）按计划进行维护，因此{GAMEMODE_NAME}届时将不可用。

exact.en: You can check your notification panel anytime to see the maintenance schedule.
exact.zh: 你可以随时检查通知面板是否有维护计划。

exact.en: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 Marketplace content that has been purchased previously is coming soon.
exact.zh: 之前购买的《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020》市场内容即将上线。

exact.en: Error accessing live air traffic data, retrying...
exact.zh: 访问实时空中交通数据时出错，正在重试……

exact.en: Issue with air traffic data resolved
exact.zh: 空中交通数据问题已解决

exact.en: Memory resources are getting low, disabling avionics to grant stability. Some settings may be lost due to this process
exact.zh: 内存资源不足，禁用航电设备以提高游戏稳定性。此操作可能会导致某些设置丢失
你的控制器已断开连接。请重新进行连接，或切换至其他控制器。

exact.en: {GAMEMODE_NAME} scheduled maintenance will begin in one hour.
exact.zh: {GAMEMODE_NAME}的计划维护将于一小时后开始。

exact.en: {GAMEMODE_NAME} scheduled maintenance is over. You can now access this mode.
exact.zh: {GAMEMODE_NAME}的计划维护已结束。你现在可以进入此模式。

exact.en: Resource usage exceeds GPU memory capacity, lower graphics settings for better performance
exact.zh: 资源使用超出GPU内存容量，请降低图形设置以获取更好的游戏性能

exact.en:
{GAMEMODE_NAME} maintenance scheduled for {MAINTENANCE_DAY} at {TIME_MAINTENANCE} (local time).
Estimated duration: {ESTIMATED_MAINTENANCE_DURATION}
exact.zh:
{GAMEMODE_NAME}维护计划定于{MAINTENANCE_DAY}{TIME_MAINTENANCE}（当地时间）进行。
预计持续时间：{ESTIMATED_MAINTENANCE_DURATION}

exact.en: There seems to be a temporary issue with the server managing the authentication service. You currently cannot access the game. Try again later. If the issue persists scan this QR code or click on this link: <https://flightsimulator.zendesk.com/hc/en-us> to contact support.
exact.zh: 管理验证服务的服务器似乎临时出现了问题。目前，你无法访问游戏。请稍后重试。若问题仍旧存在，请扫描二维码或点击此链接：<https://flightsimulator.zendesk.com/hc/en-us>以联系客户支持。

exact.en: Since you cannot resume this activity, you will be returned to the main menu.
exact.zh: 由于当前活动无法继续，您将返回主菜单。

exact.en:
Your mission will be paused for {TIME_GAME_PAUSED} to attempt to reconnect.
If connection is unsuccessful you will be redirected to the main menu.
exact.zh:
您的任务将暂停{TIME_GAME_PAUSED}以尝试重新连接。
若连接失败，您将转跳至主菜单。

exact.en: Trying to connect to your network...

Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 requires a constant internet connection. Please check your connection status or try again later.
Since you cannot resume this activity, you will be returned to the main menu.
exact.zh:
《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024》需要稳定的网络连接。请检查连接状态或稍后再试。
当前活动将无法继续，因此您将返回主菜单。

exact.en:
Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 requires a constant internet connection. Please check your connection status to continue.
Your session will be paused until you are reconnected.
exact.zh:
《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024》需要稳定的网络连接。请检查连接状态以继续。
重新连接前，游戏将暂停。

exact.en: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 requires a constant internet connection. Please check your connection status to continue.
exact.zh: 《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024》需要稳定的网络连接。请检查连接状态以继续。

exact.en: Unable to reconnect to your network

There seems to be an issue with your license or platform account. You currently cannot access Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Try again later.
If the issue persists scan the QR code or visit: to contact support.
exact.zh:
你的许可证或平台帐户似乎存在问题。目前，你无法访问《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024》。请稍后重试。
若问题仍旧存在，请扫描二维码或访问：，以联系客户支持。
现在，您可以继续飞行了！

exact.en: You are in a queue. Please wait a few minutes or try again later.
exact.zh: 您正处于队列中。请等待几分钟后再尝试。

exact.en: Too many users are trying to connect at the same time
exact.zh: 过多用户同时尝试连接

exact.en:
We’ve detected an issue with one or more essential services, making Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 currently inaccessible.
If the issue persists scan the QR code or visit: to contact support.

Error code: {ERROR_CODE}
exact.zh:
我们检测到一个或多个基础服务出现问题，导致《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024》目前无法访问。
若问题仍旧存在，请扫描此二维码或访问以下链接：，以联系客户支持。

错误代码：{ERROR_CODE}

exact.en: Attempting to connect to the servers…
Please choose a different Xbox Network account to link with this Steam account, or sign in with the Steam account already linked.
exact.zh: 请选择其他Xbox Network帐户与此Steam帐户进行关联，或使用已关联的Steam帐户登录。

exact.en: It seems like this account is already linked to another Microsoft Flight Simulator Steam account.
exact.zh: 该帐户似乎已经关联到了其他Steam版《Microsoft Flight Simulator》帐户。

exact.en: It seems like {XBOXLIVE_ACCOUNT_NAME} account is already linked to another Microsoft Flight Simulator Steam account.
exact.zh: {XBOXLIVE_ACCOUNT_NAME}帐户似乎已经关联到了其他Steam版《Microsoft Flight Simulator》帐户。

exact.en: Please choose another Xbox Network account to access Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.
exact.zh: 请选择其他Xbox Network帐户访问《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024》。

exact.en: This account is not the Xbox Network Account you chose to link to your Microsoft Flight Simulator Steam account.
exact.zh: 该帐户不是您选择与Steam版《Microsoft Flight Simulator》帐户关联的Xbox Network帐户。

exact.en:
An unexpected cloud save error occured and we couldn’t save your file.
If the issue persists, scan the QR code or visit to find potential solutions or to contact Support.

Error code: {ERROR_CODE}
exact.zh:
由于云存档出现意外错误，我们无法保存你的文件。
若问题仍旧存在，请扫描二维码或访问以寻找可能可行的解决方案或联系客户支持。

错误代码：{ERROR_CODE}

An unexpected cloud save error occured and we couldn’t load your file.
If the issue persists, scan the QR code or visit to find potential solutions or to contact Support.

Error code: {ERROR_CODE}

由于云存档出现意外错误，我们无法加载你的文件。

exact.en:
We couldn’t save your file because your cloud storage is full. You can try to free up some space by deleting input profiles, weather presets or flight plans you created.
You can delete them from the sim menus or the console settings.
exact.zh:
由于你的云存储空间已满，我们无法保存你的文件。你可以尝试通过删除已创建的输入配置、天气预设或飞行计划来释放一些空间。
你可以在游戏菜单或主机设置中将其删除。

exact.en:
We couldn’t save your file because your cloud storage seems corrupted.
If the issue persists, scan the QR code or visit to find potential solutions or to contact Support.
exact.zh:
由于云存储已损坏，我们无法保存你的文件。
若问题仍旧存在，请扫描二维码或访问以寻找可能可行的解决方案或联系客户支持。

exact.en: There is an issue with one of our servers. We will return you to the main menu.
exact.zh: 我们的某个服务器出现了问题。即将返回主菜单。

exact.en:
We couldn’t save your file because your local storage is full. You can try to free up some space by deleting input profiles, weather presets or flight plans you created.
You can delete them from the sim menus or the console settings.
exact.zh:
由于您的本地存储空间已满，我们无法保存您的文件。您可以尝试通过删除已创建的输入配置、天气预设或飞行计划来释放一些空间。
您可以在游戏菜单或主机设置中将其删除。

exact.en: The {GAMEMODE_NAME} scheduled maintenance will begin in 15 minutes. You can try to finish your current activity if you think you have enough time, or return to the main menu now to avoid being interrupted.
exact.zh: {GAMEMODE_NAME}的计划维护将于15分钟后开始。如果你认为时间充足，可以尝试完成当前活动，否则请立即返回主菜单以避免被中断。

exact.en:
The {GAMEMODE_NAME} scheduled maintenance will begin soon.
You will be redirected to the main menu.
exact.zh:
{GAMEMODE_NAME}的计划维护即将开始。
你将返回主菜单。

exact.en:
Something went wrong during your last session. Choose "Safe Mode" to disable Marketplace and Community content. To re-enable your content, visit your Library.

Scan the QR code or visit to find potential solutions or to contact Support.
exact.zh:
你上次游玩时出现了问题。请选择“安全模式”以禁用市场和社区内容。若要重新启用这些内容，请前往内容库进行相关操作。

请扫描二维码或访问以寻找可能可行的解决方案或联系客户支持。

exact.en:
Something went wrong during your last session.

exact.en: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
exact.zh: 发生意外错误。请稍后再试。

exact.en: Are you sure you want to go back to starting screen? You won’t be able to resume your current activity.
exact.zh: 您确定要返回开始画面吗？ 您将无法恢复当前正在进行的活动。

exact.en: Unable to save your photo locally due to insufficient disk space. Go to your Personal Album in your Profile to free up space by deleting some photos
exact.zh: 磁盘空间不足，无法将照片保存至本地。请先从档案中的个人相册删除一些照片，以释放空间

exact.en: Your friend is currently not on the same server as you. You need to switch to the {SERVER_NAME} server to join your friend.
exact.zh: 您与您的好友目前不在同一服务器。 您需要切换到{SERVER_NAME}服务器才能与您的好友一同游玩。

exact.en: An error occurred while attempting to delete the rolling cache.
exact.zh: 尝试删除滚动缓存时发生错误。

exact.en:
The Xbox Network account used to log in to Microsoft Flight Simulator and the Microsoft Store do not match.
To purchase items, make sure to sign in to the Microsoft Store and to Microsoft Flight Simulator with the Xbox Network account that was used to purchase Microsoft Flight Simulator.
exact.zh:
用于登录《Microsoft Flight Simulator》和Microsoft Store的Xbox Network帐户不匹配。
若要购买物品，请务必使用用于购买《Microsoft Flight Simulator》的Xbox Network帐户登录Microsoft Store和《Microsoft Flight Simulator》。

exact.en: Something went wrong during your license verification.
exact.zh: 验证许可证的过程中出了点问题。

exact.en: This might be due to a Microsoft server outage. Try again later. If the issue persists scan this QR code or visit on this link: <https://flightsimulator.zendesk.com/hc/en-us> to contact support.
exact.zh: 这可能是由于Microsoft服务器故障而造成的。请稍后再试。若问题仍旧存在，请扫描此QR码或点击以下链接：<https://flightsimulator.zendesk.com/hc/en-us>，以联系客户支持。

exact.en: Something went wrong during your game license verification.
exact.zh: 验证游戏许可证的过程中出了点问题。

exact.en: In which airport do you want to start your career?
exact.zh: 你想在哪个机场开始职业生涯？

exact.en: Which mission do you want to do?
The basic steps to handle an airplane.
Get to grips with the skills required for gravel runways, mountain flying, and water operations.
exact.zh: 掌握砾石跑道起降、山地飞行和水上操作所需的技能。

exact.en: Learn basic handling and get a feel for the F/A-18 through training missions such as afterburner take-off, split-S maneuver, and low altitude flying.
exact.zh: 通过进行加力燃烧器起飞、半滚倒转机动和低空飞行等训练任务，来学习F/A-E18的基本操作，并熟悉其驾驶手感。

exact.en: Aircraft is missing to launch this activity
exact.zh: 飞机失踪，无法启动此活动

exact.en: Master the magic of a rotorcraft flight!
Combine throttle and yoke to land safely.
exact.zh: 结合油门和控制杆以安全着陆。

exact.en: Keep cyclic aft, lower collective more, decrease groundspeed
exact.zh: 保持周期变距杆向后，再降低一些总距操纵，降低地速

exact.en: Aft cyclic, lower collective, maintain altitude
exact.zh: 后拉周期变距杆，降低总距操纵，保持高度

exact.en: When settling starts, forward cyclic and up collective
exact.zh: 当飞机降落时，前移周期变距杆并提升总距操纵

exact.en: Start with 45 kts airspeed at safe altitude
exact.zh: 在安全高度以45节的空速启动

exact.en: Settle to a hover with zero ground speed. Always use pedals to maintain heading
exact.zh: 保持地面速度为零，稳定悬停状态。始终使用踏板保持航向

exact.en: You cannot control the hot air balloon direction, let the wind carry you
exact.zh: 你无法控制热气球的方向，就随风飘动吧

exact.en: Show/hide visual assistances at any moment by using {STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}
exact.zh: 使用{STR_GUI_DISPLAY_ALL_ASSISTANCES_TOGGLE}随时显示/隐藏视觉辅助

exact.en: Complete this photo objective to unlock the Trivia associated.
exact.zh: 完成此照片目标以解锁相关的趣味知识。
世界更新：意大利和马耳他
三维摄影测绘中的城市
世界更新：伊比利亚半岛

exact.zh: 本活动尚未完全支持PlayStation®VR2。您仍可以游玩，但可能会遇到体验不够理想的情况。

exact.zh: 飞机和船舶类型、位置和行为等各种空中和海上交通的细节将基于实时数据生成。

exact.zh: 如果不更改一天中的时间，你可以看到在线玩家。选中后，你只能在飞行时看到在线玩家。
